declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteEtale_openClosed_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0G1H.** In positive characteristic, a finite étale cover of a closed
subscheme of affine space is an open-and-closed part of the restriction of a finite étale cover
of affine space.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_openClosed_pullback
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (n : ℕ)
    {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k))) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsFinite g] [Etale g] :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)))
      (_ : IsFinite f) (_ : Etale f)
      (j : Y ⟶ pullback f i),
      IsOpenImmersion j ∧ IsClosedImmersion j ∧
        j ≫ pullback.snd f i = g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.injective_etaleFundamentalGroupMap_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0G1I.** A closed immersion of connected affine schemes over `𝐅_p`
induces an injection on étale fundamental groups. Being a scheme over `𝐅_p` is spelled as
`p` being zero in the ring of global sections of the ambient scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_etaleFundamentalGroupMap_of_isClosedImmersion (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace Z] [ConnectedSpace X] [IsAffine Z] [IsAffine X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hX : (p : Γ(X, ⊤)) = 0) (z : GeometricPoint Z) :
    Function.Injective (etaleFundamentalGroupMap i z)

declarations.name: TopologicalSpace.isSpectralMap_iff_continuous_constructibleTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1J.** Let `X` and `Y` be spectral spaces and let `f : X → Y` be continuous.
Then `f` is a spectral map if and only if it is continuous for the constructible topologies
on `X` and `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSpectralMap_iff_continuous_constructibleTopology
    [SpectralSpace X] [SpectralSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (hf : Continuous f) :
    IsSpectralMap f ↔ Continuous[constructibleTopology X, constructibleTopology Y] f

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.PreZeroHypercover.injective_of_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1K.** Let `𝒰 = {U_i ⟶ U}` and `𝒱 = {V_j ⟶ U}` be families of morphisms with
fixed target `U`, and let `φ` exhibit `𝒱` as a refinement of `𝒰`. If `F(U) ⟶ ∏_j F(V_j)` is
injective, then so is `F(U) ⟶ ∏_i F(U_i)`: each `U_i` is reached from some `V_j` through `φ`,
so agreeing on all the `V_j` already forces agreement on all the `U_i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_of_hom (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{w} U) (𝒱 : PreZeroHypercover.{w'} U)
    (φ : 𝒱.Hom 𝒰) (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type t)
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      fun (x : F.obj (Opposite.op U)) (j : 𝒱.I₀) => F.map (𝒱.f j).op x) :
    Function.Injective
      fun (x : F.obj (Opposite.op U)) (i : 𝒰.I₀) => F.map (𝒰.f i).op x

declarations.name: isSheafFor_ofArrows_of_refinement
declarations.doc:
Let `{πU i : Uᵢ i ⟶ U}` and `{πV j : V j ⟶ U}` be families of morphisms such that each `πV j`
factors as `f j ≫ πU (α j)`, and let `UV i j` be a pullback of `πU i` and `πV j`. If `ℱ` is a
sheaf for `{πV j}` and, for each `i`, the restriction maps `ℱ(Uᵢ i) ⟶ ℱ(UV i j)` are jointly
injective, then `ℱ` is a sheaf for `{πU i}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheafFor_ofArrows_of_refinement
    {C : Type*} [Category C] {U : C}
    {I J : Type*} (Uᵢ : I → C) (V : J → C) (UV : I → J → C)
    (πU : ∀ i, Uᵢ i ⟶ U) (πV : ∀ j, V j ⟶ U)
    (α : J → I) (f : ∀ j, V j ⟶ Uᵢ (α j))
    (hf : ∀ j, f j ≫ πU (α j) = πV j)
    (uvToV : ∀ i j, UV i j ⟶ V j) (uvToU : ∀ i j, UV i j ⟶ Uᵢ i)
    (huv : ∀ i j, uvToV i j ≫ πV j = uvToU i j ≫ πU i)
    (hpbUU : ∀ i i', HasPullback (πU i) (πU i'))
    (hpbUV : ∀ i j, IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk (uvToV i j) (uvToU i j) (huv i j)))
    (hpbVV : ∀ j j', HasPullback (πV j) (πV j'))
    (ℱ : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type*)
    (hV : Presieve.IsSheafFor ℱ (Presieve.ofArrows V πV))
    (hinj : ∀ i, Function.Injective fun s : ℱ.obj (op (Uᵢ i)) =>
      fun j : J => ℱ.map (uvToU i j).op s) :
    Presieve.IsSheafFor ℱ (Presieve.ofArrows Uᵢ πU)

declarations.name: MvRatFunc.rank
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1M**.
For an algebraic extension `S/R` of commutative rings (with `S` a domain and
`FaithfulSMul R S`), the rank of `MvRatFunc σ S` over `MvRatFunc σ R` equals the rank of
`S` over `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem rank (R S σ : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsDomain S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S] [FaithfulSMul R S] :
    Module.rank (MvRatFunc σ R) (MvRatFunc σ S) = Cardinal.lift (Module.rank R S)

declarations.name: MvRatFunc.rank'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1M** (universe monomorphic version).
Same as `MvRatFunc.rank`, but with all types in the same universe, so the equality of ranks
needs no universe lift.
declarations.statement:
theorem rank' (R : Type*) (S σ : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsDomain S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S] [FaithfulSMul R S] :
    Module.rank (MvRatFunc σ R) (MvRatFunc σ S) = Module.rank R S
declarations.comment: universe monomorphic version

declarations.name: invLimit_isAdicComplete
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Q**.  For a finitely generated ideal `I` of a commutative ring `A` and an
inverse system `(M_n)` of `A`-modules with `I^n M_n = 0` for all `n`, the inverse limit
`M = lim_n M_n` is `I`-adically complete: it is a direct summand of its own completion, which
is `I`-adically complete because `I` is finitely generated.
declarations.statement:
theorem invLimit_isAdicComplete (hI : I.FG)
    (hM : ∀ n, I ^ n • (⊤ : Submodule A (M n)) = ⊥) :
    IsAdicComplete I (invLimit M t)

declarations.name: henselianPair_sup
declarations.doc: The sum of two ideals defining henselian pairs also defines a henselian pair.

declarations.name: exists_greatest_henselianPair
declarations.doc: Every commutative ring has a largest ideal with respect to which it forms a henselian pair.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_greatest_henselianPair (A : Type u) [CommRing A] :
    ∃ I : Ideal A, HenselianPair A I ∧
      ∀ J : Ideal A, HenselianPair A J → J ≤ I

declarations.name: IPowerTorsionDerivedTensor.derivedTensorProduct_isZero_of_mod_ideal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1T.** If `K ⊗ᴸ[R] R / I` vanishes, then so does the derived tensor product of `K`
with every positive-power quotient of `R`, every `I`-power-torsion module, and every bounded
derived object with `I`-power-torsion cohomology.
declarations.statement:
public theorem derivedTensorProduct_isZero_of_mod_ideal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    (hK : IsZero
      (((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor R).obj K).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj
          (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I))))) :
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n →
      IsZero
        (((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor R).obj K).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj
            (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n))))) ∧
    (∀ (N : ModuleCat.{u} R), IsIPowerTorsion R N I →
      IsZero
        (((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor R).obj K).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj N))) ∧
    (∀ (M : DerivedCategory.Bounded (ModuleCat.{u} R)),
      (∀ i : ℤ, IsIPowerTorsion R
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj M.obj) I) →
      IsZero
        (((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor R).obj K).obj
          M.obj))

declarations.name: KoszulTensorVanishing.isZero_of_isDerivedComplete_of_derivedTensorProduct_mod_ideal_isZero
declarations.doc:
**Derived Nakayama lemma, Stacks Project, Tag 0G1U.** A derived-complete complex with
respect to a finitely generated ideal is zero if its derived reduction modulo that ideal is
zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_of_isDerivedComplete_of_derivedTensorProduct_mod_ideal_isZero
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :
    letI : HasProductsOfShape ℕ (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      Stacks.DerivedProducts.hasProductsOfShape_derivedCategory
    IsDerivedComplete I K →
      IsZero
        (((canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor A).obj K).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)))) →
      IsZero K

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
Morphisms from the extension by zero of the structure sheaf of the localised site `C/U` to a
sheaf of modules `N` are canonically the sections of `N` over `U`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{w}) (U : C)
    (N : SheafOfModules.{max u₁ v₁ w t} R) :
    (extensionByZeroUnit.{u₁, v₁, w, t} R U ⟶ N) ≃ ToType (N.val.obj (op U))
declarations.comment: for the sheafified-free-module spelling of `j_{U!} O_U`

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv_naturality
declarations.doc: The bijection `extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv` is natural in the target module.
declarations.statement:
lemma extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv_naturality (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{w}) (U : C)
    {M N : SheafOfModules.{max u₁ v₁ w t} R}
    (ψ : extensionByZeroUnit.{u₁, v₁, w, t} R U ⟶ M) (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv.{u₁, v₁, w, t} R U N (ψ ≫ φ) =
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation R (op U)).map φ)
        (extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv.{u₁, v₁, w, t} R U M ψ)
declarations.comment: naturality in the target

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroUnitCorepresentableBy
declarations.doc:
The extension by zero of the structure sheaf of `C/U` corepresents the functor sending a
sheaf of modules to its sections over `U`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def extensionByZeroUnitCorepresentableBy (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{w}) (U : C) :
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation R (op U) ⋙
        forget (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁ w t} (R.obj.obj (op U)))).CorepresentableBy
      (extensionByZeroUnit.{u₁, v₁, w, t} R U)
declarations.comment: corepresentability

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.OverModules.extensionByZeroUnitCorepresentableBy
declarations.statement:
def extensionByZeroUnitCorepresentableBy (O : Sheaf J RingCat.{w}) (U : C) :
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation O (op U) ⋙
        forget (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁ w t} (O.obj.obj (op U)))).CorepresentableBy
      (extensionByZeroUnit.{v₁, u₁, w, t} J O U)
declarations.comment: corepresentability of the extension-by-zero spelling

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1V.** Morphisms `j_{U!} O_U ⟶ F` are canonically the sections of `F` over `U`:
transpose along the extension-by-zero adjunction, then read the resulting morphism out of the
unit sheaf of modules on `C/U` as a section at the terminal object `U ⟶ U`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv (F : SheafOfModules.{w} R) :
    ((SheafOfModules.pullback.{w} (F := Over.forget U)
      (𝟙 (R.over U) : (R.over U) ⟶ (R.over U))).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (R.over U)) ⟶ F) ≃
      (F.val.obj (op U) : Type w)

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1V.** The identification of `Hom_O(j_{U!} O_U, F)` with `F(U)` is natural in
`F`: composing with `g : F ⟶ G` corresponds to applying `g` to sections over `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv_naturality {F G : SheafOfModules.{w} R}
    (f : (SheafOfModules.pullback.{w} (F := Over.forget U)
      (𝟙 (R.over U) : (R.over U) ⟶ (R.over U))).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (R.over U)) ⟶ F)
    (g : F ⟶ G) :
    extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv J R U G (f ≫ g) =
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation R (op U)).map g)
        (extensionByZeroUnitHomEquiv J R U F f)
declarations.comment: naturality

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exists_finite_restrictIndex_cechShortComplex_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0G1W**, the middle exactness half. If `U` is a quasi-compact object
and `{U_i → U}_{i ∈ I}` is a covering family whose pairwise fibre products exist, then there
is a finite subset `I' ⊆ I` for which the Čech sequence of the subfamily `{U_i → U}_{i ∈ I'}`
is exact in the middle as well as at `j_{U!} O_U`.

Quasi-compactness is used only through
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.QuasiCompact.exists_finite_restrictIndex_sieve₀_mem`: a covering family
of a quasi-compact object has a finite subfamily which is *still a covering*, and Stacks 0934
applies to that subfamily directly.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finite_restrictIndex_cechShortComplex_exact
    (hU : J.IsQuasiCompactObject U) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁} U)
    (h𝒰 : 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J U) [hpb𝒰 : ∀ i j, HasPullback (𝒰.f i) (𝒰.f j)] :
    ∃ T : Set 𝒰.I₀, T.Finite ∧
      (cechShortComplex.{u₁, v₁, w, t} R (𝒰.restrictIndex (Subtype.val : T → 𝒰.I₀))
          (hpb := fun _ _ ↦ hpb𝒰 _ _)).Exact ∧
        Epi (cechShortComplex.{u₁, v₁, w, t} R (𝒰.restrictIndex (Subtype.val : T → 𝒰.I₀))
          (hpb := fun _ _ ↦ hpb𝒰 _ _)).g
declarations.comment:
the middle exactness: a finite subfamily of a covering of a quasi-compact
  object already has exact Čech sequence

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exists_finite_epi_sigmaDesc_extensionByZeroUnitMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0G1W**, the surjectivity half. If `U` is a quasi-compact object of a
ringed site and `{U_i → U}_{i ∈ I}` is a covering of `U`, then there is a finite subset
`I' ⊆ I` for which
`⊕_{i ∈ I'} j_{U_i!} O_{U_i} ⟶ j_{U!} O_U`
is already an epimorphism, i.e. the sequence of the source is exact at `j_{U!} O_U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finite_epi_sigmaDesc_extensionByZeroUnitMap {U : C}
    (hU : J.IsQuasiCompactObject U) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁} U)
    (h𝒰 : 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J U) :
    ∃ T : Set 𝒰.I₀, T.Finite ∧
      Epi (Sigma.desc fun i : T => extensionByZeroUnitMap.{u₁, v₁, w, t} R (𝒰.f i.1))
declarations.comment:
the surjectivity half: a finite subfamily of a covering of a quasi-compact
  object already gives an epimorphism onto the extension by zero

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.extSpectralSequenceInto_isBounded
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1X, boundedness.** If in every degree `Ext^n(M, F^pK^•)` vanishes for `p ≫ 0` and
maps bijectively onto `Ext^n(M, K^•)` for `p ≪ 0`, then the Ext spectral sequence into `K^•` is
bounded: in each total degree only finitely many terms of its first page are nonzero.
declarations.statement:
theorem extSpectralSequenceInto_isBounded
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₀ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p₀ ≤ p →
      Subsingleton (DerivedCategory.Ext M (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (K.filtration.obj (op p))) n))
    (hiso : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₁ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ p₁ →
      Function.Bijective
        (extPostcomp M n (DerivedCategory.Q.map (K.filtration.ι.app (op p))))) :
    IsBounded (extSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K).1
declarations.comment: ext_spectral_sequence_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.extSpectralSequenceInto_hasPageInfinityAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1X, the infinity page exists.** Under the same hypotheses the Ext spectral
sequence into `K^•` stabilises at every bidegree.
declarations.statement:
theorem extSpectralSequenceInto_hasPageInfinityAt
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₀ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p₀ ≤ p →
      Subsingleton (DerivedCategory.Ext M (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (K.filtration.obj (op p))) n))
    (hiso : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₁ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ p₁ →
      Function.Bijective
        (extPostcomp M n (DerivedCategory.Q.map (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)))))
    (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (extSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K).1.HasPageInfinityAt pq
declarations.comment: ext_spectral_sequence_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.extSpectralSequenceInto_convergesToExt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1X, convergence.** If in every degree `Ext^n(M, F^pK^•)` vanishes for `p ≫ 0` and
maps bijectively onto `Ext^n(M, K^•)` for `p ≪ 0`, then the Ext spectral sequence into `K^•`
converges to `Ext^{p + q}(M, K^•)`: the decreasing filtration
`Stacks.Injectives.extIntoFiltration` of `Ext^n(M, K^•)` is finite, being `⊤` for `p ≪ 0` and `⊥`
for `p ≫ 0`, the spectral sequence has an infinity page everywhere, and
`E_∞^{p, q} ≅ F^p/F^{p + 1}` in total degree `n = p + q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem extSpectralSequenceInto_convergesToExt
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₀ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p₀ ≤ p →
      Subsingleton (DerivedCategory.Ext M (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (K.filtration.obj (op p))) n))
    (hiso : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₁ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ p₁ →
      Function.Bijective
        (extPostcomp M n (DerivedCategory.Q.map (K.filtration.ι.app (op p))))) :
    let E := (extSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K).1
    ∃ hF : ∀ n : ℤ, Antitone (extIntoFiltration M K n),
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ extIntoFiltration M K n a = ⊤ ∧
        extIntoFiltration M K n b = ⊥) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, E.HasPageInfinityAt (p, q)) ∧
      ∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
        ((E.pageInfinity (p, q) : Type v) ≃+
          ((cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (extIntoFiltration M K (p + q) (p + 1))
              (extIntoFiltration M K (p + q) p)
              (hF (p + q) (by omega))) : AddCommGrpCat.{w}) : Type w))
declarations.comment: ext_spectral_sequence_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.extSpectralSequenceInto
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1X.** For a filtered complex `K^•` of a Grothendieck abelian category and an object
`M` of `D(A)`, the cohomological spectral sequence `(E_r, d_r)_{r ≥ 1}` of the filtered Hom
complex, bundled with the identifications `E_1^{p,q} = Ext^{p+q}(M, gr^pK)`.  Its differential on
page `r` has bidegree `(r, -r + 1)` by the definition of `CohomologicalSpectralSequence`.
declarations.statement:
def extSpectralSequenceInto (M : DerivedCategory A) (K : CochainComplex.Filtered A) :
    Σ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{v} 1,
      ∀ p q : ℤ, ((E.page 1).X (p, q) : Type v) ≃+
        DerivedCategory.Ext M
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((FilteredObject.gr p).obj K)) (p + q)
declarations.comment: ext_spectral_sequence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.nonempty_canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y, representative independence.**  Let `A` be a Grothendieck abelian category and
let `M` and `K` be objects of `D(A)`.  The Ext spectral sequence of Tag 0G1X attached to the
canonical truncation filtration `F^pK^• = τ_{≤ -p}K^•` of a complex `K^•` representing `K` does
not depend on the choice of `K^•`: for any two complexes `K₁^•` and `K₂^•` representing `K` the
two spectral sequences are isomorphic, so they have the same pages, differentials and
page-turning isomorphisms from `E₁` onward.

The two spectral sequences compared are the ones named
`Stacks.Injectives.canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto M K₁` and
`Stacks.Injectives.canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto M K₂`, that name being by definition the Ext
spectral sequence of Tag 0G1X applied to the canonical truncation filtration; it is written out
here so that this file does not depend on the module which introduces it.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto_iso (M : DerivedCategory A)
    (K : DerivedCategory A) (K₁ K₂ : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K₁ ≅ K) (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K₂ ≅ K) :
    Nonempty ((extSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M
        (CochainComplex.canonicalTruncationFiltration K₁)).1 ≅
      (extSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M
        (CochainComplex.canonicalTruncationFiltration K₂)).1)
declarations.comment: representative_independence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y.** The Ext spectral sequence into the canonical truncation filtration
`F^pK^• = τ_{≤ -p}K^•` of a cochain complex, a cohomological spectral sequence
`(E_r, d_r)_{r ≥ 1}`.
declarations.statement:
def canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto (M : DerivedCategory A) (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ) :
    CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{v} 1
declarations.comment: canonical_e1

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.canonicalExtSpectralSequenceIntoE₁
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y.** For a representative `K^•` of `K`, the first page of the canonical Ext
spectral sequence into `K` is `E_1^{p, q} = Ext^{2p + q}(M, H^{-p}(K))`. The degrees `n = -p`
and `m = 2p + q` are arguments constrained by equations.
declarations.statement:
def canonicalExtSpectralSequenceIntoE₁ (M K : DerivedCategory A) (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K' ≅ K) (p q n m : ℤ) (hn : n = -p) (hm : m = 2 * p + q) :
    ((canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K').page 1).X (p, q) ≃+
      DerivedCategory.Ext M ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A n).obj K)) m
declarations.comment: canonical_e1

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y.** The canonical Ext spectral sequence into `K`, renumbered by
`(i, j) ↦ (-j, i + 2j)` so that its first page becomes the second: a cohomological spectral
sequence `(E'_r, d'_r)_{r ≥ 2}` whose differential on page `r` has bidegree `(r, -r + 1)`.
declarations.comment: renumbered_e2

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequenceIntoE₂
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y.** For a representative `K^•` of `K`, the second page of the renumbered
canonical Ext spectral sequence into `K` is `(E'_2)^{i, j} = Ext^i(M, H^j(K))`.
declarations.statement:
def renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequenceIntoE₂ (M K : DerivedCategory A)
    (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ) (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K' ≅ K) (i j : ℤ) :
    ((renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K').page 2).X (i, j) ≃+
      DerivedCategory.Ext M ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A j).obj K)) i
declarations.comment: renumbered_e2

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y.** The Ext spectral sequence into the brutal truncation filtration
`F^pK^• = σ_{≥ p}K^•` of a cochain complex, a cohomological spectral sequence
`(E_r, d_r)_{r ≥ 1}`.
declarations.statement:
def stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto (M : DerivedCategory A) (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ) :
    CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{v} 1
declarations.comment: stupid_e1

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.stupidExtSpectralSequenceIntoE₁
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y.** The first page of the Ext spectral sequence of the brutal truncation
filtration of `K^•` is `E_1^{p, q} = Ext^q(M, K^p)`.
declarations.statement:
def stupidExtSpectralSequenceIntoE₁ (M : DerivedCategory A) (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (p q : ℤ) :
    ((stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K').page 1).X (p, q) ≃+
      DerivedCategory.Ext M ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj (K'.X p)) q
declarations.comment: stupid_e1

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto_isBounded
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y.** If `M` is bounded above in the derived category and `K^•` is bounded below,
the Ext spectral sequence of the brutal truncation filtration of `K^•` is bounded.
declarations.statement:
theorem stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto_isBounded (M : DerivedCategory A)
    (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ) (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus M)
    (hK : CochainComplex.plus A K') :
    IsBounded (stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K')
declarations.comment: stupid_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto_hasPageInfinityAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y.** Under the same hypotheses the brutal-truncation Ext spectral sequence has an
infinity page at every bidegree.
declarations.statement:
theorem stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto_hasPageInfinityAt (M : DerivedCategory A)
    (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ) (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus M)
    (hK : CochainComplex.plus A K') (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K').HasPageInfinityAt pq
declarations.comment: stupid_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto_convergesToExt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y, convergence of the brutal-truncation spectral sequence.** Under the same
hypotheses it converges to `Ext^{p + q}(M, K^•)`: the decreasing filtration
`Stacks.Injectives.extIntoFiltration` of each `Ext^n(M, K^•)` is finite and the infinity page at
`(p, q)` is its `p`-th graded piece in total degree `p + q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto_convergesToExt (M : DerivedCategory A)
    (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ) (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus M)
    (hK : CochainComplex.plus A K') :
    let E := stupidExtSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K'
    let F := extIntoFiltration M (CochainComplex.stupidTruncationFiltration K')
    ∃ hF : ∀ n : ℤ, Antitone (F n),
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ F n a = ⊤ ∧ F n b = ⊥) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, E.HasPageInfinityAt (p, q)) ∧
      ∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
        ((E.pageInfinity (p, q) : Type v) ≃+
          ((Limits.cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (F (p + q) (p + 1)) (F (p + q) p)
              (hF (p + q) (by omega))) : AddCommGrpCat.{w}) : Type w))
declarations.comment: stupid_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto_isBounded
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y, boundedness of the canonical spectral sequence.** For `M ∈ D^-(A)` and
`K ∈ D^+(A)` the Ext spectral sequence of the canonical truncation filtration of a complex
representing `K` is bounded: in total degree `d` its first page
`E_1^{p, d - p} = Ext^{p + d}(M, H^{-p}(K))` vanishes unless `-a - d ≤ p ≤ -b`, where `M` lives in
degrees `≤ a` and `K` in degrees `≥ b`.
declarations.statement:
theorem canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto_isBounded (M K : DerivedCategory A)
    (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ) (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K' ≅ K)
    (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus M)
    (hK : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus K) :
    IsBounded (canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K')
declarations.comment: canonical_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto_convergesToExt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y, convergence of the canonical spectral sequence.** For `M ∈ D^-(A)` and
`K ∈ D^+(A)` the Ext spectral sequence of the canonical truncation filtration converges to
`Ext^{p + q}(M, K)`: the decreasing filtration `Stacks.Injectives.extIntoFiltration` of each
`Ext^n(M, K)` is finite and the infinity page at `(p, q)` is its `p`-th graded piece in total
degree `p + q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto_convergesToExt (M K : DerivedCategory A)
    (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ) (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K' ≅ K)
    (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus M)
    (hK : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus K) :
    let E := canonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K'
    let F := extIntoFiltration M (CochainComplex.canonicalTruncationFiltration K')
    ∃ hF : ∀ n : ℤ, Antitone (F n),
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ F n a = ⊤ ∧ F n b = ⊥) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, E.HasPageInfinityAt (p, q)) ∧
      ∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
        ((E.pageInfinity (p, q) : Type v) ≃+
          ((Limits.cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (F (p + q) (p + 1)) (F (p + q) p)
              (hF (p + q) (by omega))) : AddCommGrpCat.{w}) : Type w))
declarations.comment: canonical_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto_isBounded
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y, boundedness after renumbering.** For `M ∈ D^-(A)` and `K ∈ D^+(A)` the
renumbered canonical Ext spectral sequence `(E'_r, d'_r)_{r ≥ 2}` is bounded.
declarations.statement:
theorem renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto_isBounded (M K : DerivedCategory A)
    (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ) (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K' ≅ K)
    (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus M)
    (hK : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus K) :
    IsBounded (renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K')
declarations.comment: canonical_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto_convergesToExt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Y, convergence after renumbering.** For `M ∈ D^-(A)` and `K ∈ D^+(A)` the
renumbered canonical Ext spectral sequence converges to `Ext^{i + j}(M, K)`: the infinity page at
`(i, j)` is the graded piece of `Stacks.Injectives.extIntoFiltration` from `-j + 1` to `-j` in
total degree `i + j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto_convergesToExt (M K : DerivedCategory A)
    (K' : CochainComplex A ℤ) (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K' ≅ K)
    (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus M)
    (hK : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus K) :
    let E := renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequenceInto.{w', w} M K'
    let F := extIntoFiltration M (CochainComplex.canonicalTruncationFiltration K')
    ∃ hF : ∀ n : ℤ, Antitone (F n),
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ F n a = ⊤ ∧ F n b = ⊥) ∧
      (∀ i j : ℤ, E.HasPageInfinityAt (i, j)) ∧
      ∀ i j : ℤ, Nonempty
        ((E.pageInfinity (i, j) : Type v) ≃+
          ((Limits.cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (F (i + j) (-j + 1)) (F (i + j) (-j))
              (hF (i + j) (by omega))) : AddCommGrpCat.{w}) : Type w))
declarations.comment: canonical_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.extSpectralSequence_isBounded
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Z, boundedness.** Under eventual vanishing and eventual comparison-isomorphism
for Ext from the filtered quotients, the Ext spectral sequence is bounded.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extSpectralSequence_isBounded
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    (K : DerivedCategory A) (M : CochainComplex.Filtered A)
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₀ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ p₀ →
      IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (DerivedCategory.Ext
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((FilteredObject.quot (op p)).obj M)) K n)))
    (hiso : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₁ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p₁ ≤ p →
      IsIso (extFromFilteredQuotient K M p n)) :
    IsBounded (extSpectralSequence K M).1
declarations.comment: boundedness

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.extSpectralSequence_convergesToExt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Z, convergence.** Under eventual vanishing and eventual
comparison-isomorphism for Ext from the filtered quotients, the Ext spectral sequence converges
to the Ext groups from the underlying complex, with the canonical quotient-image filtration.
The graded quotient at `(p,q)` is the step from `-p` to `-p + 1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extSpectralSequence_convergesToExt
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    (K : DerivedCategory A) (M : CochainComplex.Filtered A)
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₀ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ p₀ →
      IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (DerivedCategory.Ext
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((FilteredObject.quot (op p)).obj M)) K n)))
    (hiso : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₁ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p₁ ≤ p →
      IsIso (extFromFilteredQuotient K M p n)) :
    let E := (extSpectralSequence K M).1
    ∃ hF : ∀ n : ℤ, Monotone (extQuotientFiltration K M n),
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ extQuotientFiltration K M n a = ⊥ ∧
        extQuotientFiltration K M n b = ⊤) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, E.HasPageInfinityAt (p, q)) ∧
      ∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
        (E.pageInfinity (p, q) ≅
          cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (extQuotientFiltration K M (p + q) (-p))
            (extQuotientFiltration K M (p + q) (-p + 1)) (hF (p + q) (by omega))))
declarations.comment: convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.extSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G1Z.** The Ext spectral sequence associated to a filtered complex `M`, bundled with
the identifications `E₁^{p,q} = Ext^{p+q}(gr^{-p} M, K)`.  Its differential on page `r` has
bidegree `(r, -r + 1)` by the definition of `CohomologicalSpectralSequence`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def extSpectralSequence
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    (K : DerivedCategory A) (M : CochainComplex.Filtered A) :
    Σ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{w} 1,
      ∀ p q : ℤ,
        (E.page 1).X (p, q) ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of
          (DerivedCategory.Ext
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              ((FilteredObject.gr (C := (CochainComplex A ℤ)) (-p)).obj M))
            K (p + q))
declarations.comment: spectral_sequence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequence
declarations.doc: 0G20 renumbered_e2, declaration 1.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequence
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A]
    {M K : DerivedCategory A} {M' : CochainComplex A ℤ}
    {e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj M' ≅ M}
    (S : CanonicalExtSpectralSequence M K M' e) :
    CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{w} 2

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequence_page_two
declarations.doc: 0G20 renumbered_e2, declaration 2.
declarations.statement:
public theorem renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequence_page_two
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A]
    {M K : DerivedCategory A} {M' : CochainComplex A ℤ}
    {e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj M' ≅ M}
    (S : CanonicalExtSpectralSequence M K M' e) (i j : ℤ) :
    Nonempty
      (((renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequence S).page 2).X (i, j) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of
          (DerivedCategory.Ext ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A (-j)).obj M)) K i))
declarations.comment: renumbered_e2

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.canonicalExtSpectralSequence_isBounded
declarations.doc:

`K ∈ D⁺(A)`, the canonical Ext spectral sequence is bounded.
declarations.statement:
public theorem canonicalExtSpectralSequence_isBounded
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.canonicalExtSpectralSequence_convergesToExt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G20, convergence before renumbering.** For `M ∈ D⁻(A)` and
`K ∈ D⁺(A)`, the canonical Ext spectral sequence converges to `Ext^(p+q)(M, K)`, with
filtration index `-p`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem canonicalExtSpectralSequence_convergesToExt
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A]
    {M K : DerivedCategory A} {M' : CochainComplex A ℤ}
    {e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj M' ≅ M}
    (S : CanonicalExtSpectralSequence M K M' e)
    (hM : (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t (C := A)).minus M)
    (hK : (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t (C := A)).plus K) :
    let E := S.spectralSequence
    ∃ hF : ∀ n : ℤ, Monotone (canonicalExtFiltration S n),
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ canonicalExtFiltration S n a = ⊥ ∧
        canonicalExtFiltration S n b = ⊤) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, E.HasPageInfinityAt (p, q)) ∧
      ∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
      (E.pageInfinity (p, q) ≅
          cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (canonicalExtFiltration S (p + q) (-p))
            (canonicalExtFiltration S (p + q) (-p + 1)) (hF (p + q) (by omega))))
declarations.comment: canonical_convergence

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequence_isBounded
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0G20, boundedness after renumbering.** For `M ∈ D⁻(A)` and
`K ∈ D⁺(A)`, the renumbered canonical Ext spectral sequence is bounded.
declarations.statement:
public theorem renumberedCanonicalExtSpectralSequence_isBounded
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A]
    {M K : DerivedCategory A} {M' : CochainComplex A ℤ}
    {e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj M' ≅ M}
