    (hcramer : ∀ g ∈ Jid, algebraMap A (RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin r)) (a ^ c) * g
        - ∑ i, partialDerivative I i g * γ i ∈ Jid ^ 2)
    (ψ : RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin r) →ₐ[A] C)
    (hψc : @Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin r))
      ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology) ψ)
    (hψJ : ∀ g ∈ Jid, ψ g ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) :
    ∃ ψ' : RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin r) →ₐ[A] C,
      (@Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin r))
        ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology) ψ') ∧
      (∀ g ∈ Jid, ψ' g ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * (n - c))) ∧
      (∀ g, ψ' g - ψ g ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (n - c))
declarations.comment: the lifting claim

declarations.name: Rig.sub_mem_pow_two_mul_of_sub_mem_sq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the well-definedness of the obstruction map. Representatives of one class
in `J / J²` have the same image in `IⁿC / I²ⁿC`, so `o(ψ) : J/J² → IⁿC/I²ⁿC`, `g ↦ ψ(g)`, is
well defined.
declarations.comment: the obstruction map o(ψ) is well defined

declarations.name: Rig.exists_obstruction_difference_of_lifts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the independence of the obstruction class of the chosen lift. Two
continuous `A`-algebra maps `ψ, ψ' : A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩ → C` that reduce to the same map modulo
`IⁿC` satisfy

`ψ'(g) - ψ(g) - ∑ i, ψ(∂g/∂xᵢ) εᵢ ∈ I²ⁿC`  for every `g`,

with `εᵢ = ψ'(xᵢ) - ψ(xᵢ) ∈ IⁿC`. So the obstruction maps `o(ψ')` and `o(ψ)` differ by the
composite of the differential of `NL^∧_{B/A}` with `dxᵢ ↦ εᵢ`, and therefore define the same
class in `Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, IⁿC/I²ⁿC)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_obstruction_difference_of_lifts (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    {C : Type w} [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C]
    {r : ℕ} (n : ℕ)
    (ψ ψ' : RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin r) →ₐ[A] C)
    (hψc : @Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin r))
      ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology) ψ)
    (hψ'c : @Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin r))
      ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology) ψ')
    (hsame : ∀ g, ψ' g - ψ g ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) :
    ∃ ε : Fin r → C, (∀ i, ε i ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) ∧
      ∀ g, ψ' g - ψ g - ∑ i, ψ (partialDerivative I i g) * ε i
        ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n)
declarations.comment: o(ψₙ) does not depend on the chosen lift

declarations.name: Rig.exists_perturbed_algHom_of_obstruction_factors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the power-series computation, for an arbitrary ideal `I`.

Let `C` be an `I`-adically complete `A`-algebra, `J` an ideal of `A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩`, and
`ψ : A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩ → C` a continuous `A`-algebra map. Suppose there are `δ₁, …, δ_r ∈ I^{n'}C`
with

`ψ(g) - ∑ i, ψ(∂g/∂xᵢ) δᵢ ∈ I^{2n'}C`  for every `g ∈ J`,

which is the statement that the obstruction map of `ψ` agrees with `h ∘ d` into
`I^{n'}C / I^{2n'}C`, for `h : ⨁ i, B dxᵢ → I^{n'}C / I^{2n'}C` the map sending `dxᵢ` to the
class of `δᵢ`. Then `ψ' : xᵢ ↦ ψ(xᵢ) - δᵢ` is a continuous `A`-algebra map with
`ψ'(J) ⊆ I^{2n'}C`, and `ψ' - ψ` takes values in `I^{n'}C`.

No principality of `I`, no regularity on `C` and no relation between `n'` and the precision of
`ψ` are used; the two conclusions are the first-order expansion of Stacks 0AK3 applied to the
perturbation.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_perturbed_algHom_of_obstruction_factors (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    {C : Type w} [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C]
    {r : ℕ} (Jid : Ideal (RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin r))) (n' : ℕ)
    (ψ : RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin r) →ₐ[A] C)
    (hψc : @Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin r))
      ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology) ψ)
    (δ : Fin r → C) (hδ : ∀ i, δ i ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n')
    (hfac : ∀ g ∈ Jid, ψ g - ∑ i, ψ (partialDerivative I i g) * δ i
      ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n')) :
    ∃ ψ' : RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin r) →ₐ[A] C,
      (@Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin r))
        ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology) ψ') ∧
      (∀ g ∈ Jid, ψ' g ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n')) ∧
      (∀ g, ψ' g - ψ g ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n')
declarations.comment: the lifting claim, arbitrary ideal

declarations.name: Rig.exists_algHom_quotient_of_obstruction_factors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the claim of the remark, for an arbitrary ideal `I`.

Let `A` be a ring with a finitely generated ideal `I`, let `B` be an `I`-adically complete
`A`-algebra of finite type modulo `I` with a completed polynomial presentation
`B = A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩ / J`, and let `C` be an `I`-adically complete `A`-algebra. Let
`ψₙ : B → C / IⁿC` be an `A`-algebra map and `ψ : A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩ → C` a continuous lift of it.

If the obstruction map of `ψ` maps to zero in
`Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, I^{n'}C / I^{2n'}C)` for some `n' ≤ n` — that is, if there are
`δ₁, …, δ_r ∈ I^{n'}C` with `ψ(g) - ∑ i, ψ(∂g/∂xᵢ) δᵢ ∈ I^{2n'}C` for every `g ∈ J` — then
there is an `A`-algebra homomorphism `ψ'_{2n'} : B → C / I^{2n'}C` which agrees with `ψₙ` as
maps into `C / I^{n'}C`.

Neither principality of `I` nor regularity of anything on `C` is assumed, and no Cramer
relation on `J` is hypothesised: the only input is the vanishing of the obstruction class.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_algHom_quotient_of_obstruction_factors
    {I : Ideal A} (hI : I.FG) {B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I}
    (P : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I B)
    {C : Type w} [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C]
    (n n' : ℕ) (hn' : n' ≤ n)
    (ψn : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n)
    (ψ : RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin P.variableCount) →ₐ[A] C)
    (hψc : @Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin P.variableCount))
      ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology) ψ)
    (hψred : ∀ g, Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) (ψ g)
      = ψn (P.restrictedToAlgHom g))
    (δ : Fin P.variableCount → C) (hδ : ∀ i, δ i ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n')
    (hfac : ∀ g ∈ P.restrictedKer, ψ g - ∑ i, ψ (partialDerivative I i g) * δ i
      ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n')) :
    ∃ ψ₂ : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n'),
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ A
          (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : n' ≤ 2 * n'))).comp ψ₂
        = (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ A (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hn')).comp ψn
declarations.comment: the claim

declarations.name: Rig.exists_algHom_quotient_of_obstruction_vanishes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the claim of the remark with the lift of `ψₙ` produced internally.

For a Noetherian `A`, an `A`-algebra map `ψₙ : B → C/IⁿC` whose obstruction class vanishes in
`Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, I^{n'}C/I^{2n'}C)` — the vanishing being witnessed, as in the source, on
*some* continuous lift `ψ` of `ψₙ`, which by `Rig.obstruction_factors_of_lift_change` is the
same as on every one — lifts to `ψ'_{2n'} : B → C/I^{2n'}C` agreeing with `ψₙ` into
`C/I^{n'}C`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_algHom_quotient_of_obstruction_vanishes
    {I : Ideal A} (hI : I.FG) {B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I}
    (P : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I B)
    {C : Type w} [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C]
    (n n' : ℕ) (hn' : n' ≤ n)
    (ψn : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n)
    (hvanish : ∀ ψ : RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin P.variableCount) →ₐ[A] C,
      @Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin P.variableCount))
        ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology) ψ →
      (∀ g, Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) (ψ g)
        = ψn (P.restrictedToAlgHom g)) →
      ∃ δ : Fin P.variableCount → C, (∀ i, δ i ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n') ∧
        ∀ g ∈ P.restrictedKer, ψ g - ∑ i, ψ (partialDerivative I i g) * δ i
          ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n')) :
    ∃ ψ₂ : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n'),
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ A
          (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : n' ≤ 2 * n'))).comp ψ₂
        = (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ A (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hn')).comp ψn
declarations.comment: the claim, with the lift chosen internally

declarations.name: Rig.exists_obstruction_factors_of_exists_algHom_quotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the converse of the claim: `o(ψₙ)` is *the* obstruction, not merely an
obstruction. If `ψₙ : B → C/IⁿC` does lift to an `A`-algebra map `ψ₂ : B → C/I²ⁿC`, then the
obstruction map of any continuous lift `ψ` of `ψₙ` already factors through the differential of
`NL^∧_{B/A}`, i.e. `o(ψₙ) = 0` in `Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, IⁿC/I²ⁿC)`.

The proof is the independence of the obstruction class of the chosen lift: a continuous lift
`χ` of `ψ₂` is in particular a lift of `ψₙ` with `χ(J) ⊆ I²ⁿC`, so `o(χ) = 0`, and
`o(ψ) = o(χ) - h ∘ d` for `h : dxᵢ ↦ χ(xᵢ) - ψ(xᵢ)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_obstruction_factors_of_exists_algHom_quotient
    {I : Ideal A} (hI : I.FG) {B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I}
    (P : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I B)
    {C : Type w} [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C]
    (n : ℕ)
    (ψn : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n)
    (ψ : RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin P.variableCount) →ₐ[A] C)
    (hψc : @Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin P.variableCount))
      ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology) ψ)
    (hψred : ∀ g, Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) (ψ g)
      = ψn (P.restrictedToAlgHom g))
    (ψ₂ : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n))
    (hψ₂ : (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ A
        (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (show n ≤ 2 * n by omega))).comp ψ₂ = ψn) :
    ∃ δ : Fin P.variableCount → C, (∀ i, δ i ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) ∧
      ∀ g ∈ P.restrictedKer, ψ g - ∑ i, ψ (partialDerivative I i g) * δ i
        ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n)
declarations.comment: o(ψₙ) is the obstruction: the converse

declarations.name: Rig.obstruction_factors_iff_exists_algHom_quotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the headline sentence of the remark: the obstruction to lifting
`ψₙ : B → C/IⁿC` to `C/I²ⁿC` *is* the class `o(ψₙ)`. Reading the class through the cokernel
description of `Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, IⁿC/I²ⁿC)` of Stacks 0ALN part (1), its vanishing says
that the obstruction map of a continuous lift `ψ` of `ψₙ` is `h ∘ d` for some
`h : ⨁ i, B dxᵢ → IⁿC/I²ⁿC`, i.e. that there are `δ₁, …, δ_r ∈ IⁿC` with
`ψ(g) - ∑ i, ψ(∂g/∂xᵢ) δᵢ ∈ I²ⁿC` for every `g ∈ J`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem obstruction_factors_iff_exists_algHom_quotient
    {I : Ideal A} (hI : I.FG) {B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I}
    (P : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I B)
    {C : Type w} [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C]
    (n : ℕ)
    (ψn : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n)
    (ψ : RestrictedPowerSeries I (Fin P.variableCount) →ₐ[A] C)
    (hψc : @Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin P.variableCount))
      ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology) ψ)
    (hψred : ∀ g, Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) (ψ g)
      = ψn (P.restrictedToAlgHom g)) :
    (∃ δ : Fin P.variableCount → C, (∀ i, δ i ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) ∧
        ∀ g ∈ P.restrictedKer, ψ g - ∑ i, ψ (partialDerivative I i g) * δ i
          ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n))
      ↔ ∃ ψ₂ : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n),
          (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ A
            (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (show n ≤ 2 * n by omega))).comp ψ₂ = ψn
declarations.comment: o(ψₙ) is the obstruction to lifting ψₙ to C/I²ⁿC

declarations.name: Rig.exists_conormal_cramer_relation_of_ext_annihilated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP.** The obstruction relation in the form the lifting arguments use: if `b`
annihilates every first Ext group of the completed naive cotangent complex, and `β` lifts `b` to
`A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩`, then there are `γ₁, …, γ_r ∈ J` with

`β · g - ∑ i, (∂g/∂xᵢ) · γᵢ ∈ J²`  for every `g ∈ J`.

Applying an `A`-algebra map `ψ : A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩ → C` with `ψ(J) ⊆ IⁿC` turns this into the
statement that `b · o(ψ)` is the composite of the differential with the map
`dxᵢ ↦ ψ(γᵢ) mod I²ⁿC`, i.e. that the obstruction class is killed by `b`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_conormal_cramer_relation_of_ext_annihilated
    (K : CompletedNaiveCotangentComplex P) (b : B.carrier)
    (β : P.completedPolynomialRing) (hβ : P.toAlgHom β = b)
    (hExt : ∀ (N : ModuleCat.{max u v} B.carrier)
      (ξ : DerivedCategory.Ext (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K.cochainComplex)
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} B.carrier) 0).obj N) 1),
      b • ξ = 0) :
    ∃ γ : Fin P.variableCount → P.completedPolynomialRing,
      (∀ i, γ i ∈ P.ker) ∧
      ∀ g ∈ P.ker, β * g - ∑ i, K.partialDeriv i g * γ i ∈ P.ker ^ 2
declarations.comment: the obstruction class

declarations.name: Rig.ObstructionLift.obstruction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the obstruction map. The `B`-linear map

`o(ψ) : J/J² → IᵐC/I²ᵐC`, `g ↦ ψ(g)`,

well defined because `ψ(J) ⊆ IᵐC` forces `ψ(J²) ⊆ I²ᵐC`. The `B`-action on the target is
through `residue`, i.e. through the reduction of `ψ` modulo `IᵐC`.
declarations.statement: public def obstruction : P.extension.Cotangent →ₗ[B.carrier] D.target
declarations.comment: the obstruction map o(ψ) : J/J² → IᵐC/I²ᵐC

declarations.name: Rig.ObstructionLift.obstructionBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the `C`-linear extension of the obstruction map. Since the `B`-action on
`IᵐC/I²ᵐC` factors through `C/IᵐC`, the `B`-linear map `o(ψ)` extends to a `C/IᵐC`-linear map

`(C/IᵐC) ⊗_B J/J² → IᵐC/I²ᵐC`.

This is the extension the remark records after constructing `o(ψ)`.
declarations.statement:
public def obstructionBaseChange :
    D.base ⊗[B.carrier] P.extension.Cotangent →ₗ[D.base] D.target
declarations.comment: the C-linear extension of o(ψ) over J/J² ⊗_B C

declarations.name: Rig.ObstructionLift.extClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the obstruction class

`o(ψₘ) ∈ Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, IᵐC/I²ᵐC)`,

the image of `o(ψ)` under the identification of `Ext¹` with
`Coker (Hom_B(⨁ B dxᵢ, -) → Hom_B(J/J², -))` of Stacks 0ALN part (1).
declarations.statement:
public def extClass :
    DerivedCategory.Ext (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K.cochainComplex)
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} B.carrier) 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of B.carrier D.target)) 1
declarations.comment: the obstruction class o(ψₘ) in Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, IᵐC/I²ᵐC)

declarations.name: Rig.ObstructionLift.extClass_eq_zero_iff_exists_linearMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**: the obstruction class vanishes exactly when `o(ψ)` factors through the
differential of `NL^∧_{B/A}`, i.e. exactly when there is a `B`-linear
`h : ⨁ i, B dxᵢ → IᵐC/I²ᵐC` with `h ∘ d = o(ψ)`. This is the cokernel description of
Stacks 0ALN part (1), read on the completed naive cotangent complex.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extClass_eq_zero_iff_exists_linearMap :
    D.extClass K = 0 ↔
      ∃ h : (Fin P.variableCount → B.carrier) →ₗ[B.carrier] D.target,
        ∀ z, h (K.differential z) = D.obstruction z
declarations.comment: the vanishing of o(ψₘ) as a factorization through d

declarations.name: Rig.ObstructionLift.extClass_eq_zero_iff_exists_delta
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**: the obstruction class vanishes exactly when there are
`δ₁, …, δ_r ∈ IᵐC` with

`ψ(g) - ∑ i, ψ(∂g/∂xᵢ) δᵢ ∈ I²ᵐC`  for every `g ∈ J`.

The `δᵢ` are representatives of the values `h(dxᵢ)` of the factorisation `h` of the previous
theorem; this is the form in which the lifting argument consumes the vanishing.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extClass_eq_zero_iff_exists_delta :
    D.extClass K = 0 ↔
      ∃ δ : Fin P.variableCount → C, (∀ i, δ i ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ m) ∧
        ∀ g ∈ P.ker, D.lift g - ∑ i, D.lift (K.partialDeriv i g) * δ i
          ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * m)
declarations.comment: the vanishing of o(ψₘ) on representatives

declarations.name: Rig.exists_algHom_quotient_of_extClass_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAP**, the claim of the remark with its hypothesis in the form the remark states
it: the vanishing of the obstruction class in `Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, I^{n'}C/I^{2n'}C)`.

Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, `I` a finitely generated ideal, `B` an `I`-adically complete
`A`-algebra of finite type modulo `I` with a completed polynomial presentation
`B = A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩ / J`, and `C` an `I`-adically complete `A`-algebra. Let
`ψₙ : B → C/IⁿC` be an `A`-algebra map and `D` a continuous lift of it to `A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩`
with `D.lift(J) ⊆ I^{n'}C`, for some `n' ≤ n`. If `o(ψ_{n'}) = 0` in
`Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, I^{n'}C/I^{2n'}C)`, then there is an `A`-algebra homomorphism
`ψ'_{2n'} : B → C/I^{2n'}C` agreeing with `ψₙ` as maps into `C/I^{n'}C`.

Arbitrary `I`, no regularity hypothesis, and no Cramer relation assumed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_algHom_quotient_of_extClass_eq_zero [IsNoetherianRing A] (hI : I.FG)
    [IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C] (n n' : ℕ) (hn' : n' ≤ n)
    (ψn : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n)
    (D : ObstructionLift P C n')
    (hcont : @Continuous _ _ (limitTopology I (Fin P.variableCount))
      ((I.map (algebraMap A C)).adicTopology)
      (D.lift.comp (adicCompletionAlgEquiv I (Fin P.variableCount)).toAlgHom))
    (hred : ∀ g, Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n)
        (D.lift (adicCompletionAlgEquiv I (Fin P.variableCount) g))
      = ψn (P.restrictedToAlgHom g))
    (hvanish : D.extClass (completedNaiveCotangentComplex B P) = 0) :
    ∃ ψ₂ : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (2 * n'),
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ A
          (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (show n' ≤ 2 * n' by omega))).comp ψ₂
        = (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ A (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hn')).comp ψn
declarations.comment: the claim, with the hypothesis as the vanishing of the Ext class

declarations.name: Rig.exists_algHom_lift_of_dualSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAQ**, with the precision of the conclusion corrected as in the library's Tag 0GAD.

Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, `I ⊆ A` an ideal, `B` an object of the category of Stacks 0AL4 for
`(A, I)` with a completed polynomial presentation `P`, and suppose `I ^ c` annihilates
`Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, N)` for every `B`-module `N`. Let `C` be a Noetherian `I`-adically complete
`A`-algebra whose invariants of Local Cohomology, Section 0GA6 are `d` and `q₀`, write
`D = k + 1 = max(d, 1)`, and let `n ≥ q₀ + (1+D)c` with `n > 2(2+D)c`. Then every `A`-algebra map
`ψₙ : B → C / IⁿC` agrees modulo `I^{n-(2+D)c}` with the reduction of an `A`-algebra map
`φ : B → C`.

**Deviation from the source.** The source concludes agreement modulo `I^{n-(1+d)c}` under
`n ≥ max(q₀ + (1+d)c, 2(1+d)c + 1)`. The level reached here is `n - (2+D)c`, which is the level
the source's argument for Tag 0GAD reaches with `D` in place of `d`
(`Stacks.LocalCohomology.UniformityIII.CanDualSituation.ext_one_powQuot_map_eq_zero` at `d`),
and the bound on `n` is adjusted to `n > 2(2+D)c` accordingly; `D = max(d, 1)` in place of `d` is
inherited from the library's Tag 0GAC. The discrepancy is the one that Tag 0GAD's docstring records:
the source's own argument produces maps at level `n - (2+d)c`, and for `d ≥ 1` the module it
asserts the obstruction dies in admits no canonical map to or from the one its argument reaches.
Twisting down is harmless for the iteration, so the only effect is on the numbers.

**The route.** The source passes from `Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, N)` to `Ext¹_{C/IⁿC}` of the derived
base change (Tags 0E1W and 0G9G) in order to apply Tag 0GAD. Here the Ext-annihilation
hypothesis is used through Tag 0GAP in its cokernel form — the obstruction relation
`a · g ≡ ∑ i (∂g/∂xᵢ) γᵢ` modulo `J²` of `Rig.exists_restricted_cramer_relation` — which base
changes to `C / IᵐC` by elementary means, so that Tag 0GAC applies directly to the explicit
two-term complex and Tags 0E1W, 0G9G and 0GAD itself are not needed. The level reached is the
one of Tag 0GAD, as it must be: the argument is the same.

**The carried hypotheses.** `S` is the family of `DualSituation`s of Tag 0GA6, one for each
thickness `m`, with the invariants `d` and `q₀` independent of `m` (`hd`, `hq₀`); the structure
carries the blowup cohomology of Tag 0GAA, which the library does not build from the blowup.
`hdual` is the open duality input of the library's Tag 0GAC, carried for every level `m ≥ n`: it is
the section of `p^*(M^∨)` at level `m - 2c` obtained by factoring through
`can : p^*(M^∨) → (p^*M)^∨`, whose kernel and cokernel being scheme theoretically supported on
`Y_c` is not available. Nothing else is assumed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_algHom_lift_of_dualSituation
    {I : Ideal A} (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I)
    (P : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I B) (c : ℕ)
    (hExt : ∀ a ∈ I ^ c, ∀ (N : ModuleCat.{max u v} B.carrier)
      (ξ : DerivedCategory.Ext
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (completedNaiveCotangentComplex B P).cochainComplex)
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} B.carrier) 0).obj N) 1),
      (algebraMap A B.carrier a) • ξ = 0)
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C] [Algebra A C]
    [IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C]
    (S : ∀ m : ℕ, DualSituation C (I.map (algebraMap A C)) m c)
    (d q₀ k : ℕ) (hd : ∀ m, (S m).d = d) (hq₀ : ∀ m, (S m).q₀ = q₀)
    (hk : max d 1 = k + 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn₁ : q₀ + (k + 2) * c ≤ n) (hn₂ : 2 * ((k + 3) * c) < n)
    (hdual : ∀ (m e : ℕ) (_ : n ≤ m) (hem : e + 2 * c = m) (hq : (S m).q₀ ≤ e)
      (M : ANCModule (I.map (algebraMap A C)) m c)
      (φ : resModule (I.map (algebraMap A C)) m M.1 →ₗ[C]
        powQuot (I.map (algebraMap A C)) m m),
      ∃ σ' : (S m).H M.dual 0 (e : ℤ),
        (S m).ev M e hq σ'
          = (powQuotLe (I.map (algebraMap A C)) (Nat.le.intro hem)).comp φ)
    (ψn : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) :
    ∃ φ : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C,
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ A
        (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.sub_le n ((k + 3) * c)))).comp ψn =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ A ((I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ (n - (k + 3) * c))).comp φ
declarations.comment: with the conclusion at precision I^{n-(2+D)c}, D = max(d,1) -- the level the library's Tag 0GAD reaches -- in place of the source's I^{n-(1+d)c}, and with n > 2(2+D)c for the source's n > 2(1+d)c; the Ext hypothesis is used through Tag 0GAP's cokernel form and Tag 0GAC, so Tags 0E1W, 0G9G and 0GAD are not invoked; carries 0GAC's open duality input as `hdual`, and d, q₀ as a family `S` of DualSituations with m-independent invariants

declarations.name: Rig.exists_algHom_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GAQ.** Let `c ≥ 0`, let `I` be an ideal of a Noetherian ring `A`, let
`B` be in the category of Stacks 0AL4 for `(A, I)`, with a completed polynomial presentation `P`,
such that `I ^ c` annihilates `Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, N)` for every `B`-module `N`, and let `C` be a
Noetherian `I`-adically complete `A`-algebra. Denote `d = d(Gr_I(C))` and `q₀ = q(Gr_I(C))` the
integers of Local Cohomology, Section 0GA6. Then for `n ≥ max(q₀ + (d + 1)c, 2(d + 1)c + 1)`
every `A`-algebra map `ψₙ : B → C/IⁿC` agrees modulo `I^{n-(d+1)c}` with the reduction of an
`A`-algebra map `φ : B → C`.

The two integers are the defining quantities of Section 0GA6, computed on the blowup `X` of
`Spec(C)` in `IC`: `d` is the maximal dimension of the fibres of `X ⟶ Spec(C)`
(`Stacks.LocalCohomology.UniformityIII.fibreDim`, a maximum by
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.UniformityIII.topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le_fibreDim` and
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.UniformityIII.fibreDim_le`), and `q₀` is the least integer past which
the twists `𝒪_Y(q)` of the exceptional divisor have no higher cohomology and global sections
`I^q C/I^{q+1} C` (`Stacks.LocalCohomology.UniformityIII.qS`), which is the source's `q(S)`
because `Hⁱ(Y, 𝒪_Y(q))` vanishes for `i > d` anyway (Stacks 02V7;
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.UniformityIII.qS_isLeast_isBaseThresholdUpTo_fibreDim`).

**The proof.** The obstruction relation of Stacks 0GAP makes the obstruction complex
`[(C/IᵐC) ⊗ J → (C/IᵐC)ʳ]` of a lift a two-term complex whose differential splits multiplication
by `I^c`; the obstruction then dies at level `m - (d+1)c` by the corrected Tag 0GAD
(`Stacks.LocalCohomology.UniformityIII.exists_extension_of_split`), and the iteration of the
source (`Rig.exists_algHom_lift_of_extension`) passes to the limit in the complete ring `C`. The
source's own argument for Tag 0GAD reaches only `m - (2+d)c` for `d > 0`; the argument used is the
one the source gives for `d = 0` (a local lift and the vanishing of a global obstruction), carried
out for every `d`, which reaches the source's level.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_algHom_lift
    {I : Ideal A} (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I)
    (P : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I B) (c : ℕ)
    (hExt : ∀ a ∈ I ^ c, ∀ (N : ModuleCat.{max u v} B.carrier)
      (ξ : DerivedCategory.Ext
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (completedNaiveCotangentComplex B P).cochainComplex)
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} B.carrier) 0).obj N) 1),
      (algebraMap A B.carrier a) • ξ = 0)
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C] [Algebra A C]
    [IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C]
    (n : ℕ)
    (hn : max (qS (I.map (algebraMap A C)) +
        (fibreDim (I.map (algebraMap A C)) + 1) * c)
      (2 * ((fibreDim (I.map (algebraMap A C)) + 1) * c) + 1) ≤ n)
    (ψn : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^ n) :
    ∃ φ : B.carrier →ₐ[A] C,
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ A (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right
        (Nat.sub_le n ((fibreDim (I.map (algebraMap A C)) + 1) * c)))).comp ψn =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ A ((I.map (algebraMap A C)) ^
        (n - (fibreDim (I.map (algebraMap A C)) + 1) * c))).comp φ
declarations.comment: with d = d(Gr_I(C)) and q₀ = q(Gr_I(C)) the defining quantities of Section 0GA6 computed on the blowup of Spec(C) in IC (maximal fibre dimension and the threshold qS), and NL^∧_{B/A} computed from a completed polynomial presentation P of B

declarations.name: Rig.PerturbedPresentation.exists_algEquiv_of_perturbation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAR.** Let `I` be an ideal of a Noetherian ring `A`, `r ≥ 0` and
`P = A[x₁, …, x_r]^∧` the `I`-adic completion. Let `P^⊕t --K--> P^⊕m --(g₁, …, g_m)--> P → B → 0`
be a resolution of the quotient `B = P/(g₁, …, g_m)`, and assume `B` is rig-smooth over `(A, I)`.
Then there is an integer `n₀` such that for every `n ≥ n₀` and every complex
`P^⊕t --K'--> P^⊕m --(g'₁, …, g'_m)--> P` with `gᵢ - g'ᵢ ∈ IⁿP` and
`K - K' ∈ Iⁿ Mat(m × t, P)` there is an isomorphism of `A`-algebras `B ≅ B' = P/(g'₁, …, g'_m)`;
moreover the perturbed complex is again a resolution.

The proof is the source's.
* (A) `I^c` annihilates `Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, -)` for some `c`, by rig-smoothness
  (`exists_extAnnihilated_of_isRigSmooth`).
* (B) For `n` beyond an Artin-Rees constant of the resolution the perturbed complex is a
  resolution (Stacks 07VE) and `Gr_I(B) ≅ Gr_I(B')` — as the equality of initial forms of the
  two ideals (Stacks 07VF, `exists_perturbationBound_sameInitialForms`).
* (C) The invariants of Local Cohomology, Section 0GA6 are those of `B`: `q₀ = q(Gr_I(B))` serves
  for `B'` because `q` only depends on `Gr_I` (`isBaseThreshold_quotIdeal_of_sameInitialForms`),
  and the vanishing degree `d` is read off a generating family of `I`, so it serves for every
  quotient of `P` (`subsingleton_blowupHmod_of_span`).
* Lemma 0GAQ (`Rig.exists_algHom_lift_of_dualSituation'`, via
  `exists_comparison_algHom_of_liftingInputsAboveExponent`) lifts
  the canonical `B → B'/IⁿB'` to an `A`-algebra map `φ : B → B'` congruent to it modulo a fixed
  power of `I`; its inputs are the blowup's dual situations and the duality input of Tag 0GAC
  (`liftingInputsOfIsBaseThreshold`).
* The final paragraph: such a `φ` is an isomorphism (`exists_perturbationBound_algEquiv_of_algHom`,
  by Artin-Rees and Nakayama).

The integer `n₀` absorbs the precision loss of the lifting lemma, so its exact value is
immaterial; the source's choice is `max(c₁ + 1, q₀ + (d₀ + 1)c, 2(d₀ + 1)c + 1)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_algEquiv_of_perturbation {t m : ℕ}
    (K : (Fin t → completedPolynomialAlgebra I r) →ₗ[completedPolynomialAlgebra I r]
      (Fin m → completedPolynomialAlgebra I r))
    (g : (Fin m → completedPolynomialAlgebra I r) →ₗ[completedPolynomialAlgebra I r]
      completedPolynomialAlgebra I r)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker g = LinearMap.range K)
    (hB : IsRigSmooth (quotientObj A I r (LinearMap.range g))) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀,
      ∀ (K' : (Fin t → completedPolynomialAlgebra I r) →ₗ[completedPolynomialAlgebra I r]
          (Fin m → completedPolynomialAlgebra I r))
        (g' : (Fin m → completedPolynomialAlgebra I r) →ₗ[completedPolynomialAlgebra I r]
          completedPolynomialAlgebra I r),
      g'.comp K' = 0 →
      CongruentModPow (I.map (algebraMap A (completedPolynomialAlgebra I r))) K K' n →
      CongruentModPow (I.map (algebraMap A (completedPolynomialAlgebra I r))) g g' n →
        LinearMap.ker g' = LinearMap.range K' ∧
        Nonempty
          ((completedPolynomialAlgebra I r ⧸
              (LinearMap.range g : Ideal (completedPolynomialAlgebra I r))) ≃ₐ[A]
            (completedPolynomialAlgebra I r ⧸
              (LinearMap.range g' : Ideal (completedPolynomialAlgebra I r))))

declarations.name: Rig.exists_finiteType_adicCompletion_algEquiv_henselization_quotient
declarations.doc:
A quotient of the henselization of a finite type `A`-algebra has a completion algebraizable
by a finite type `A`-algebra.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finiteType_adicCompletion_algEquiv_henselization_quotient
    (A : Type u) (C : Type v) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [Algebra.FiniteType A C]
    (I : Ideal A)
    (J : Ideal (henselization C (I.map (algebraMap A C)) : Type v)) :
    let H := (henselization C (I.map (algebraMap A C)) : Type v)
    letI : Algebra A H :=
      ((algebraMap C H).comp (algebraMap A C)).toAlgebra
    ∃ (B : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra A B)
      (_ : Algebra.FiniteType A B),
      Nonempty (AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap A B)) B ≃ₐ[A]
        AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap A (H ⧸ J))) (H ⧸ J))

declarations.name: Rig.exists_finiteType_adicCompletion_algEquiv_of_isGRing_of_isRigSmooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Proposition 0GAT.** Let `I` be an ideal of a Noetherian G-ring `A` and
let `B` be an object of the category of Tag 0AL4. If `B` is rig-smooth over `(A, I)`, then
there is a finite type `A`-algebra `C` and an isomorphism `B ≅ C^∧` of `A`-algebras.

Every step of the source's proof is carried out:
`Rig.exists_finiteType_adicCompletion_algEquiv_of_isRigSmooth'` runs the presentation (Tag 0AJP),
its finite free resolution, the henselization `H` of `(A[x], I A[x])` with its G-ring property
(Tags 07PV, 0AH3) and completion `P` (Tag 0AGV), the approximation of the resolution's relations
over `H` (Tag 0AH5, with Popescu's Theorem 07GC and Tag 0AH2), and the final algebraization
(Tag 0GAS); Lemma 0GAR is `Rig.perturbationStableQuotients`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finiteType_adicCompletion_algEquiv_of_isGRing_of_isRigSmooth
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (hA : IsGRing A) (I : Ideal A)
    (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I) (hB : IsRigSmooth B) :
    ∃ (C : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra A C),
      Algebra.FiniteType A C ∧
        Nonempty (B.carrier ≃ₐ[A] AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C)

declarations.name: Rig.jacobianDet_smul_naiveCotangentComplex_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
For a square presentation `B = A[x₁, …, xₙ]/(f₁, …, fₙ)`, the image of the
Jacobian determinant annihilates `NL_{B/A}` in the derived category of `B`-modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem jacobianDet_smul_naiveCotangentComplex_eq_zero
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (n : ℕ)
    (f : Fin n → MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f))
      (Matrix.det (fun i j : Fin n ↦ MvPolynomial.pderiv i (f j)))) •
        𝟙 (Deformation.Artin.derivedNaiveCotangentComplex A
          (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))) = 0
declarations.comment: square_null_action

declarations.name: Rig.jacobianDet_smul_ext_one_naiveCotangentComplex_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
Let `B = A[x₁, …, xₙ]/(f₁, …, fₘ)`, where `m ≤ n`.  The image in `B` of the
Jacobian determinant formed with the first `m` variables annihilates
`Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, N)` for every `B`-module `N`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem jacobianDet_smul_ext_one_naiveCotangentComplex_eq_zero
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (m n : ℕ) (f : Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)
    (h : m ≤ n)
    (N : ModuleCat.{max u v}
      (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)))
    (x : DerivedCategory.Ext
      (derivedNaiveCotangentComplex A
        (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)))
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (ModuleCat.{max u v} (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))) 0).obj N) 1) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f))
        (Matrix.det (fun i j : Fin m => MvPolynomial.pderiv (Fin.castLE h i) (f j))) • x = 0
declarations.comment: ext_annihilation

declarations.name: Rig.exists_finiteType_adicCompletion_algEquiv_of_jacobianChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GAW: the Jacobian criterion for algebraization.**

Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, `I ⊆ A` an ideal and `B` an `I`-adically complete `A`-algebra
with `B/IB` of finite type over `A/I` (an object of Stacks 0AL4), presented as
`B = A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩/J`.  Assume there are `b ∈ B`, `0 ≤ m ≤ r` and `f₁, …, f_m ∈ J` such that

1. `V(b) ⊆ V(IB)` in `Spec(B)`,
2. the image of `Δ = det(∂fⱼ/∂xᵢ)_{1 ≤ i, j ≤ m}` in `B` divides `b`, and
3. `bJ ⊆ (f₁, …, f_m) + J²`.

Then there exist a finite type `A`-algebra `C` and an `A`-algebra isomorphism `B ≅ C^∧`.

Here `b` is given by a lift to `A⟨x⟩`; condition (1) is `IB ⊆ √(b)`.

**The proof.**  As in the source, `C` is the algebra
`A[z₁, …, z_t, x₁, …, x_r]/(z₁Δ' - a₁^{c₁}, …, z_tΔ' - a_t^{c₁}, f'₁, …, f'_m)` of Stacks 0GAV
built from polynomial approximations `f'ⱼ` of the `fⱼ` and generators `a₁, …, a_t` of `I`, and
it maps onto `B/IⁿB`.  The lift of that map to `φ : C^∧ → B` is produced by Newton's method
(`exists_algHom_newton`): in this algebra the Jacobian determinant of the relations with
respect to `z₁, …, z_t, x₁, …, x_m` is `Δ'^{t+1}`, and the relations themselves force a fixed
power of `I` into `Δ'B`, so the linearized equations can be solved exactly at each step and
the source's uniform lifting result Stacks 0GAQ is not needed.  `φ` is surjective because it is
surjective modulo `I`, a power of `I` kills `Ker(φ)/Ker(φ)²`
(`exists_pow_smul_cotangent_eq_bot_of_jacobianChart`, the source's application of Stacks 0ALM
and of the comparison of free modules of rank `r - m`), and Stacks 0ALR concludes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finiteType_adicCompletion_algEquiv_of_jacobianChart
    (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I) (P : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I B)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ P.variableCount) (b : P.completedPolynomialRing)
    (f : Fin m → P.ker)
    (hvanish : B.adicIdeal ≤ (Ideal.span {P.toAlgHom b}).radical)
    (hjacobian :
      P.toAlgHom (Matrix.det fun i j : Fin m ↦
        (completedNaiveCotangentComplex B P).partialDeriv (Fin.castLE hm i)
          (f j : P.completedPolynomialRing)) ∣ P.toAlgHom b)
    (hrelations : ∀ x : P.completedPolynomialRing, x ∈ P.ker →
      b * x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j : Fin m ↦ (f j : P.completedPolynomialRing)) +
        P.ker ^ 2) :
    ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra A C),
      Algebra.FiniteType A C ∧
        Nonempty (B.carrier ≃ₐ[A] AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C)

declarations.name: Rig.exists_finiteType_algEquiv_adicCompletion_of_jacobianChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAW, carrying the hypotheses that the library's Stacks 0GAQ carries.**

Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, `I ⊆ A` an ideal, `B` an `I`-adically complete `A`-algebra of
finite type modulo `I`, presented as `B = A⟨x₁, …, x_r⟩/J`, and suppose given `b`, an integer
`m ≤ r` and `f₁, …, f_m ∈ J` with `V(b) ⊆ V(IB)`, with the Jacobian determinant
`Δ = det(∂fⱼ/∂xᵢ)_{i, j ≤ m}` dividing the image of `b`, and with `bJ ⊆ (f₁, …, f_m) + J²`.
Then `B` is the `I`-adic completion of a finite type `A`-algebra.

**The route.** The hypotheses make `B` rig-smooth over `(A, I)`, so a power `I^{c}` annihilates
`Ext¹_B(NL^∧_{B/A}, N)`, and `V(b) ⊆ V(IB)` gives `c₁` with `I^{c₁}B ⊆ bB`.  Writing
`I = (a₁, …, a_t)` and approximating the `fⱼ` by polynomials `f'ⱼ` to accuracy `n`, the algebra

`C = A[z₁, …, z_t, x₁, …, x_r]/(z₁Δ' - a₁^{c₁}, …, z_tΔ' - a_t^{c₁}, f'₁, …, f'_m)`

of Stacks 0GAV has `I^{1 + t((t+1)c₁ - 1)}` annihilating `Ext¹` of its completed naive cotangent
complex — an exponent independent of `n`, which is what lets `n` be chosen in terms of it — and
maps onto `B/IⁿB` by `x_i ↦ x_i`, `z_k ↦ b_k b'`.  Stacks 0GAQ lifts that surjection to
`φ : C^∧ → B`, which is surjective because it is surjective modulo `I`, and Stacks 0ALR
algebraizes `B` from `φ`.

**The carried hypotheses, one line each.**

* `S` — a family of Stacks 0GA6 `DualSituation`s for `B`, one for each thickness and each
  Ext-exponent, exactly as the library's Stacks 0GAQ carries one for each thickness.
* `d`, `q₀`, `k`, `hd`, `hq₀`, `hk` — the invariants of Stacks 0GA6 of `B`, independent of the
  thickness and of the exponent, with `k + 1 = D = max(d, 1)`.
* `hdual` — the open duality input of Stacks 0GAC, which Stacks 0GAQ carries for every level
  `m ≥ n`, here carried for every level and every exponent since `n` is chosen inside the proof.
* `hconormal` — that for every finite type `A`-algebra `C` and every surjection
  `φ : C^∧ → B` of `A`-algebras with both `B` and `C^∧` rig-smooth over `(A, I)` a power of `I`
  annihilates `Ker(φ)/Ker(φ)²`; this is the step the source makes with the six-term sequence of
  Stacks 0ALM and the comparison `H⁰(NL^∧_{C^∧/A}) ⊗ B[1/b] = H⁰(NL^∧_{B/A}) ⊗ B[1/b]` of free
  modules of rank `r - m`, which the library does not have.  Both rig-smoothness inputs are
  discharged here: `B`'s from the Jacobian chart of the statement, `C^∧`'s from the smoothness
  of `C` away from `V(I)`.

Two further deviations, both inherited rather than assumed: the Stacks 0GAQ used here lifts only
to precision `I^{n-(2+D)c}` under `n > 2(2+D)c`, in place of the source's `I^{n-(1+d)c}` under
`n > 2(1+d)c`; and `B` is taken in the universe of `A`, which is the only case Stacks 0GAQ's
target admits.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finiteType_algEquiv_adicCompletion_of_jacobianChart
    (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, u} A I) (P : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I B)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ P.variableCount) (b : P.completedPolynomialRing)
    (f : Fin m → P.ker)
    (hvanish : B.adicIdeal ≤ (Ideal.span {P.toAlgHom b}).radical)
    (hjacobian :
      P.toAlgHom (Matrix.det fun i j : Fin m ↦
        (completedNaiveCotangentComplex B P).partialDeriv (Fin.castLE hm i)
          (f j : P.completedPolynomialRing)) ∣ P.toAlgHom b)
    (hrelations : ∀ x : P.completedPolynomialRing, x ∈ P.ker →
      b * x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j : Fin m ↦ (f j : P.completedPolynomialRing)) +
        P.ker ^ 2)
    (S : ∀ c l : ℕ, DualSituation B.carrier (I.map (algebraMap A B.carrier)) l c)
    (d q₀ k : ℕ) (hd : ∀ c l, (S c l).d = d) (hq₀ : ∀ c l, (S c l).q₀ = q₀)
    (hk : max d 1 = k + 1)
    (hdual : ∀ (c l e : ℕ) (hel : e + 2 * c = l) (hq : (S c l).q₀ ≤ e)
      (M : ANCModule (I.map (algebraMap A B.carrier)) l c)
      (ϕ : resModule (I.map (algebraMap A B.carrier)) l M.1 →ₗ[B.carrier]
        powQuot (I.map (algebraMap A B.carrier)) l l),
      ∃ s : (S c l).H M.dual 0 (e : ℤ),
        (S c l).ev M e hq s =
          (powQuotLe (I.map (algebraMap A B.carrier)) (Nat.le.intro hel)).comp ϕ)
    (hconormal : ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [Algebra.FiniteType A C]
      (ϕ : AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C →ₐ[A] B.carrier),
      Function.Surjective ϕ → IsRigSmooth B → IsRigSmooth (adicCompletionObj I (B := C)) →
        ∃ c : ℕ, I ^ c • (⊤ : Submodule A (RingHom.ker ϕ.toRingHom).Cotangent) = ⊥) :
    ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra A C),
      Algebra.FiniteType A C ∧
        Nonempty (B.carrier ≃ₐ[A] AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C)
declarations.comment: carrying, beyond the source's hypotheses: `S`, a family of Stacks 0GA6 DualSituations for B, one per thickness and per Ext-exponent, as the library's Stacks 0GAQ carries one per thickness; `d`, `q₀`, `k`, `hd`, `hq₀`, `hk`, the Stacks 0GA6 invariants of B, independent of thickness and exponent, with k+1 = D = max(d,1); `hdual`, the open duality input of Stacks 0GAC that Stacks 0GAQ carries, here for every level and exponent because n is chosen in the proof; and `hconormal`, that a power of I kills Ker(φ)/Ker(φ)² for every surjection φ from the completion of a finite type A-algebra onto B with both sides rig-smooth (both rig-smoothness inputs are discharged here), which is the source's last step by the Stacks 0ALM six-term sequence and the localized comparison H⁰(NL^∧_{C^∧/A}) ⊗ B[1/b] = H⁰(NL^∧_{B/A}) ⊗ B[1/b], absent from the library. Inherited, not assumed: the Stacks 0GAQ used lifts to precision I^{n-(2+D)c} under n > 2(2+D)c for the source's I^{n-(1+d)c}; and B is taken in A's own universe, the only case that Stacks 0GAQ's target admits

declarations.name: Rig.isRigSmooth_algebraization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GAX.** Let `I` be an ideal of a Noetherian ring `A` and let `B` be an object of the
category of Stacks 0AL4 which is rig-smooth over `(A, I)`. Then `B` is isomorphic to the `I`-adic
completion of a finite type `A`-algebra (Gabber–Zavyalov [Theorem 1.2]). This supersedes the
partial results:

1. if `A` is a G-ring, the result follows from Proposition 0GAT;
2. if `B` is rig-étale over `(A, I)`, the result follows from Lemma 0AKA;
3. if `I` is principal, the result follows from Elkik [III, Theorem 7].

The four conjuncts are, in order, the theorem
(`Rig.exists_finiteType_algEquiv_adicCompletion_of_isRigSmooth`) and the three partial results,
each proved by the route the remark names: Proposition 0GAT and Lemma 0AKA through
`Rig.exists_finiteType_adicCompletion_algEquiv_of_isRigSmooth_of_isGRing_or_isRigEtale`, and
Elkik's theorem through `Rig.exists_finiteType_adicCompletion_algEquiv_of_isRigSmooth_principal`.
In the theorem the finite type algebra lies in the universe of `A`; the partial results produce it
in the universe `max u v`, as the lemmas they follow from do.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRigSmooth_algebraization :
    (∀ {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {I : Ideal A}
        (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I), IsRigSmooth B →
        ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra A C), Algebra.FiniteType A C ∧
          Nonempty (B.carrier ≃ₐ[A] AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C)) ∧
    (∀ {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {I : Ideal A}
        (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I), IsRigSmooth B → IsGRing A →
        ∃ (C : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra A C), Algebra.FiniteType A C ∧
          Nonempty (B.carrier ≃ₐ[A] AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C)) ∧
    (∀ {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {I : Ideal A}
        (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I), IsRigSmooth B → IsRigEtale B →
        ∃ (C : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra A C), Algebra.FiniteType A C ∧
          Nonempty (B.carrier ≃ₐ[A] AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C)) ∧
    (∀ {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {I : Ideal A}
        (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I), IsRigSmooth B → I.IsPrincipal →
        ∃ (C : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra A C), Algebra.FiniteType A C ∧
          Nonempty (B.carrier ≃ₐ[A] AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C))

declarations.name: Rig.IsRigEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GAY.** An adically complete algebra of finite type modulo `I` is
rig-étale over `(A, I)` if some power of `I` acts by zero on its completed naive cotangent
complex in `D(B)`.  The condition is imposed for each completed polynomial presentation
of `B`.
declarations.statement: public abbrev IsRigEtale (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I) : Prop

declarations.name: Rig.isRigSmooth_of_isRigEtale
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0GB1.** A rig-étale adically finite type algebra over `(A, I)` is rig-smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRigSmooth_of_isRigEtale {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {I : Ideal A} (B : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u, v} A I)
    (hB : IsRigEtale B) : IsRigSmooth B

declarations.name: Rig.isRigEtale_completedBaseChangeOfIsNoetherianRing
declarations.doc:
Let `A₁ → A₂` be a map of Noetherian rings and let `Iᵢ ⊆ Aᵢ` be ideals with
`V(I₁ A₂) = V(I₂)`. Let `B₁` be adically of finite type over `(A₁, I₁)` and let
`B₂ = (B₁ ⊗_{A₁} A₂)^∧_{I₂}` be its base change as in Stacks Remark 0AL5, the functor
`Rig.completedBaseChangeOfIsNoetherianRing`. If `B₁` is rig-étale over `(A₁, I₁)`, then `B₂` is
rig-étale over `(A₂, I₂)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRigEtale_completedBaseChangeOfIsNoetherianRing
    (hV : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ((I₁.map (algebraMap A₁ A₂) : Ideal A₂) : Set A₂) =
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I₂ : Set A₂))
    (B₁ : AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.{u₁, v} A₁ I₁) (hB₁ : IsRigEtale B₁) :
    IsRigEtale ((completedBaseChangeOfIsNoetherianRing
      (exists_pos_pow_map_le_of_zeroLocus_eq hV)).functor.obj B₁)
declarations.comment: preservation of rig-étaleness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasEtaleLocalPropertyULift_isReduced_of_isSmoothULift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GB3, reducedness of the source**, for presheaves with values in a universe
`max w u` independent of the universe `u` of the schemes: a smooth morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S` whose target is reduced has reduced source.

A reduced surjective étale atlas `V` of the target and an atlas `W` of the base change of the
morphism along it form a commuting square of étale charts, so the scheme morphism `W ⟶ V` is
smooth and `W` is reduced by Stacks 033B; it is a reduced surjective étale atlas of the
source.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasEtaleLocalPropertyULift_isReduced_of_isSmoothULift
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w u)}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpaceULift.{w} B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpaceULift.{w} B S hS G)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (hf : IsSmoothULift.{w} B S hS f)
    (hred : HasEtaleLocalPropertyULift.{w} B S hS G (fun T : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsReduced T)) :
    HasEtaleLocalPropertyULift.{w} B S hS F (fun T : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsReduced T)
declarations.comment: reducedness of the source, in an arbitrary value universe

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReduced_of_flat_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
A flat surjective morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` whose source is reduced has reduced
target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReduced_of_flat_of_surjective
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (hred : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced T)) :
    HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced T)
declarations.comment: reducedness of the target under surjectivity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReduced_source_of_isSmooth
declarations.doc: A smooth morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` whose target is reduced has reduced source.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReduced_source_of_isSmooth
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsSmooth B S hS f)
    (hred : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced T)) :
    HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced T)
declarations.comment: reducedness of the source

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.isAdicStar_completedTensorProduct
declarations.doc:
The completed tensor product of two objects of `WAdm^{adic*}` over a third is again an
object of `WAdm^{adic*}`: it is adic and it has a finitely generated ideal of definition.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAdicStar_completedTensorProduct {A₀ A₁ A : Type u}
    [CommRing A₀] [TopologicalSpace A₀] [IsTopologicalRing A₀] [IsLinearTopology A₀ A₀]
    [CommRing A₁] [TopologicalSpace A₁] [IsTopologicalRing A₁] [IsLinearTopology A₁ A₁]
    [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
    [Algebra A₀ A₁] [Algebra A₀ A]
    (h₁ : IsAdicStar A₁) (hA : IsAdicStar A)
    (hc₁ : Continuous (algebraMap A₀ A₁)) (hcA : Continuous (algebraMap A₀ A)) :
    IsAdicStar (CompletedTensorProduct (R := A₀) (M := A₁) (N := A))
declarations.comment: the adic_finite clauses, assembled as membership in WAdm^{adic*}

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.isCountablyWeaklyAdmissible_completedTensorProduct
declarations.doc:
**Lemma 87.4.12 (Stacks 0GB4) on the class `WAdm^count`.** The completed tensor product of
two countably indexed weakly admissible topological rings over a third is again one: it is
weakly admissible and its fundamental system of neighbourhoods of zero is countable.

This is the well definedness that the notion of stability under base change of Stacks 0GBC
needs, and it is what the chart argument of Stacks 0GBD needs of the class beyond the
stability clause itself, in order to transport `P` along the isomorphism identifying the chart
ring of a fibre product of charts with the completed tensor product.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCountablyWeaklyAdmissible_completedTensorProduct {A₀ A₁ A : Type u}
    [CommRing A₀] [TopologicalSpace A₀] [IsTopologicalRing A₀] [IsLinearTopology A₀ A₀]
    [CommRing A₁] [TopologicalSpace A₁] [IsTopologicalRing A₁] [IsLinearTopology A₁ A₁]
    [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
    [Algebra A₀ A₁] [Algebra A₀ A]
    (h₁ : IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible A₁) (hA : IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible A) :
    IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible
      (CompletedTensorProduct (R := A₀) (M := A₁) (N := A))
declarations.comment: the weakly_admissible and countable_basis clauses, assembled as membership in WAdm^count

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.completedTensorProduct_isAdic
declarations.doc:
The completed tensor product of two pre-adic, linearly topologized algebras with finitely
generated ideals of definition is adic.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completedTensorProduct_isAdic
    {B A C : Type*} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
    [IsLinearTopology B B] [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    [IsLinearTopology A A] [CommRing C] [TopologicalSpace C] [IsTopologicalRing C]
    [IsLinearTopology C C] [Algebra B A] [Algebra B C]
    (_hBA : Continuous (algebraMap B A)) (_hBC : Continuous (algebraMap B C))
    (_hA : TopologicalRing.IsPreAdic A)
    (_hAfg : ∃ I : Ideal A, TopologicalRing.IsIdealOfDefinition I ∧ I.FG)
    (_hC : TopologicalRing.IsPreAdic C)
    (_hCfg : ∃ J : Ideal C, TopologicalRing.IsIdealOfDefinition J ∧ J.FG) :
    TopologicalRing.IsAdic (CompletedTensorProduct (R := B) (M := A) (N := C))
declarations.comment: adic_finite

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.exists_fg_ideal_of_definition
declarations.doc: The completed tensor product has a finitely generated ideal of definition.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_fg_ideal_of_definition
    {B A C : Type*} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
    [IsLinearTopology B B] [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    [IsLinearTopology A A] [CommRing C] [TopologicalSpace C] [IsTopologicalRing C]
    [IsLinearTopology C C] [Algebra B A] [Algebra B C]
    (_hBA : Continuous (algebraMap B A)) (_hBC : Continuous (algebraMap B C))
    (_hA : TopologicalRing.IsPreAdic A)

declarations.comment: adic_finite

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.completedTensorProduct_isNoetherianRing
declarations.doc:
If the induced quotient map is of finite type, the completed tensor product
of pre-adic Noetherian algebras is Noetherian.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completedTensorProduct_isNoetherianRing
    {B A C : Type*} [CommRing B] [CommRing A] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra B A] [Algebra B C]
    [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [IsLinearTopology B B]
    [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
    [TopologicalSpace C] [IsTopologicalRing C] [IsLinearTopology C C]
    (hBA : Continuous (algebraMap B A)) (hBC : Continuous (algebraMap B C))
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hA : TopologicalRing.IsPreAdic A) (hC : TopologicalRing.IsPreAdic C)
    (hFinite : ∃ h : topologicalNilradical B ≤
        (topologicalNilradical A).comap (algebraMap B A),
      (Ideal.quotientMap (topologicalNilradical A) (algebraMap B A) h).FiniteType) :
    IsNoetherianRing (CompletedTensorProduct (R := B) (M := A) (N := C))
declarations.comment: adic_noetherian

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.completedTensorProduct_isAdmissible

The completed tensor product of pre-admissible linearly topologized
algebras is admissible.

The completed tensor product of two weakly pre-admissible linearly

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.projectionKernel_isWeakIdealOfDefinition
declarations.doc:
**The projection kernel cut out by two weak ideals of definition is a weak ideal of
definition of the completed tensor product.** It is open by
`TopologicalRing.isOpen_projectionKernel`, and it consists of topologically nilpotent elements
because it is the closure of the sum of the two extended ideals.
declarations.statement:
public theorem projectionKernel_isWeakIdealOfDefinition (i : ι) (j : κ)
    (hI : TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition (I i))
    (hJ : TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition (J j)) :
    TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition
      (projectionKernel (B := B) I J bI bJ i j)
declarations.comment: the projection kernels as weak ideals of definition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isReduction_formalSpectrum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GB6.** Let `A` be a weakly admissible topological ring over `S` and let `𝔞` be
its ideal of topologically nilpotent elements, the largest weak ideal of definition of `A`.
The stage of `Spf A` at `𝔞` is `Spec (A ⧸ 𝔞)`, and its morphism to `Spf A` exhibits it as the
reduction of `Spf A`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isReduction_formalSpectrum
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    [IsLinearTopology A A] (hA : TopologicalRing.IsWeaklyAdmissible A)
    {B : BigFppfSite.{u}} {S : Scheme.{u}} {hS : B.Contains S}
    (D : QuotientSystem B S hS A) (_hB : D.HasLargeSite) :
    IsReduction B S hS (formalSpectrum D)
      ((formalSpectrumDiagram D).obj (OrderDual.toDual (TopologicalRing.nilIdx hA.1)))
      (formalSpectrumInclusion D (OrderDual.toDual (TopologicalRing.nilIdx hA.1)))
declarations.comment: the reduction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isReduction_pullback_reduction_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GB7.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` which is
representable by algebraic spaces and smooth, let `iY : Yred ⟶ Y` be a reduction of `Y` and let
`P` with projections `fst : P ⟶ X` and `snd : P ⟶ Yred` be a fibre product `X ×_Y Yred`. Then
`P`, with the projection `fst`, is a reduction of `X`: this is the assertion
`X_red = X ×_Y Y_red`.

`P` is an algebraic space by Stacks 03XY, reduced by Stacks 0GB3 applied to the base change
`snd` of `f`, and `fst` is a representable thickening because `iY` is; a morphism to `X` from a
reduced algebraic space factors uniquely through `P` because its composite with `f` factors
uniquely through `Yred`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReduction_pullback_reduction_of_smooth {X Y Yred P : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    (_hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (_hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS f.hom)
    (hsmooth : Space.HasPropertyULift.{u + 1} B S hS
      (Space.smoothPropertyULift.{u + 1} B S hS) f.hom hf)
    {iY : Yred ⟶ Y} (hiY : IsReduction B S hS Y Yred iY)
    {fst : P ⟶ X} {snd : P ⟶ Yred} (sq : IsPullback fst snd f iY) :
    IsReduction B S hS X P fst
declarations.comment: the fibre product X ×_Y Y_red is a reduction of X; read against given reductions and a given fibre product rather than chosen ones, exactly as for Stacks 0GB8. Stacks 0AIN supplies the reductions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isIso_of_isReduction_of_isPullback_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GB7.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` which is
representable by algebraic spaces and smooth, let `iX : Xred ⟶ X` and `iY : Yred ⟶ Y` be
reductions and let `P` with projections `fst` and `snd` be a fibre product `X ×_Y Yred`. Then
every morphism `Xred ⟶ P` over `X` is an isomorphism: the canonical comparison morphism
`X_red ⟶ X ×_Y Y_red` identifies the two.

`P` is a reduction of `X` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isReduction_pullback_reduction_of_smooth`, and two reductions of
`X` are isomorphic over `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_of_isReduction_of_isPullback_of_smooth {X Y Xred Yred P : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS f.hom)
    (hsmooth : Space.HasPropertyULift.{u + 1} B S hS
      (Space.smoothPropertyULift.{u + 1} B S hS) f.hom hf)
    {iX : Xred ⟶ X} (hiX : IsReduction B S hS X Xred iX)
    {iY : Yred ⟶ Y} (hiY : IsReduction B S hS Y Yred iY)
    {fst : P ⟶ X} {snd : P ⟶ Yred} (sq : IsPullback fst snd f iY)
    {g : Xred ⟶ P} (hg : g ≫ fst = iX) : IsIso g
declarations.comment: the comparison morphism X_red ⟶ X ×_Y Y_red over X is an isomorphism; read against given reductions and a given fibre product rather than chosen ones, exactly as for Stacks 0GB8. Stacks 0AIN supplies the reductions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyULift_isSurjectiveULift_iff_isSurjectiveULift_red
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GB8.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` which is
representable by algebraic spaces, let `iX : Xred ⟶ X` and `iY : Yred ⟶ Y` be reductions and let
`fred : Xred ⟶ Yred` be compatible with `f`. Then `f` is surjective in the sense of Stacks 03XZ
if and only if `fred` is a surjective morphism of algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyULift_isSurjectiveULift_iff_isSurjectiveULift_red
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    (_hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (_hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    {Xred Yred : FppfSheaf B S hS} {iX : Xred ⟶ X} {iY : Yred ⟶ Y}
    (hiX : IsReduction B S hS X Xred iX) (hiY : IsReduction B S hS Y Yred iY)
    {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS f.hom)
    {fred : Xred ⟶ Yred} (hfred : fred ≫ iY = iX ≫ f) :
    Space.HasPropertyULift.{u + 1} B S hS
        (fun _ _ g ↦ Space.IsSurjectiveULift.{u + 1} B S hS g.hom) f.hom hf ↔
      Space.IsSurjectiveULift.{u + 1} B S hS fred.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isReduction_completionSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GB9.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S` and let `T ⊆ |X|` be a closed
subset. The reduction of the completion `X_{/T}` of `X` along `T` is the reduced induced
closed subspace `Z` of `X` supported on `T`: the canonical morphism `Z ⟶ X_{/T}` exhibits `Z`
as the reduction of `X_{/T}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReduction_completionSheaf :
    IsReduction B S hS (Space.completionSheaf B S hS X T)
      (reducedClosedSubsetSheaf B S hS hX T hT)
      (reducedClosedSubsetToCompletionSheaf B S hS hX T hT)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isAdicStar_completionSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBA (1).** Let `X = Spec A` be an affine scheme over `S` in the big fppf site and
let `T ⊆ |X|` be a closed subset whose complement is quasi-compact, that is a constructible
closed subset. Then the completion `X_{/T}` is an adic\* affine formal algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAdicStar_completionSheaf
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS (yoneda.obj (affineOver B S hS hA f))))
    (hT : @IsClosed _
      (Space.pointTopology B S hS (yoneda.obj (affineOver B S hS hA f))) T)
    (hqc : @IsCompact _
      (Space.pointTopology B S hS (yoneda.obj (affineOver B S hS hA f))) Tᶜ) :
    IsAdicStar B S hS
      (Space.completionSheaf B S hS (yoneda.obj (affineOver B S hS hA f)) T)
declarations.comment: adic*

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isNoetherian_completionSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBA (3).** Let `X = Spec A` be a Noetherian affine scheme over `S` in the big
fppf site and let `T ⊆ |X|` be a closed subset. Then the completion `X_{/T}` is a Noetherian
affine formal algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNoetherian_completionSheaf [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS (yoneda.obj (affineOver B S hS hA f))))
    (hT : @IsClosed _
      (Space.pointTopology B S hS (yoneda.obj (affineOver B S hS hA f))) T) :
    IsNoetherian B S hS
      (Space.completionSheaf B S hS (yoneda.obj (affineOver B S hS hA f)) T)
declarations.comment: Noetherian

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isIso_completionComparison_adicQuotientSystem
declarations.doc:
Let `X = Spec A` be an affine scheme over `S` in the big fppf site and let `T = V(I)` for a
finitely generated ideal `I ⊆ A`. Then the canonical comparison `Spf (A^∧) ⟶ X_{/T}` is an
isomorphism, for the presentation `adicQuotientSystem` of the `I`-adic completion `A^∧`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_completionComparison_adicQuotientSystem (hA : B.Contains (Spec (.of A)))
    (f : Spec (.of A) ⟶ S) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    IsIso (completionComparison B S hS hA f I (adicQuotientSystem B S hS hA f I hI)
      (quotientSystemCompatible_adicQuotientSystem B S hS hA f I hI))
declarations.comment: formal spectrum, for the constructed quotient-system presentation `AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.adicQuotientSystem` of the completion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isIso_completionComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBA (2).** Let `X = Spec A` be an affine scheme over `S` in the big fppf site
and let `T = V(I)` be the zero locus of a finitely generated ideal `I ⊆ A`. Then the
canonical comparison from the formal spectrum of the `I`-adic completion of `A` to the
completion of `X` along `T` is an isomorphism, so `X_{/T} = Spf (A^∧)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_completionComparison
    (hI : I.FG)
    (D : AdicQuotientSystem B S hS I)
    (hD : QuotientSystemCompatible B S hS f I D) :
    IsIso (completionComparison B S hS hA f I D hD)
declarations.comment: formal spectrum

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isLocallyCountablyIndexed_pullback'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBB, clause (1).** If `X` and `Z` are locally countably indexed, then so is
`X ×_Y Z`. The hypotheses `hPaff` and `hcover` are the inputs of the source which the
library does not carry; the implication (2) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0AKX, which the other four clauses
carry as `h0AKX`, is a theorem at countable indexing and is discharged here, as is
separatedness of the chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyCountablyIndexed_pullback' {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS X) (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Z)
    (hPaff : AffineChartFibreProductStable B S hS (IsCountablyIndexed B S hS))
    (hcover : HasChartPullbackCover B S hS f g) :
    IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS (pullback f g)
declarations.comment: clause (1), locally countably indexed; the affine case (0AN3 with 0GB4) and the 0AIM covering condition for the chart cover are named hypotheses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isLocallyCountablyIndexed_pullback_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBB, clause (1).** If `X` and `Z` are locally countably indexed, then so is
`X ×_Y Z`. The hypotheses are exactly the source's.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyCountablyIndexed_pullback_unconditional {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS X) (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Z) :
    IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS (pullback f g)
declarations.comment: clause (1), locally countably indexed, in full under the source's hypotheses. The affine case (0AN3 with 0GB4) is `affineChartFibreProductStable_isCountablyIndexed`; the 0AIS set-theoretic condition for X ×_Y Z is `satisfiesSetTheoreticCondition_pullback_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace'`, from 0AIP; the 0AIM covering condition for the chart cover is `isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_chartPullbackMap`; Stacks 0AKX (2) implies (1) is `AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasAffineEtaleChartProperty_iff_hasAffineEtaleAtlasWithProperty_isCountablyIndexed`; and the étale case of Stacks 0AJ3 is `isFormalAlgebraicSpace_pullback_of_isRepresentableEtale`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isLocallyCountablyIndexedAndClassical_pullback_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBB, clause (2).** If `X` and `Z` are locally countably indexed and classical, then
so is `X ×_Y Z`. The hypotheses are exactly the source's.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyCountablyIndexedAndClassical_pullback_unconditional {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y) (hX : IsLocallyCountablyIndexedAndClassical B S hS X)
    (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyCountablyIndexedAndClassical B S hS Z) :
    IsLocallyCountablyIndexedAndClassical B S hS (pullback f g)
declarations.comment: clause (2), locally countably indexed and classical, in full under the source's hypotheses. The affine case (0AN3 with 0GB4) is `affineChartFibreProductStable_isCountablyIndexedAndClassical`; the 0AIS set-theoretic condition for X ×_Y Z is `satisfiesSetTheoreticCondition_pullback_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace'`, from 0AIP; the 0AIM covering condition for the chart cover is `isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_chartPullbackMap`; Stacks 0AKX (2) implies (1) is `hasAffineEtaleChartProperty_iff_atlas_isCountablyIndexedAndClassical_unconditional`; and the étale case of Stacks 0AJ3 is `isFormalAlgebraicSpace_pullback_of_isRepresentableEtale`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isLocallyWeaklyAdic_pullback_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBB, clause (3).** If `X` and `Z` are locally weakly adic, then so is `X ×_Y Z`. The
hypotheses are exactly the source's.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyWeaklyAdic_pullback_unconditional {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)

    (hX : IsLocallyWeaklyAdic B S hS X) (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyWeaklyAdic B S hS Z) :
    IsLocallyWeaklyAdic B S hS (pullback f g)
declarations.comment: clause (3), locally weakly adic, in full under the source's hypotheses. The affine case (0AN3 with 0GXJ) is `affineChartFibreProductStable_isWeaklyAdic`; the 0AIS set-theoretic condition for X ×_Y Z is `satisfiesSetTheoreticCondition_pullback_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace'`, from 0AIP; the 0AIM covering condition for the chart cover is `isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_chartPullbackMap`; Stacks 0AKX (2) implies (1) is `hasAffineEtaleChartProperty_iff_atlas_isWeaklyAdic_unconditional`; and the étale case of Stacks 0AJ3 is `isFormalAlgebraicSpace_pullback_of_isRepresentableEtale`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isLocallyAdicStar_pullback_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBB, clause (4).** If `X` and `Z` are locally adic\*, then so is `X ×_Y Z`. The
hypotheses are exactly the source's.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyAdicStar_pullback_unconditional {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS X) (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS Z) :

declarations.comment: clause (4), locally adic*, in full under the source's hypotheses. The affine case (0AN3 with 0GB4) is `affineChartFibreProductStable_isAdicStar`; the 0AIS set-theoretic condition for X ×_Y Z is `satisfiesSetTheoreticCondition_pullback_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace'`, from 0AIP; the 0AIM covering condition for the chart cover is `isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_chartPullbackMap`; Stacks 0AKX (2) implies (1) is `hasAffineEtaleChartProperty_iff_atlas_isAdicStar_unconditional`; and the étale case of Stacks 0AJ3 is `isFormalAlgebraicSpace_pullback_of_isRepresentableEtale`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isLocallyNoetherian_pullback_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBB, clause (5).** If `X` and `Z` are locally Noetherian and `X_red ⟶ Y_red` is
locally of finite type, then `X ×_Y Z` is locally Noetherian.

`hfin` is the source's own hypothesis on the reduction morphism, and the hypotheses are exactly
the source's.

The affine case is relative to the chart map,
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.AffineChartFibreProductStableRel`: the map-blind
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.AffineChartFibreProductStable`, which the other four clauses
prove, is *unsatisfiable* at `P := IsNoetherian`: it asserts that every fibre product of
Noetherian affine formal algebraic spaces over an affine formal algebraic space is Noetherian,
which is false in every big fppf site over a nonempty base. Take a point of `S` with residue field
`k` and `K = k(x₁, x₂, …)`; then `Spec k` and `Spec K` are affine objects of the site, hence affine
formal algebraic spaces by
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isAffineFormalAlgebraicSpace_sheafifiedYoneda'`, and `Spec K` is
Noetherian — its presenting ring `K` is discrete, hence Noetherian, complete and adic with ideal of
definition `(0)`. The sheafified Yoneda embedding preserves fibre products on this subcanonical
site, so `Spec K ×_{Spec k} Spec K = Spec (K ⊗_k K)`, whose presenting ring is `K ⊗_k K`; that
ring is not Noetherian, and by
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.exists_continuous_ringEquiv_of_isPresentingRing` the presenting
ring is unique up to isomorphism of topological rings, so no Noetherian one presents it. A
registration of this clause on the map-blind affine case would be vacuously true.

The passage from the chart map to the morphism into the shrunk base of the affine case transports
nothing along the monomorphism of the shrink: reduction is not invariant along an arbitrary
monomorphism, `AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isReduction_completionSheaf` being a
counterexample.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyNoetherian_pullback_unconditional {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS X) (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS Z)
    (hfin : HasLocallyOfFiniteTypeReduction B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS (pullback f g)
declarations.comment: clause (5), locally Noetherian, in full under the source's hypotheses. The affine case (0AN3 with 0GB4) is `affineChartFibreProductStable_isNoetherian`, the affine case RELATIVE TO THE CHART MAP: the map-blind form is unsatisfiable at IsNoetherian -- it quantifies over all affine U, V, W with no condition on the maps, which is false for Spec K over Spec k with K/k of infinite transcendence degree, the presenting ring of the fibre product being the non-Noetherian K tensor K -- so a registration on it would have been vacuous. The docstring gives that witness. The source's finite type condition on the reductions, hfin, is carried to the chart maps by `hasLocallyOfFiniteTypeReduction_chart` and from there to `algebraMap C A` by the affine dictionary `chartPropertyIsFiniteTypeOnReductions`. The 0AIS set-theoretic condition for X ×_Y Z is `satisfiesSetTheoreticCondition_pullback_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace'`, from 0AIP; the 0AIM covering condition for the chart cover is `isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_chartPullbackMap`; Stacks 0AKX (2) implies (1) is `hasAffineEtaleChartProperty_iff_atlas_isNoetherian_unconditional`; and the étale case of Stacks 0AJ3 is `isFormalAlgebraicSpace_pullback_of_isRepresentableEtale`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasProperty_pullback_snd_of_isLocallyCountablyIndexed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBD.** Let `S` be a scheme. Let `P` be a local property of morphisms of
`WAdm^count` which is stable under base change. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Z ⟶ Y` be morphisms of
locally countably indexed formal algebraic spaces over `S`. If `f` satisfies the equivalent
conditions of Stacks 0ANG, then so does `pr₂ : X ×_Y Z ⟶ Z`.

`P` being local in the sense of Situation 0CBA is `TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocal P`, which
`TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChange P` (Stacks 0GBC) contains, together with the
invariance under isomorphism of source and target with which Situation 0CBA opens, `hsrc` and
`htgt`. The conditions of Stacks 0ANG for `f` are equivalent by
`hasProperty_tfae_of_isLocallyCountablyIndexed`, and `hf` is condition (1). The conclusion is
that `X ×_Y Z` is locally countably indexed (Stacks 0GBB, clause (1)), so that the conditions
of Stacks 0ANG are equivalent for `pr₂`, and that `pr₂` satisfies all three of them.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasProperty_pullback_snd_of_isLocallyCountablyIndexed
    (P : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [TopologicalSpace R₁] [IsTopologicalRing R₁]
      [CommRing R₂] [TopologicalSpace R₂] [IsTopologicalRing R₂], (R₁ →+* R₂) → Prop)
    (hP : TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChange.{u} P)
    (hsrc : PropertyIsInvariantUnderSourceIso.{u}
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P)
    (htgt : PropertyIsInvariantUnderTargetIsoOn.{u}
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P)
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Z)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P f) :
    IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS (pullback f g) ∧
      HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P
        (pullback.snd f g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P
        (pullback.snd f g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P
        (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasProperty_tfae_pullback_snd_of_isLocalUpToIso_of_isLocallyCountablyIndexed
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme. Let `P` be a local property of morphisms of `WAdm^count` which is
stable under base change. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Z ⟶ Y` be morphisms of locally countably
indexed formal algebraic spaces over `S`. If `f` satisfies one, hence all, of the equivalent
conditions of Stacks 0ANG, then `X ×_Y Z` is locally countably indexed, the conditions of Stacks
0ANG are equivalent for `pr₂ : X ×_Y Z ⟶ Z`, and `pr₂` satisfies all three of them.

    (P : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [TopologicalSpace R₁] [IsTopologicalRing R₁]
      [CommRing R₂] [TopologicalSpace R₂] [IsTopologicalRing R₂], (R₁ →+* R₂) → Prop)
    (hloc : TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocalUpToIso.{u} P)
    (hP : TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChange.{u} P)
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Z)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
        TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P f ∨
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P f ∨
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P f) :
    IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS (pullback f g) ∧
      List.TFAE
        [ HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
            TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P (pullback.snd f g),
          HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P
            (pullback.snd f g),
          HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P
            (pullback.snd f g) ] ∧
      HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P
        (pullback.snd f g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P
        (pullback.snd f g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P
        (pullback.snd f g)

conditions of Stacks 0ANG make sense for `pr₂ : X ×_Y Z ⟶ Z`, and `pr₂` satisfies all three of
