declarations.name: TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderBaseChangeAdicStar
declarations.doc:
A local property `P` of morphisms of `WAdm^{adic*}` is *stable under base change* when,
for every pair of morphisms `B → A` and `B → C` of `WAdm^{adic*}`, `P (B → A)` implies
`P (C → A ⊗̂_B C)`.

`WAdm^{adic*}` is the full subcategory of `WAdm` whose objects are the adic, hence complete and
separated, topological rings possessing a finitely generated ideal of definition, and the
locality of `P` is `TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocalAdicStar`, read in the same subcategory. That
`A ⊗̂_B C` lies in `WAdm^{adic*}` is `TopologicalRing.isAdicStar_completedTensorProduct`.

This agrees with `TopologicalRing.AdicStarPropertyIsStableUnderBaseChange`, by
`TopologicalRing.adicStarPropertyIsStableUnderBaseChange_iff`.
declarations.statement:
public structure PropertyIsStableUnderBaseChangeAdicStar
    (P : ∀ {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
      [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A], (B →+* A) → Prop) : Prop
declarations.comment: the first half, the definition of stability under base change, at the source's class of rings: the morphisms range over WAdm^{adic*}, the adic topological rings -- hence complete and separated -- possessing a finitely generated ideal of definition, and the locality of P is read in the same subcategory by TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocalAdicStar. The well definedness the remark cites, that the completed tensor product is again an object of WAdm^{adic*} by Lemma 87.4.12, is TopologicalRing.isAdicStar_completedTensorProduct

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_pullback_snd_of_stableBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBF**, the variant of Stacks 0GBD for locally Noetherian formal algebraic
spaces: let `P` be stable under base change for Noetherian adic topological rings in the sense
of Stacks 0GBF. If `f : X ⟶ Y` satisfies condition (1) of Stacks 0ANG for `P`, then for every
`g : Z ⟶ Y` the second projection `X ×_Y Z ⟶ Z` satisfies condition (1) for `P`.

Nothing is asked of `g`, exactly as the definition of Stacks 0GBF imposes no condition on the
morphism being based along: stability under base change is stability under base change by the
property that holds of every morphism, and that property is local, so the statement is the one
of Stacks 0GBG with `Q` instantiated there.

The three further hypotheses are those the Stacks 0GBG statements already carry, for the same
reasons: `hcover` is the geometric input of Stacks 0GBD, `h31` the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of
Stacks 0ANG, and `hiso` the invariance of `P` under isomorphism of targets.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_pullback_snd_of_stableBaseChange
    (P : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [TopologicalSpace R₁] [IsTopologicalRing R₁]
      [CommRing R₂] [TopologicalSpace R₂] [IsTopologicalRing R₂], (R₁ →+* R₂) → Prop)
    (hP : TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeNoetherian.{u} P)
    (hiso : PropertyIsInvariantUnderTargetIso.{u} P)
    (h31 : SourceCoverImpliesEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P)
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hcover : HasBaseChangeCoverOverPullbackSnd B S hS f g)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P f) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: the 0GBD variant for locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.conditions_pullback_snd_of_isStableUnderBaseChangeNoetherian
declarations.doc:
The variant of Stacks 0GBD for locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces. Let `P` be a local
property of morphisms of `WAdm^{Noeth}` (Remark 0ANI) which is stable under base change: given
`B → A` and `B → C` in `WAdm^{Noeth}`, `P (B → A)` implies that `A ⊗̂_B C` is adic Noetherian and
that `P (C → A ⊗̂_B C)` holds (`TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeNoetherian`, the definition
of the remark). Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Z ⟶ Y` be morphisms of locally Noetherian formal algebraic
spaces over `S`. If `f` satisfies the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0ANG, then so does
`pr₂ : X ×_Y Z ⟶ Z`; all three of them are concluded.

Being local in the sense of Remark 0ANI is `hP.isLocal` together with `hPiso`, the invariance
of `P` under isomorphism of source and target that Situation 0CBA assumes. Nothing is asked of
`g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem conditions_pullback_snd_of_isStableUnderBaseChangeNoetherian
    (P : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [TopologicalSpace R₁] [IsTopologicalRing R₁]
      [CommRing R₂] [TopologicalSpace R₂] [IsTopologicalRing R₂], (R₁ →+* R₂) → Prop)
    (hP : TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeNoetherian.{u} P)
    (hPiso : ∀ {B A B' A' : Type u}
      [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [IsLinearTopology B B]
      [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
      [CommRing B'] [TopologicalSpace B'] [IsTopologicalRing B'] [IsLinearTopology B' B']
      [CommRing A'] [TopologicalSpace A'] [IsTopologicalRing A'] [IsLinearTopology A' A']
      (eB : B ≃+* B') (eA : A ≃+* A'), Continuous eB → Continuous eB.symm →
      Continuous eA → Continuous eA.symm → ∀ (f : B →+* A), Continuous f →
      TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic B → TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic A →
      TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic B' → TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic A' →
      (P f ↔ P ((eA.toRingHom.comp f).comp eB.symm.toRingHom)))
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS Z)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P f) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P
        (pullback.snd f g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P (pullback.snd f g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: the variant of Stacks 0GBD for morphisms between locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces; the definition of stability under base change is TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeNoetherian

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeNoetherian
declarations.doc:
A local property `P` of morphisms of Noetherian adic topological rings is *stable under
base change* when, for every pair of continuous homomorphisms `B →+* A` and `B →+* C` of such
rings, `P (B →+* A)` forces the completed tensor product `A ⊗̂_B C` to be adic Noetherian again
and `P` to hold for `C →+* A ⊗̂_B C`. No condition is imposed on `B →+* C`.
declarations.statement:
public structure IsStableUnderBaseChangeNoetherian
    (P : ∀ {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
      [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A], (B →+* A) → Prop) : Prop
declarations.comment: the definition of stability under base change; not the 0GBD variant for spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyAfterSourceCover_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBG**, in the form that the argument of Stacks 0GBD produces: if `P` is stable
under base change by `Q` and `f : X ⟶ Y`, `g : Z ⟶ Y` satisfy condition (1) of Stacks 0ANG for
`P` and for `Q`, then the second projection `X ×_Y Z ⟶ Z` satisfies condition (3) of Stacks
0ANG for `P`.

The covering of `X ×_Y Z` by fibre products of charts, with the presentation of those fibre
products by completed tensor products, is the hypothesis `hcover`; it mentions neither `P` nor
`Q`. The isomorphism invariance of `P` implied by the locality of Stacks 0ANI is `hiso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyAfterSourceCover_pullback_snd
    (P Q : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [TopologicalSpace R₁] [IsTopologicalRing R₁]
      [CommRing R₂] [TopologicalSpace R₂] [IsTopologicalRing R₂], (R₁ →+* R₂) → Prop)
    (hPQ : TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeBy.{u} P Q)
    (hiso : PropertyIsInvariantUnderTargetIso.{u} P)
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hcover : HasBaseChangeCoverOverPullbackSnd B S hS f g)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P f)
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) Q g) :
    HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS
      (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: condition (3) for pr₂, with the 0GBD cover and iso-invariance assumed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBG.** Let `P` be stable under base change by `Q` for Noetherian adic
topological rings. If `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Z ⟶ Y` are morphisms of locally Noetherian formal
algebraic spaces over `S` satisfying condition (1) of Stacks 0ANG for `P` and for `Q`
respectively, then the second projection `X ×_Y Z ⟶ Z` satisfies condition (1) for `P`.

Condition (3) is what the argument of Stacks 0GBD gives; the passage back to condition (1) is
the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0ANG, carried as the hypothesis `h31`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_pullback_snd
    (P Q : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [TopologicalSpace R₁] [IsTopologicalRing R₁]
      [CommRing R₂] [TopologicalSpace R₂] [IsTopologicalRing R₂], (R₁ →+* R₂) → Prop)
    (hPQ : TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeBy.{u} P Q)
    (hiso : PropertyIsInvariantUnderTargetIso.{u} P)
    (h31 : SourceCoverImpliesEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P)
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hcover : HasBaseChangeCoverOverPullbackSnd B S hS f g)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P f)
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) Q g) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: condition (1) for pr₂, with the 0GBD cover, 0ANG (3) ⟹ (1) and iso-invariance

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.transfersBaseChangeOnAffineEtaleDiagrams
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBG**, uniformly over all pairs of properties: whenever `P` is stable under base
change by `Q` for Noetherian adic topological rings, condition (1) of Stacks 0ANG transfers
from `(f, P)` and `(g, Q)` to `(X ×_Y Z ⟶ Z, P)`.

The three inputs of the single-pair statement are asked of every property local in the sense
of Stacks 0ANI, which is how the stability bundle of Stacks 0GBG supplies locality, and of
every pair of morphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem transfersBaseChangeOnAffineEtaleDiagrams
    (hiso : ∀ P : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [TopologicalSpace R₁] [IsTopologicalRing R₁]
        [CommRing R₂] [TopologicalSpace R₂] [IsTopologicalRing R₂], (R₁ →+* R₂) → Prop,
      TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocalNoetherian.{u} P → PropertyIsInvariantUnderTargetIso.{u} P)
    (h31 : ∀ P : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [TopologicalSpace R₁] [IsTopologicalRing R₁]
        [CommRing R₂] [TopologicalSpace R₂] [IsTopologicalRing R₂], (R₁ →+* R₂) → Prop,
      TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocalNoetherian.{u} P →
        SourceCoverImpliesEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
          (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P)
    (hcover : ∀ {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y),
      HasBaseChangeCoverOverPullbackSnd B S hS f g) :
    ∀ (P Q : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [TopologicalSpace R₁] [IsTopologicalRing R₁]
        [CommRing R₂] [TopologicalSpace R₂] [IsTopologicalRing R₂], (R₁ →+* R₂) → Prop),
      TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeBy.{u} P Q →
      ∀ {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y),
        HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
            (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P f →
          HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
              (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) Q g →
            HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
              (fun R ↦ TopologicalRing.IsAdic R ∧ IsNoetherianRing R) P (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: the transfer for every property pair, on the same three hypotheses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.conditions_pullback_snd_of_isStableUnderBaseChangeBy
declarations.doc:
Let `P` and `Q` be local properties of morphisms of `WAdm^{Noeth}` (Remark 0ANI), with `P`
stable under base change by `Q`: given `B → A` and `B → C` in `WAdm^{Noeth}` with `P (B → A)` and
`Q (B → C)`, the completed tensor product `A ⊗̂_B C` is adic Noetherian and `P (C → A ⊗̂_B C)`
holds (`TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeBy`). Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Z ⟶ Y` be morphisms
of locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces over `S` such that the equivalent conditions of
Stacks 0ANG hold for `f` and `P` and for `g` and `Q`. Then the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0ANG
hold for `pr₂ : X ×_Y Z ⟶ Z` and `P`; all three of them are concluded.

Being local in the sense of Remark 0ANI is `hPQ.isLocalP` together with `hPiso`, the invariance
of `P` under isomorphism of source and target that Situation 0CBA assumes of a property of
arrows of the category.
declarations.statement:
theorem conditions_pullback_snd_of_isStableUnderBaseChangeBy
    (P Q : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [TopologicalSpace R₁] [IsTopologicalRing R₁]
      [CommRing R₂] [TopologicalSpace R₂] [IsTopologicalRing R₂], (R₁ →+* R₂) → Prop)
    (hPQ : TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeBy.{u} P Q)
    (hPiso : ∀ {B A B' A' : Type u}
      [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [IsLinearTopology B B]
      [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
      [CommRing B'] [TopologicalSpace B'] [IsTopologicalRing B'] [IsLinearTopology B' B']
      [CommRing A'] [TopologicalSpace A'] [IsTopologicalRing A'] [IsLinearTopology A' A']
      (eB : B ≃+* B') (eA : A ≃+* A'), Continuous eB → Continuous eB.symm →
      Continuous eA → Continuous eA.symm → ∀ (f : B →+* A), Continuous f →
      TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic B → TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic A →
      TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic B' → TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic A' →
      (P f ↔ P ((eA.toRingHom.comp f).comp eB.symm.toRingHom)))
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS Z)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P f)
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic Q g) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P
        (pullback.snd f g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P (pullback.snd f g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: the statement drawn there: the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0ANG pass from f and P and from g and Q to the second projection of X ×_Y Z and P, for locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces; the notion of stability under base change by Q is TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeBy

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChangeBy

A local morphism property of Noetherian adic rings is stable under completed
tensor-product base change along morphisms satisfying another local property.
declarations.statement:
public structure IsStableUnderBaseChangeBy (P Q : ∀ {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B]
    [IsTopologicalRing B] [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A],
    (B →+* A) → Prop) : Prop
declarations.comment: stable_under_base_change_by_noetherian

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderComposition
declarations.doc:
A local property of morphisms of countably indexed weakly admissible rings is
stable under composition when two composable morphisms with the property have a
composite with the property.
declarations.statement:
public structure PropertyIsStableUnderComposition
    (P : ∀ {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [CommRing A]
    [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A], (B →+* A) → Prop) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBI.** Let `P` be a local property of arrows of the class `C` which is stable
under composition. If `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` are morphisms of formal algebraic spaces over
`S` satisfying the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0ANG for `P`, then so does `g ∘ f`.

Condition (3) is what the covering of the proof gives; the passage back to condition (1) is the
implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0ANG, carried as the hypothesis `h31`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_comp
    (hchart : ChartPropertyIsStableUnderComposition B S hS C P)
    (h31 : SourceCoverImpliesEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS C P)
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hZ : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z)
    (hpbg : HasFormalAlgebraicSpaceChartPullbacks B S hS g)
    (hpbf : HasFormalAlgebraicSpaceChartPullbacks B S hS f)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS C P f)
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS C P g) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS C P (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: condition (1) for the composite, granting the composition axiom of Situation 0GBH read on charts through Stacks 0AN0 (hchart), the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0ANG (h31) and the fibre products of Stacks 0AJ3 (hpbf, hpbg)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_comp_of_isLocallyCountablyIndexed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBI.** Let `P` be a local property of morphisms of `WAdm^{count}` which is stable
under composition, and let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of locally countably
indexed formal algebraic spaces over `S`. If `f` and `g` satisfy the equivalent conditions of
Stacks 0ANG, then so does `g ∘ f`: the conclusion lists all three of them. Being a local
property in the sense of Situation 0CBA is `hP.isLocal` together with `hPiso`, the invariance of
`P` under isomorphism of source and target that the situation assumes.

The covering of the proof is
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.exists_affineEtaleCover_chartFactorization_comp_of_atlas`, built
on the countably indexed atlas of `Y`; its intermediate charts are countably indexed by clause
(1) of Stacks 0AKQ, hence presented by rings of `WAdm^{count}` (Stacks 0AN1), and the
composition axiom applies through Stacks 0AN0. That gives condition (3) for `g ∘ f`; condition
(1) follows by the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0ANG, from the presented refinement of a
covering of the source and the locality of `P`, and condition (2) by (1) ⟹ (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_comp_of_isLocallyCountablyIndexed
    (hP : TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderComposition P)
    (hPiso : ∀ {B A B' A' : Type u}
      [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [IsLinearTopology B B]
      [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
      [CommRing B'] [TopologicalSpace B'] [IsTopologicalRing B'] [IsLinearTopology B' B']
      [CommRing A'] [TopologicalSpace A'] [IsTopologicalRing A'] [IsLinearTopology A' A']
      (eB : B ≃+* B') (eA : A ≃+* A'), Continuous eB → Continuous eB.symm →
      Continuous eA → Continuous eA.symm → ∀ (f : B →+* A), Continuous f →
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible B →
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible A →
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible B' →
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible A' →
      (P f ↔ P ((eA.toRingHom.comp f).comp eB.symm.toRingHom)))
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hX : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Z)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P f)
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P g) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
        TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P (f ≫ g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS
        TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P (f ≫ g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS
        TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_comp_of_isLocallyAdicStar
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBJ, second half: the variant of Lemma 0GBI for locally adic\* formal algebraic
spaces.** Let `P` be a local property of morphisms of `WAdm^{adic*}` (Remark 0ANH) which is
stable under composition in the sense of the first half of Remark 0GBJ,
`TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionAdicStar`. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be
morphisms of locally adic\* formal algebraic spaces over `S`. If `f` and `g` satisfy the
equivalent conditions of Stacks 0ANG for `P` (in the adic\* reading of Remark 0ANH) — here
condition (1), that `P` holds on every affine étale diagram, the strongest of the three — then
so does `g ∘ f`: the conclusion lists all three conditions.

Condition (1) for `g ∘ f` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_comp_of_isLocal` at the
class `WAdm^{adic*}`: every affine formal algebraic space representable étale over `Y` is adic\*
by the implication (2) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0AKX, hence presented by a ring of `WAdm^{adic*}`.
Conditions (2) and (3) follow by the implications (1) ⟹ (2) ⟹ (3) of Stacks 0ANG. The
invariance of `P` under isomorphism of source and target, which Situation 0CBA stipulates, is
not needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_comp_of_isLocallyAdicStar
    (hP : TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionAdicStar.{u} P)
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hX : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS Z)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar P f)
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar P g) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar P (f ≫ g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar P (f ≫ g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar P (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: the second half, the variant of Lemma 0GBI for morphisms between locally adic* formal algebraic spaces: for a local property P of morphisms of WAdm^{adic*} (Remark 0ANH) which is stable under composition in the sense of the first half, TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionAdicStar, and morphisms f : X -> Y, g : Y -> Z of locally adic* formal algebraic spaces satisfying the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0ANG (condition (1)), the composite g o f satisfies all three; the invariance of P under isomorphism of Situation 0CBA is not used

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.AdicStarPropertyIsStableUnderComposition
declarations.doc:
A local property of morphisms of weakly admissible adic-star rings is stable
under composition if it is preserved by composition of continuous maps between
such rings.
declarations.statement:
public structure AdicStarPropertyIsStableUnderComposition
    (P : ∀ {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [CommRing A]
      [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A], (B →+* A) → Prop) : Prop
declarations.comment: stable_under_composition_for_adic_ring_map_properties

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionAdicStar
declarations.doc:
A local property `P` of morphisms of `WAdm^{adic*}` is *stable under composition* when,
for morphisms `B → A` and `C → B` of `WAdm^{adic*}`, `P (B → A)` and `P (C → B)` imply
`P (C → A)`.

`WAdm^{adic*}` is the full subcategory of `WAdm` whose objects are the adic, hence complete and
separated, topological rings possessing a finitely generated ideal of definition, and the
locality of `P` is `TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocalAdicStar`, read in the same subcategory.

This agrees with `TopologicalRing.AdicStarPropertyIsStableUnderComposition`, by
`TopologicalRing.adicStarPropertyIsStableUnderComposition_iff`.
declarations.statement:
public structure PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionAdicStar
    (P : ∀ {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [CommRing A]
      [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A], (B →+* A) → Prop) : Prop
declarations.comment: the definition of stability under composition, at the source's class of rings: the morphisms range over WAdm^{adic*}, the adic topological rings -- hence complete and separated -- possessing a finitely generated ideal of definition, and the locality of P is read in the same subcategory by TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocalAdicStar

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_comp_of_isLocallyNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBK.** A local property `P` of morphisms of `WAdm^{Noeth}` is *stable under
composition* when `P(B → A) ∧ P(C → B) ⟹ P(C → A)` for arrows of `WAdm^{Noeth}`: that is the
structure `TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionNoetherian`, whose `isLocal` field
together with `hPiso` (invariance under isomorphism of source and target, assumed by Situation
0CBA and hence by Remark 0ANI) make `P` local. The variant of Stacks 0GBI then holds for
morphisms between locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces: if `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z`
satisfy the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0ANG for `P` on `WAdm^{Noeth}`, so does `g ∘ f`, and
the conclusion lists all three of them.

The covering is
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.exists_presentedSourceCover_comp_of_atlas` built on the
Noetherian atlases of `X`, `Y` and `Z`: its charts stay Noetherian along representable étale
maps by clause (5) of Stacks 0AKQ and are then presented by their presenting rings, which are
Noetherian and adic, so the composition axiom applies through Stacks 0AN0 and gives condition
(3) on a covering with presented members. The implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0ANG on such a
covering is
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_of_presentedSourceCover`,
at the class `WAdm^{Noeth}`, whose closure conditions are clauses of Stacks 0ANB; condition (2)
follows by (1) ⟹ (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_comp_of_isLocallyNoetherian
    (hP : TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionNoetherian P)
    (hPiso : ∀ {B A B' A' : Type u}
      [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [IsLinearTopology B B]
      [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
      [CommRing B'] [TopologicalSpace B'] [IsTopologicalRing B'] [IsLinearTopology B' B']
      [CommRing A'] [TopologicalSpace A'] [IsTopologicalRing A'] [IsLinearTopology A' A']
      (eB : B ≃+* B') (eA : A ≃+* A'), Continuous eB → Continuous eB.symm →
      Continuous eA → Continuous eA.symm → ∀ (f : B →+* A), Continuous f →
      TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic B → TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic A →
      TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic B' → TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic A' →
      (P f ↔ P ((eA.toRingHom.comp f).comp eB.symm.toRingHom)))
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hX : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS Z)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P f)
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P g) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P (f ≫ g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P (f ≫ g) ∧
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: the variant of Stacks 0GBI for morphisms between locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces; the definition of stability under composition is TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionNoetherian

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionNoetherian

A local property of morphisms of Noetherian adic rings is stable under composition

declarations.comment: stable_under_composition_noetherian

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocalWithCancellation
declarations.doc:
A local property of morphisms of countably indexed weakly admissible rings with
the cancellation property for composable morphisms.

    (P : ∀ {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [CommRing A]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_of_comp_of_isLocallyCountablyIndexed
declarations.doc:
Let `P` be a local property of morphisms of `WAdmᶜᵒᵘⁿᵗ` which has the cancellation
property, and let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of locally countably indexed formal
algebraic spaces over `S`. If `g ∘ f` and `g` satisfy `HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram`,
then `f` satisfies `HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram`, `HasPropertyAfterTargetCover` and
`HasPropertyAfterSourceCover`.

Here `P` being local with the cancellation property is `hP` (the three axioms and the
cancellation property) together with `hPiso`, the clause that `P` is "invariant under isomorphism
of source and target in this category".
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_of_comp_of_isLocallyCountablyIndexed
    (hP : TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocalWithCancellation P)
    (hPiso : ∀ {B A B' A' : Type u}
      [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [IsLinearTopology B B]
      [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
      [CommRing B'] [TopologicalSpace B'] [IsTopologicalRing B'] [IsLinearTopology B' B']
      [CommRing A'] [TopologicalSpace A'] [IsTopologicalRing A'] [IsLinearTopology A' A']
      (eB : B ≃+* B') (eA : A ≃+* A'), Continuous eB → Continuous eB.symm →
      Continuous eA → Continuous eA.symm → ∀ (f : B →+* A), Continuous f →
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible B →
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible A →
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible B' →
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible A' →
      (P f ↔ P ((eA.toRingHom.comp f).comp eB.symm.toRingHom)))
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hX : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Z)
    (hfg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P (f ≫ g))
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
      TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P g) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
        TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P f ∧
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P f ∧
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible P f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBM.** Let `P` be a local property of arrows of the class `C` with the
cancellation property. If `g ∘ f` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` satisfy the equivalent conditions of Stacks
0ANG for `P`, then so does `f : X ⟶ Y`.

Condition (3) is what the covering of the proof gives; the passage back to condition (1) is the
implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0ANG, carried as the hypothesis `h31`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_of_comp
    (hchart : ChartPropertyHasCancellation B S hS C P)
    (h31 : SourceCoverImpliesEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS C P)
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hZ : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z)
    (hpbg : HasFormalAlgebraicSpaceChartPullbacks B S hS g)
    (hpbf : HasFormalAlgebraicSpaceChartPullbacks B S hS f)
    (hfg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS C P (f ≫ g))
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS C P g) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS C P f
declarations.comment: condition (1) for the first factor, granting the cancellation axiom of Situation 0GBL read on charts through Stacks 0AN0 (hchart), the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0ANG (h31) and the fibre products of Stacks 0AJ3 (hpbf, hpbg)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_of_comp_of_isLocallyAdicStar
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBN, second half: the cancellation variant for locally adic\* formal algebraic
spaces.** Let `P` be a local property of morphisms of `WAdm^{adic*}` in the sense of Remark
0ANH, `hP`: a property of arrows of `WAdm^{adic*}` invariant under isomorphism of source and
target in that category and satisfying the three axioms of Situation 0CBA there. Suppose `P`
has the cancellation property of the first half of the remark, `hcancel`: for `B → A` and
`C → B` in `WAdm^{adic*}`, `P(C → A) ∧ P(C → B) ⟹ P(B → A)`. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and
`g : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of locally adic\* formal algebraic
spaces over `S`. If `g ∘ f` and `g` satisfy the equivalent conditions of
Stacks 0ANG for `P` at `WAdm^{adic*}` — here condition (1), which is equivalent to the other two
by the second half of Stacks 0ANH — then so does `f`; the conclusion lists all three.

The proof is that of Stacks 0GBM: on the covering `Uᵢ ⟶ Vᵢ ⟶ Wᵢ` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyAfterSourceCover_of_comp_of_atlas`, built on adic\*
atlases of `X`, `Y`, `Z`, the maps `Vᵢ ⟶ Wᵢ` and `Uᵢ ⟶ Wᵢ` correspond to arrows `C → B` and
`C → A` of `WAdm^{adic*}` with `P`, so `Uᵢ ⟶ Vᵢ`, corresponding to `B → A`, has `P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_of_comp_of_isLocallyAdicStar
    (hP : TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocal'.{u} P TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar)
    (hcancel : TopologicalRing.HasAdicStarCancellationProperty.{u} P)
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hX : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS Z)
    (hfg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar P (f ≫ g))
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar P g) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar P f ∧
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar P f ∧
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar P f
declarations.comment: the second half: the variant of Lemma 0GBM (the remark's Lemma 0GBI is a slip for 0GBM, an erratum to the Stacks Project) for morphisms f : X -> Y, g : Y -> Z between locally adic* formal algebraic spaces over S, for a local property P of WAdm^{adic*} (Remark 0ANH: invariant under isomorphism of source and target and satisfying the three axioms of Situation 0CBA) having the cancellation property TopologicalRing.HasAdicStarCancellationProperty: if g o f and g satisfy the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0ANG then so does f

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.HasAdicStarCancellationProperty
declarations.doc:
**Cancellation for a morphism property of `WAdm^{adic*}`** (Stacks 0GBN).  Given arrows
`f : B →+* A` and `g : C →+* B` of `WAdm^{adic*}` — continuous homomorphisms of weakly
admissible topological rings each carrying the adic topology of a finitely generated ideal —
the property of the composite `C → A` and the property of `C → B` together imply the property
of `B → A`.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev HasAdicStarCancellationProperty
    (P : ∀ {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [CommRing A]
      [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A], (B →+* A) → Prop) : Prop
declarations.comment: the cancellation property

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_of_comp_of_isLocallyNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBP.** Let `P` be a local property of morphisms of `WAdm^{Noeth}` in the sense of
Remark 0ANI: it satisfies the three axioms of Situation 0CBA for morphisms of `WAdm^{Noeth}`,
which is `hP`, and is invariant under isomorphism of source and target, which Situation 0CBA
assumes and is `hPiso`. Suppose `P` has the *cancellation property*: for arrows `B → A` and
`C → B` of `WAdm^{Noeth}`, `P(C → B) ∧ P(C → A) ⟹ P(B → A)`, which is `hcancel`. Then the
variant of Stacks 0GBM holds for morphisms between locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces:
if `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` are such that `g ∘ f` and `g` satisfy the equivalent conditions
of Stacks 0ANG for `P` on `WAdm^{Noeth}`, so does `f`, and the conclusion lists all three of
them.

The covering is the one of the proof of Stacks 0GBM,
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.exists_presentedSourceCover_of_comp_of_atlas`, built on the
Noetherian atlases of `X`, `Y` and `Z`: its charts stay Noetherian along representable étale
maps by clause (5) of Stacks 0AKQ and are presented by their presenting rings, which are
Noetherian and adic, so the cancellation property applies through Stacks 0AN0 and gives
condition (3) for `f` on a covering with presented members. The implication (3) ⟹ (1) of
Stacks 0ANG on such a covering is
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_of_presentedSourceCover`,
at the class `WAdm^{Noeth}`; condition (2) follows by (1) ⟹ (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram_of_comp_of_isLocallyNoetherian
    (hP : TopologicalRing.PropertyIsLocalNoetherian.{u} P)
    (hcancel : TopologicalRing.HasNoetherianCancellationProperty.{u} P)
    (hPiso : TopologicalRing.IsomorphismInvariant.{u} P
      (fun R _ _ _ _ ↦ TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic R))
    {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hX : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS Z)
    (hfg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P
      (f ≫ g))
    (hg : HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P g) :
    HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P f ∧
      HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P f ∧
      HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic P f
declarations.comment: the variant of Stacks 0GBM for morphisms between locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces; the definition of the cancellation property is TopologicalRing.HasNoetherianCancellationProperty

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.HasNoetherianCancellationProperty
declarations.doc: Cancellation for a morphism property on Noetherian adic topological rings.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev HasNoetherianCancellationProperty
    (P : ∀ {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [CommRing A]
    [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A], (B →+* A) → Prop) : Prop
declarations.comment: noetherian_cancellation_property

declarations.name: RingHom.IsAdic
declarations.doc:
A ring homomorphism `φ : A →+* B` is adic if some ideal defining the
topology of `A` extends along `φ` to an ideal defining the topology of `B`.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsAdic {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B] (φ : A →+* B) : Prop

declarations.name: RingHom.isTaut_of_isAdic
declarations.doc: A continuous adic homomorphism of linearly topologized rings is taut.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isTaut_of_isAdic
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    [IsLinearTopology A A] [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
    [IsLinearTopology B B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : Continuous φ) (hAdic : RingHom.IsAdic φ) :
    RingHom.IsTaut φ
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: RingHom.isAdic_iff_isTaut
declarations.doc:
Adicness and tautness are equivalent for a continuous homomorphism from a linearly
topologized ring with a finitely generated ideal of definition to a complete separated linearly
topologized ring. In particular, this applies to morphisms in `WAdm^{adic*}`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isAdic_iff_isTaut
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    [IsLinearTopology A A] [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
    [IsLinearTopology B B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : Continuous φ)
    (hA : ∃ I : Ideal A, I.FG ∧ _root_.IsAdic I)
    [@CompleteSpace B (IsTopologicalAddGroup.rightUniformSpace B)] [T2Space B] :
    RingHom.IsAdic φ ↔ RingHom.IsTaut φ
declarations.comment: on WAdm^{adic*}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsProper.of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBT.** A base change of a proper morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` is
proper: representability by algebraic spaces is stable under base change, and so is the Bootstrap
condition of Stacks 03XZ, properness of morphisms of algebraic spaces being invariant under
isomorphism.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.existsUnique_algebraization_of_adic_into_completion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBU.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S` and `T` a closed
set of points of `X` whose complementary open subspace has quasi-compact inclusion into `X`.
Let `R` be a Noetherian complete local `S`-algebra whose spectrum lies in the site, equipped
with a quotient system whose weak ideals of definition are cofinal among the powers of the
maximal ideal. Then an adic morphism `p : Spf R ⟶ X_{/T}` into the completion of `X` along
`T` admits a unique algebraization: a unique morphism `g : Spec R ⟶ X` restricting on
`Spf R` to the composite `Spf R ⟶ X_{/T} ⟶ X` and satisfying `g⁻¹(T) = {𝔪}`.

The existence and uniqueness of the algebraization are the two halves of **Stacks 0AQH**,
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.bijective_map_into_algebraicSpace`. The inclusion
`{𝔪} ⊆ g⁻¹(T)` of the fibre condition is
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.pointsMap_mem_of_pointsToScheme_eq_closedPoint` and the reverse
inclusion `g⁻¹(T) ⊆ {𝔪}` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.preimageSubsetClosedPoint_of_comp_eq`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_algebraization_of_adic_into_completion
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R]
    (hR : IsNoetherianCompleteLocalRing R)
    (D : QuotientSystem B S hS R)
    (hD₁ : ∀ J : { I : Ideal R // TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition I },
      ∃ n : ℕ, (@IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R _ hR.isLocal) ^ n ≤ J.1)
    (hD : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ J : { I : Ideal R // TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition I },
      J.1 ≤ (@IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R _ hR.isLocal) ^ n)
    (hRS : B.Contains (Spec (.of R))) (q : Spec (.of R) ⟶ S)
    (hq : ∀ J : { I : Ideal R // TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition I },
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J.1)) ≫ q = D.overS J)
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS X))
    (hT : @IsClosed _ (Space.pointTopology B S hS X) T)
    (_hTqc : letI : TopologicalSpace (Space.points B S hS X) := Space.pointTopology B S hS X
      Space.IsQuasiCompact B S hS
        ((Space.openSubspacesOrderIso B S hS X hX).symm ⟨Tᶜ, hT.isOpen_compl⟩).1.ι)
    (P : formalSpectrum D ⟶ Space.completionSheaf B S hS X T)
    (hPadic : Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS P.hom) :
    ∃! g : (Sheaf.sheafifiedYoneda (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)).obj
        ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj (specOver hRS q)) ⟶ upliftedSheaf X hX,
      formalSpectrumToSpec D hRS q hq ≫ g = P ≫ completionToUpliftedSheaf X hX T ∧
        PreimageEqClosedPoint hR T hRS q
          (Sheaf.sectionEquiv (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) g).down
declarations.comment: The algebraization, its existence and uniqueness, and both inclusions of its fibre condition g⁻¹(T) = {𝔪}, the second of them by Krull's intersection theorem.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.adicCompletionHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBU.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S` and `T` a closed set of
points of `X` whose complementary open subspace has quasi-compact inclusion into `X`. Let `R` be
a Noetherian complete local `S`-algebra whose spectrum lies in the site, equipped with a
quotient system whose weak ideals of definition are cofinal among the powers of the maximal
ideal `𝔪`. Then the adic morphisms `p : Spf R ⟶ X_{/T}` correspond bijectively to the morphisms
`g : Spec R ⟶ X` with `g⁻¹(T) = {𝔪}`.

The bijection sends `p` to the unique `g` restricting on `Spf R` to `p` followed by
`X_{/T} ⟶ X` (`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.existsUnique_algebraization_of_adic_into_completion`),
and its inverse sends `g` to `AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.adicOfAlgebraization`; the
correspondence is characterised by
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.adicCompletionHomEquiv_apply_eq_iff`.
declarations.statement:
def adicCompletionHomEquiv
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R]
    (hR : IsNoetherianCompleteLocalRing R)
    (D : QuotientSystem B S hS R)
    (hD₁ : ∀ J : { I : Ideal R // TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition I },
      ∃ n : ℕ, (@IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R _ hR.isLocal) ^ n ≤ J.1)
    (hD : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ J : { I : Ideal R // TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition I },
      J.1 ≤ (@IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R _ hR.isLocal) ^ n)
    (hRS : B.Contains (Spec (.of R))) (q : Spec (.of R) ⟶ S)
    (hq : ∀ J : { I : Ideal R // TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition I },
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J.1)) ≫ q = D.overS J)
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS X))
    (hT : @IsClosed _ (Space.pointTopology B S hS X) T)
    (hTqc : letI : TopologicalSpace (Space.points B S hS X) := Space.pointTopology B S hS X
      Space.IsQuasiCompact B S hS
        ((Space.openSubspacesOrderIso B S hS X hX).symm ⟨Tᶜ, hT.isOpen_compl⟩).1.ι) :
    { p : formalSpectrum D ⟶ Space.completionSheaf B S hS X T //
        Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS p.hom } ≃
      { g : (Sheaf.sheafifiedYoneda (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)).obj
          ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj (specOver hRS q)) ⟶ upliftedSheaf X hX //
        PreimageEqClosedPoint hR T hRS q
          (Sheaf.sectionEquiv (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) g).down }
declarations.comment: The bijection between adic morphisms Spf R ⟶ X_{/T} and morphisms g : Spec R ⟶ X with g⁻¹(T) = {𝔪}.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.adicCompletionHomEquiv_apply_eq_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBU, the correspondence.** The bijection `adicCompletionHomEquiv` sends an adic
`p : Spf R ⟶ X_{/T}` to `g : Spec R ⟶ X` with `g⁻¹(T) = {𝔪}` exactly when `g` restricts on
`Spf R` to `p` followed by `X_{/T} ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem adicCompletionHomEquiv_apply_eq_iff
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R]
    (hR : IsNoetherianCompleteLocalRing R)
    (D : QuotientSystem B S hS R)
    (hD₁ : ∀ J : { I : Ideal R // TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition I },
      ∃ n : ℕ, (@IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R _ hR.isLocal) ^ n ≤ J.1)
    (hD : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ J : { I : Ideal R // TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition I },
      J.1 ≤ (@IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R _ hR.isLocal) ^ n)
    (hRS : B.Contains (Spec (.of R))) (q : Spec (.of R) ⟶ S)
    (hq : ∀ J : { I : Ideal R // TopologicalRing.IsWeakIdealOfDefinition I },
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J.1)) ≫ q = D.overS J)
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS X))
    (hT : @IsClosed _ (Space.pointTopology B S hS X) T)
    (hTqc : letI : TopologicalSpace (Space.points B S hS X) := Space.pointTopology B S hS X
      Space.IsQuasiCompact B S hS
        ((Space.openSubspacesOrderIso B S hS X hX).symm ⟨Tᶜ, hT.isOpen_compl⟩).1.ι)
    (p : { p : formalSpectrum D ⟶ Space.completionSheaf B S hS X T //
        Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS p.hom })
    (g : { g : (Sheaf.sheafifiedYoneda (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)).obj
          ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj (specOver hRS q)) ⟶ upliftedSheaf X hX //
        PreimageEqClosedPoint hR T hRS q
          (Sheaf.sectionEquiv (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) g).down }) :
    adicCompletionHomEquiv hR D hD₁ hD hRS q hq X hX T hT hTqc p = g ↔
      formalSpectrumToSpec D hRS q hq ≫ g.1 = p.1 ≫ completionToUpliftedSheaf X hX T
declarations.comment: The bijection is the correspondence: p ↦ g exactly when g restricts on Spf R to p followed by X_{/T} ⟶ X.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasPropertyOnAffineChartMap_adicStar_iff
declarations.doc:
**The equivalence of conditions (1) and (2) of Stacks 0GBW, read on charts.** Let
`t : U ⟶ V` be a map of affine formal algebraic spaces over `S` all of whose presenting
topological rings are adic\*. Then `t` corresponds to an adic, topologically of finite type
arrow of `WAdm^{adic*}` exactly when it corresponds to a taut, topologically of finite type
arrow of `WAdm^{count}`.

The two conditions quantify over different classes of presentations, so neither inclusion is
formal: the condition for countably indexed weakly admissible rings quantifies over strictly
more presentations, since an adic\* ring is countably indexed weakly admissible, and the
hypotheses `hU` and `hV` are what make the two ranges of quantification agree. On a single
presentation the two properties of the arrow are identified by Stacks 0GBW.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnAffineChartMap_adicStar_iff {U V : FppfSheaf B S hS} (t : U ⟶ V)
    (hU : ∀ (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalRing R]
      [IsLinearTopology R R] (E : QuotientSystem B S hS R), (U ≅ formalSpectrum E) →
      TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar R)
    (hV : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
      [IsLinearTopology A A] (D : QuotientSystem B S hS A), (V ≅ formalSpectrum D) →
      TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar A) :
    HasPropertyOnAffineChartMap B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar
        TopologicalRing.IsAdicTopologicallyOfFiniteTypeHom t ↔
      HasPropertyOnAffineChartMap B S hS TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible
        TopologicalRing.IsTautTopologicallyOfFiniteTypeHom t
declarations.comment: the equivalence of conditions (1) and (2), read on a map of affine formal algebraic spaces whose presenting rings are all adic*

declarations.name: Rig.adicFiniteType_tfae
declarations.doc: The eight characterizations of an adic morphism of topologically finite type.
declarations.statement:
public theorem adicFiniteType_tfae (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : Continuous φ)
    (hA : TopologicalRing.IsAdic A) (hB : TopologicalRing.IsAdic B)
    (hAfg : ∃ I : Ideal A, TopologicalRing.IsIdealOfDefinition I ∧ I.FG)
    (hBfg : ∃ J : Ideal B, TopologicalRing.IsIdealOfDefinition J ∧ J.FG) :
    List.TFAE [
      RingHom.IsAdic φ ∧ TopologicalRing.IsTopologicallyOfFiniteType φ,
      RingHom.IsTaut φ ∧ TopologicalRing.IsTopologicallyOfFiniteType φ,
      FiniteTypeModuloSomeIdealOfDefinition φ,
      FiniteTypeModuloEveryIdealOfDefinition φ,
      FiniteTypeAdicAlgebraForSomeIdeal φ,
      FiniteTypeAdicAlgebraForEveryIdeal φ,
    TopologicalRing.HasRestrictedPowerSeriesPresentation φ,
      HasCompletedPolynomialPresentation φ]
declarations.comment: equivalent_conditions

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.adicTopologicallyFiniteType_isLocal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBW.** Being adic and topologically of finite type is a local property of
morphisms of weakly admissible adic-star rings: it ascends along completed étale localization
diagrams, descends along faithfully flat ones, and is preserved by finite products of
targets.
declarations.comment: local_property

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.adicTopologicallyFiniteType_isomorphismInvariant
declarations.doc:
Being adic and topologically of finite type is independent of the presentations of the source
and the target.
declarations.comment: local_property

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.adicTopologicallyFiniteType_isLocal'
declarations.doc:
Being adic and topologically of finite type is a local property of morphisms of weakly
admissible adic-star rings: it is independent of the presentations of the source and the target,
ascends along completed étale localization diagrams, descends along faithfully flat ones, and is
preserved by finite products of targets.
declarations.comment: local_property

declarations.name: Rig.nonempty_restrictedNaiveCotangentComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 88.14.3 (Tag 0GBX).** For a presentation
`B = A{x₁, …, x_r} / J` of `B` as a topological `A`-algebra, the completed naive cotangent
complex `NL^∧_{B/A} = (J / J² → ⨁ i, B dxᵢ)` exists: the formal partial derivatives of
`A{x₁, …, x_r}` exist, and the differential sending the class of a restricted power series
`g ∈ J` to the tuple of its formal partial derivatives is well defined. Since
`RestrictedNaiveCotangentComplex P` is a subsingleton, this determines the complex.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_restrictedNaiveCotangentComplex
    (P : RestrictedPowerSeriesPresentation A B) :
    Nonempty (RestrictedNaiveCotangentComplex P)

declarations.name: Rig.nonempty_restrictedPowerSeriesPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GBX.** An arrow of `WAdm^{adic*}` which is adic and topologically
of finite type can be written as `B = A{x₁, …, x_r} / J`, so that the construction applies to
it. This is condition (7) of Lemma 0GBW.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_restrictedPowerSeriesPresentation
    (hcont : Continuous (algebraMap A B))
    (hA : TopologicalRing.IsAdic A) (hB : TopologicalRing.IsAdic B)
    (hAfg : ∃ I : Ideal A, TopologicalRing.IsIdealOfDefinition I ∧ I.FG)
    (hBfg : ∃ J : Ideal B, TopologicalRing.IsIdealOfDefinition J ∧ J.FG)
    (hadic : _root_.RingHom.IsAdic (algebraMap A B))
    (hft : TopologicalRing.IsTopologicallyOfFiniteType (algebraMap A B)) :
    Nonempty (RestrictedPowerSeriesPresentation A B)
declarations.comment: every adic, topologically finite type arrow has a presentation

declarations.name: Rig.exists_noetherianPresentationComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GBX.** When `A` is Noetherian and `I` is an ideal of definition for
its topology, the complex of Tag 0GBX reproduces the completed naive cotangent complex of
`B` over `(A, I)` defined by Equation 0AJR.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_noetherianPresentationComparison
    {I : Ideal A} (_hI : TopologicalRing.IsIdealOfDefinition I) (hIadic : _root_.IsAdic I)
    {C : Type v} [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [TopologicalSpace C] [IsTopologicalRing C]
    [IsLinearTopology C C]
    (hc : IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C)
    [Algebra.FiniteType (A ⧸ I) (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A C))]
    (P : RestrictedPowerSeriesPresentation A C) :
    ∃ Q : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I (AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.of C hc),
      Nonempty (NoetherianPresentationComparison (restrictedNaiveCotangentComplex P) hc Q)
declarations.comment: agreement with Equation 0AJR

declarations.name: Rig.nonempty_homotopyEquiv_of_idealOfDefinition
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GBX.** For `A` an adic Noetherian topological ring, the completed
naive cotangent complex of Equation 0AJR is independent of the choice of the ideal of
definition `I ⊆ A`: both are the complex of Tag 0GBX, which is built from the topology of `A`
alone.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_homotopyEquiv_of_idealOfDefinition
    {I I' : Ideal A}
    (hI : TopologicalRing.IsIdealOfDefinition I) (hIadic : _root_.IsAdic I)
    (hI' : TopologicalRing.IsIdealOfDefinition I') (hIadic' : _root_.IsAdic I')
    {C : Type v} [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [TopologicalSpace C] [IsTopologicalRing C]
    [IsLinearTopology C C]
    (hc : IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap A C)) C)
    [Algebra.FiniteType (A ⧸ I) (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A C))]
    (hc' : IsAdicComplete (I'.map (algebraMap A C)) C)
    [Algebra.FiniteType (A ⧸ I') (C ⧸ I'.map (algebraMap A C))]
    (P : RestrictedPowerSeriesPresentation A C)
    (Q : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I (AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.of C hc))
    (Q' : CompletedPolynomialPresentation I' (AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.of C hc')) :
    Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv
      (Rig.completedNaiveCotangentComplex (AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.of C hc) Q).cochainComplex
      (Rig.completedNaiveCotangentComplex
        (AdicFiniteTypeAlgebra.of C hc') Q').cochainComplex)
declarations.comment: independence of the ideal of definition

declarations.name: Rig.exists_restrictedPresentationComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GBX.** Any two presentations of `B` are related by a morphism of
presentations, and the map of complexes it induces is a homotopy equivalence. This is the
existence half of "the complex is well defined in `K(B)`".
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_restrictedPresentationComparison :
    Nonempty (RestrictedPresentationComparison K L)
declarations.comment: well defined in K(B)

declarations.name: Rig.homotopy_of_restrictedPresentationComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GBX.** The isomorphism in `K(B)` is *unique*: any two morphisms of
presentations induce homotopic maps of complexes. This is Step 2 of the proof of Lemma
0GAE.
declarations.statement:
public theorem homotopy_of_restrictedPresentationComparison
    (e e' : RestrictedPresentationComparison K L) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy e.equiv.hom e'.equiv.hom)
declarations.comment: unique isomorphism in K(B)

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.adicAndFiniteType_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
Adic morphisms of topologically finite type in the category of weakly admissible adic-star
rings form a local property which is stable under completed tensor-product base change.

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.adicTopologicallyFiniteType_isStableUnderComposition
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GBZ.** The local property of Stacks 0GBW — being adic and topologically of finite
type — is stable under composition on weakly admissible adic-star rings.

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.adicTopologicallyFiniteType_isStableUnderComposition'
declarations.doc:
Being adic and topologically of finite type is stable under composition on weakly admissible
adic-star rings.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isLocallyOfFiniteType_adicStar_tfae'
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of locally adic\* formal algebraic spaces over `S`, the condition
that every affine representable étale square over `f` carry an adic, topologically of finite type
arrow of `WAdm^{adic*}`, the existence of an affine étale covering of `Y` together with affine
étale coverings of the fibre products of its members with `X` on which that condition holds, the
existence of an affine étale covering of `X` whose members factor through affine representable
étale charts of `Y` by such arrows, and `f` being locally of finite type, are all equivalent,
provided chart presentations are adic\*.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_adicStar_tfae' {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS Y)
    (hchart : ChartPresentationIsAdicStar B S hS) :
    List.TFAE
      [HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar
          TopologicalRing.IsAdicTopologicallyOfFiniteTypeHom f,
        HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar
          TopologicalRing.IsAdicTopologicallyOfFiniteTypeHom f,
        HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar
          TopologicalRing.IsAdicTopologicallyOfFiniteTypeHom f,
        IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f]
declarations.comment: all four conditions, with all six equivalences proved, from one named hypothesis this library does not have: Stacks 0AKX in the adic* form of Stacks 0AKT together with Stacks 0AIC as `hchart`. The library's Stacks 0ANW is unconditional, so nothing is forwarded from it; the covering refinement of Stacks 0AJ2 and the implication (2) implies (1) of Stacks 0AKX, which used to be forwarded as `href` and `h0AKX`, are theorems. Stacks 0AJ3, the implication (4) implies (1) of Stacks 0ANL and Stacks 0ANV on countably indexed charts are no longer among them: Stacks 0AJ3 is proved for a base which is a formal algebraic space, (4) implies (1) is obtained as (4) implies (5) implies (1), and Stacks 0ANV on countably indexed charts is proved. Neither are the locality axioms of Situation 0CBA for tautness with topological finite type: they follow from the locality of Stacks 0ANU

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isLocallyOfFiniteType_tfae_of_isLocallyAdicStar
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GC0.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of locally adic\* formal algebraic spaces
over `S`. The following are equivalent:

1. for every commutative square with `U`, `V` affine formal algebraic spaces and `U ⟶ X`,
   `V ⟶ Y` representable by algebraic spaces and étale, the morphism `U ⟶ V` corresponds to an
   arrow of `WAdm^{adic*}` which is adic and topologically of finite type;
2. there are a covering `{Yⱼ ⟶ Y}` as in Definition 0AIM and for each `j` a covering
   `{Xⱼᵢ ⟶ Yⱼ ×_Y X}` as in Definition 0AIM such that each `Xⱼᵢ ⟶ Yⱼ` corresponds to an arrow
   of `WAdm^{adic*}` which is adic and topologically of finite type;
3. there are a covering `{Xᵢ ⟶ X}` as in Definition 0AIM and for each `i` a factorization
   `Xᵢ ⟶ Yᵢ ⟶ Y` where `Yᵢ` is an affine formal algebraic space, `Yᵢ ⟶ Y` is representable by
   algebraic spaces and étale, and `Xᵢ ⟶ Yᵢ` corresponds to an arrow of `WAdm^{adic*}` which
   is adic and topologically of finite type;
4. `f` is locally of finite type.

This is the source's proof. By Stacks 0AKX for the adic\* property together with Stacks 0AIC
(`chartPresentationIsAdicStarOfWeaklyAdmissible`) every weakly admissible ring presenting an
affine chart of `X` or `Y` is adic\*, so on each chart the adic, topologically of finite type
condition and the taut, topologically of finite type condition agree by Stacks 0GBW
(`hasPropertyOnAffineChartMap_adicStar_iff_of_isWeaklyAdmissible`); and Stacks 0ANW
(`isLocallyOfFiniteType_tfae'`), for the locally countably indexed spaces `X` and `Y`,
identifies the three resulting conditions with `f` being locally of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_tfae_of_isLocallyAdicStar {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyAdicStar B S hS Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar
          TopologicalRing.IsAdicTopologicallyOfFiniteTypeHom f,
        HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar
          TopologicalRing.IsAdicTopologicallyOfFiniteTypeHom f,
        HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS TopologicalRing.IsAdicStar
          TopologicalRing.IsAdicTopologicallyOfFiniteTypeHom f,
        IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f]

declarations.name: Rig.IsFiniteTypeOnReductions
declarations.doc:
A continuous homomorphism of linearly topologized commutative rings is *of finite type on
reductions* if the induced homomorphism between the quotients by their topological
nilradicals is of finite type.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsFiniteTypeOnReductions {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    [IsLinearTopology A A] [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsLinearTopology B B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : Continuous φ) : Prop
declarations.comment: finite_type_on_reductions

declarations.name: Rig.finiteTypeOnReductionsProperty_localizationPreserves
declarations.doc:
Finite type on reductions ascends along a completed étale localization diagram of countably
indexed weakly admissible rings: the first locality axiom of Situation 0CBA.
declarations.comment: localization_preserves

declarations.name: Rig.finiteTypeOnReductionsProperty_finiteProductPreserves
declarations.doc:
Finite type on reductions is preserved by a finite product of targets: the third locality
axiom of Situation 0CBA.  Topological nilpotence in a product is a coordinatewise condition, so
the reduction of the product is a quotient of the product of the reductions.
declarations.comment: finite_product

declarations.name: Rig.finiteTypeOnReductionsProperty_faithfullyFlatDescent
declarations.doc:
Finite type on reductions descends along a completed étale localization diagram of countably
indexed weakly admissible rings whose horizontal map is faithfully flat: the second locality
axiom of Situation 0CBA.  The reduced diagonal of the diagram is of finite type, being the
reduction of the canonical map into the completion of an étale algebra followed by the reduction
of the completed morphism, and finite type descends along the faithfully flat, finitely
presented reduction of the horizontal map.
declarations.comment: faithfully_flat_descent

declarations.name: Rig.isFiniteTypeOnReductions_local
declarations.doc:
Finite type on reductions is a local property of morphisms of countably indexed weakly
admissible topological rings: it ascends along completed étale localization diagrams, descends
along those whose horizontal map is faithfully flat, and is preserved by finite products of
targets.

declarations.name: Rig.isFiniteTypeOnReductions_stableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
Finite type on reductions is a local property of countably indexed weakly admissible rings
that is preserved by completed tensor-product base change.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteTypeOnReductions_stableUnderBaseChange :
    TopologicalRing.IsStableUnderBaseChange TopologicalRing.FiniteTypeOnReductionsProperty

declarations.name: Rig.finiteTypeOnReductions_isStableUnderComposition
declarations.doc:
Finite type on reductions is a composition-stable local property of morphisms of countably
indexed weakly admissible topological rings.

declarations.name: Rig.isFiniteTypeOnReductions_of_isTaut_of_isTopologicallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
A continuous taut homomorphism that is topologically of finite type is of finite type on
reductions, provided its source has a weak ideal of definition.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isFiniteTypeOnReductions_of_isTaut_of_isTopologicallyOfFiniteType
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
    [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B] [IsLinearTopology B B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : Continuous φ) (hA : TopologicalRing.IsWeaklyPreAdmissible A)
    (htaut : RingHom.IsTaut φ) (hft : TopologicalRing.IsTopologicallyOfFiniteType φ) :
    IsFiniteTypeOnReductions φ hφ

declarations.name: Rig.isTopologicallyOfFiniteType_of_isFiniteTypeOnReductions
declarations.doc:
A continuous homomorphism into a Noetherian weakly admissible topological ring that is of
finite type on reductions is topologically of finite type.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isTopologicallyOfFiniteType_of_isFiniteTypeOnReductions
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
    [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B]
    [IsTopologicalRing B] [IsLinearTopology B B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : Continuous φ) (hB : TopologicalRing.IsWeaklyAdmissible B)
    (hred : IsFiniteTypeOnReductions φ hφ) :
    TopologicalRing.IsTopologicallyOfFiniteType φ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isLocallyOfFiniteTypeOnReductions_tfae_of_isLocallyCountablyIndexed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GC7.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of locally countably indexed formal algebraic
spaces over `S` the following are equivalent:

1. every affine representable étale square over `f` has its upper map given by an arrow of
   `WAdm^{count}` with the property of Stacks 0GC2;
2. there is an affine étale covering of `Y` together with affine étale coverings of the fibre
   products of its members with `X` whose maps to the members of the first covering are given by
   such arrows;
3. there is an affine étale covering of `X` whose members factor through affine formal
   algebraic spaces representable étale over `Y` by such arrows;
4. the morphism of reductions `f_red : X_red ⟶ Y_red` is locally of finite type.

The first three are the three conditions of Stacks 0ANG for the property of Stacks 0GC2, which
is local on `WAdm^{count}`; (3) ⟹ (4) and (4) ⟹ (1) are the affine computation of Stacks 0GB6
together with the étale locality of being locally of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteTypeOnReductions_tfae_of_isLocallyCountablyIndexed
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS X) (hY : IsLocallyCountablyIndexed B S hS Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
          TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible
          TopologicalRing.FiniteTypeOnReductionsProperty f,
        HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS
          TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible
          TopologicalRing.FiniteTypeOnReductionsProperty f,
        HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS
          TopologicalRing.IsCountablyWeaklyAdmissible
          TopologicalRing.FiniteTypeOnReductionsProperty f,
        IsLocallyOfFiniteTypeOnReductions B S hS f]
declarations.comment: the four conditions, for a morphism of locally countably indexed formal algebraic spaces; condition (4) is read for every pair of reductions of the source and the target and every morphism between them over f, reductions existing and being unique up to unique isomorphism by Stacks 0AIN

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.flat_isLocalNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**Flatness is a local property of morphisms of Noetherian adic topological rings**
(Stacks 0GC9): it ascends along completed étale localization diagrams, descends along faithfully
flat ones, and is preserved by finite products of targets.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flat_isLocalNoetherian :
    PropertyIsLocalNoetherian
      (fun {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
        [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] (φ : B →+* A) ↦ φ.Flat)

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.flat_isLocalNoetherian'
declarations.doc:
**Flatness is a local property of morphisms of Noetherian adic topological rings**: it is
independent of the presentations of the source and the target, ascends along completed étale
localization diagrams, descends along faithfully flat ones, and is preserved by finite products
of targets.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flat_isLocalNoetherian' :
    PropertyIsLocalNoetherian'
      (fun {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
        [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] (φ : B →+* A) ↦ φ.Flat)

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.flat_isStableUnderBaseChangeByFiniteTypeOnReductions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GCA, part (1).** Flatness of morphisms of Noetherian adic topological rings
(Stacks 0GC9) is stable under completed tensor-product base change along morphisms of finite
type on reductions (Stacks 0GC2), in the sense of Remark 0GBG.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flat_isStableUnderBaseChangeByFiniteTypeOnReductions :
    IsStableUnderBaseChangeBy
      (fun {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
        [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] (φ : B →+* A) ↦ φ.Flat)
      FiniteTypeOnReductionsProperty
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.flatAdicFiniteType_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GCA, part (2).** Flatness (Stacks 0GC9) together with the property of Stacks
0GBW, being adic and topologically of finite type, is stable under base change in the sense of
Remark 0GBF: for continuous homomorphisms `B → A` and `B → C` of Noetherian adic topological
rings with `B → A` flat, adic and topologically of finite type, the completed tensor product
`A ⊗̂_B C` is Noetherian adic and `C → A ⊗̂_B C` is again flat, adic and topologically of finite
type. No condition is imposed on `B → C`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flatAdicFiniteType_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    IsStableUnderBaseChangeNoetherian
      (fun {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
        [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] (φ : B →+* A) ↦
        φ.Flat ∧ RingHom.IsAdic φ ∧ IsTopologicallyOfFiniteType φ)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.flat_isStableUnderBaseChangeByFiniteTypeOnReductions'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GCA, part (1).** Flatness of morphisms of Noetherian adic topological rings
(Stacks 0GC9) is stable under completed tensor-product base change along morphisms of finite
type on reductions (Stacks 0GC2), in the sense of Remark 0GBG.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flat_isStableUnderBaseChangeByFiniteTypeOnReductions' :
    IsStableUnderBaseChangeBy'
      (fun {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
        [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] (φ : B →+* A) ↦ φ.Flat)
      FiniteTypeOnReductionsProperty
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.flatAdicFiniteType_isStableUnderBaseChange'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GCA, part (2).** Flatness (Stacks 0GC9) together with the property of Stacks
0GBW, being adic and topologically of finite type, is stable under base change in the sense of
Remark 0GBF: for continuous homomorphisms `B → A` and `B → C` of Noetherian adic topological
rings with `B → A` flat, adic and topologically of finite type, the completed tensor product
`A ⊗̂_B C` is Noetherian adic and `C → A ⊗̂_B C` is again flat, adic and topologically of finite
type. No condition is imposed on `B → C`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flatAdicFiniteType_isStableUnderBaseChange' :
    IsStableUnderBaseChangeNoetherian'
      (fun {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
        [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] (φ : B →+* A) ↦
        φ.Flat ∧ RingHom.IsAdic φ ∧ IsTopologicallyOfFiniteType φ)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.flat_isStableUnderCompositionNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GCB.** Flatness, as a local property of morphisms of Noetherian adic topological
rings (Stacks 0GC9), is stable under composition: the composite of two flat ring homomorphisms
is flat.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flat_isStableUnderCompositionNoetherian :
    PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionNoetherian
      (fun {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
        [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] (φ : B →+* A) ↦ φ.Flat)

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.flat_isStableUnderCompositionNoetherian'
declarations.doc:
Flatness, as a local property of morphisms of Noetherian adic topological rings, is stable
under composition: the composite of two flat ring homomorphisms is flat.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flat_isStableUnderCompositionNoetherian' :
    PropertyIsStableUnderCompositionNoetherian'
      (fun {B A : Type u} [CommRing B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalRing B]
        [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] (φ : B →+* A) ↦ φ.Flat)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GCC.** A morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` is *flat* when every
morphism between affine, representable, étale charts of its source and target is induced by a
flat continuous homomorphism of adic Noetherian topological rings.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsFlat (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isFlat_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GCD.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces
over `S`, flatness of `f` in the sense of Definition 0GCC, the condition that every affine
representable étale square over `f` carry a flat map of Noetherian adic topological rings, the
existence of an affine étale covering of `Y` together with affine étale coverings of the fibre
products of its members with `X` on which that condition holds, and the existence of an affine
étale covering of `X` whose members factor flatly through affine representable étale charts of
`Y`, are all equivalent.

The first two conditions agree by Definition 0GCC, as in the source's own proof; the last three
are the three conditions of Stacks 0ANG for the class of Noetherian adic topological rings and
flatness, which is a local property of such arrows by Stacks 0GC9. The hypotheses `hpb`,
`href`, `hasc` and `hdesc` carry Stacks 0AJ3, the covering refinement of Stacks 0AJ2, and the
locality axioms of Situation 0CBA read through Stacks 0AN8 and Stacks 0AN9.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_tfae {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hpb : ∀ (V : FppfSheaf B S hS) (v : V ⟶ Y), IsAffineFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS V →
      IsRepresentableEtale B S hS v → IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS (pullback v f))
    (hasc : ChartPropertyAscendsAlongAffineEtale B S hS
      TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic TopologicalRing.IsFlatHom)
    (hdesc : ChartPropertyDescendsAlongFiniteAffineEtaleCover B S hS
      TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic TopologicalRing.IsFlatHom)
    (href : HasEtaleRefinementOfSourceCover B S hS f) :
    List.TFAE
      [IsFlat B S hS f,
        HasPropertyOnEveryAffineEtaleDiagram B S hS
          TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic TopologicalRing.IsFlatHom f,
        HasPropertyAfterTargetCover B S hS
          TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic TopologicalRing.IsFlatHom f,
        HasPropertyAfterSourceCover B S hS
          TopologicalRing.IsNoetherianAdic TopologicalRing.IsFlatHom f]
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (2) agree by Definition 0GCC, as the source's proof states; Stacks 0AJ3, the covering refinement of Stacks 0AJ2 and the locality axioms of Stacks 0GC9 read through Stacks 0AN8 and Stacks 0AN9 are carried as the hypotheses `hpb`, `href`, `hasc` and `hdesc`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isFlat_tfae_of_isLocallyNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GCD.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces
over `S` the following are equivalent:

1. `f` is flat in the sense of Definition 0GCC;
2. every commutative square with affine formal algebraic spaces `U`, `V` and representable
   étale maps `U ⟶ X`, `V ⟶ Y` carries a flat map of Noetherian adic topological rings on
   `U ⟶ V`;
3. there are an affine étale covering `{Yⱼ ⟶ Y}` and affine étale coverings `{Xⱼᵢ ⟶ Yⱼ ×_Y X}`
