    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})) :
    ∃ δ : (etaleAbelianDirectImageOfInverseImage.{u, v} i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ⟶
        ((extensionByZeroOfRestriction.{u, v} j).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk
        (((extensionByZeroOfRestriction.{u, v} j).mapDerivedCategoryTransToId
          (extensionByZeroAdj.{u, v} j).counit).app K)
        (((etaleAbelianDirectImageOfInverseImage.{u, v} i).mapDerivedCategoryTransFromId
          (etaleAbelianInverseImageDirectImageAdj.{u, v} i).unit).app K) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}))
declarations.comment: abelian coefficients

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_distTriang_etaleModuleExtensionByZero_directImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GKL.**  Let `X` be a scheme, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion and
let `j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion whose image is the complement of the image of `i`, and let
`Λ` be a ring.  For every object `K` of the derived category `D(X_étale, Λ)` of sheaves of
`Λ`-modules on the small étale site of `X` there is a distinguished triangle
`j_! j^{-1} K ⟶ K ⟶ i_* i^{-1} K ⟶ (j_! j^{-1} K)[1]`,
whose first arrow is the counit of `j_! ⊣ j^{-1}` and whose second arrow is the unit of
`i^{-1} ⊣ i_*`, both induced on the derived category by exactness of the four functors
involved.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distTriang_etaleModuleExtensionByZero_directImage (Λ : Type r) [Ring Λ]
    {Z U X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (hij : Set.range j.base = (Set.range i.base)ᶜ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X)]
    (K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X)) :
    ∃ δ : (etaleModuleDirectImageOfInverseImage.{u, r} Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ⟶
        ((etaleModuleExtensionByZeroOfRestriction.{u, r} Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk
        (((etaleModuleExtensionByZeroOfRestriction.{u, r} Λ j).mapDerivedCategoryTransToId
          (etaleModuleExtensionByZeroAdj.{u, r} Λ j).counit).app K)
        (((etaleModuleDirectImageOfInverseImage.{u, r} Λ i).mapDerivedCategoryTransFromId
          (etaleModuleInverseImageAdj.{u, r} Λ i).unit).app K) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_compactification_derivedLowerShriekIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GKM** for abelian étale sheaves. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a quasi-finite separated
morphism of a big étale site with `Y` quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Then `f` factors as an
open immersion `j : X ⟶ X̄` followed by a finite morphism `f̄ : X̄ ⟶ Y`, and for that
compactification the derived lower shriek `Rf_! = R f̄_* ∘ j_!` of Stacks 0F7H agrees with the
functor induced on unbounded derived categories of abelian étale sheaves by the direct image
with compact support `f_!` of Stacks 0F6R, which is the functor Stacks 0F5M derives.

Quasi-finiteness is Stacks 02NG: locally quasi-finite, locally of finite type and quasi-compact
together. No compactification is assumed; one is produced, by Zariski's main theorem
Stacks 05K0.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_compactification_derivedLowerShriekIso (B : BigEtaleSite.{u})
    {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)] [QuasiCompact (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [CompactSpace Y.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y.obj]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (AbelianSheaf.{u, u} B X)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (AbelianSheaf.{u, u} B Y)] :
    ∃ (Xbar : B.Scheme) (j : X ⟶ Xbar) (fbar : Xbar ⟶ Y)
      (_ : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)) (_ : IsFinite (B.inclusion.map fbar)),
      f = j ≫ fbar ∧ DerivedLowerShriekAgrees.{w} B j fbar
declarations.comment: abelian coefficients

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_compactification_moduleDerivedLowerShriekIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GKM** for coefficients in a ring `Λ`. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a quasi-finite separated
morphism of a big étale site with `Y` quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and let `Λ` be a ring.
Then `f` factors as an open immersion `j : X ⟶ X̄` followed by a finite morphism `f̄ : X̄ ⟶ Y`,
and for that compactification the derived lower shriek `Rf_! = R f̄_* ∘ j_!` of Stacks 0F7H
agrees with the functor `D(X_étale, Λ) ⥤ D(Y_étale, Λ)` induced by the `Λ`-linear direct image
with compact support `f_!`, which is the functor Stacks 0F5M derives.

Quasi-finiteness is Stacks 02NG: locally quasi-finite, locally of finite type and quasi-compact
together. No compactification is assumed; one is produced, by Zariski's main theorem
Stacks 05K0.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_compactification_moduleDerivedLowerShriekIso (B : BigEtaleSite.{u})
    (Λ : Type u) [Ring Λ] {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)] [QuasiCompact (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [CompactSpace Y.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y.obj]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y Λ)] :
    ∃ (Xbar : B.Scheme) (j : X ⟶ Xbar) (fbar : Xbar ⟶ Y)
      (_ : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)) (_ : IsFinite (B.inclusion.map fbar)),
      f = j ≫ fbar ∧ ModuleDerivedLowerShriekAgrees.{w} B Λ j fbar
declarations.comment: coefficients in a ring Λ, i.e. in D(X_étale, Λ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.etalePushforward_isRightDerivedFunctor_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
`R f̄_* = f̄_*`: for a finite morphism `f̄` the functor induced on unbounded derived
categories by the direct image `f̄_*` is a total right derived functor of `f̄_*`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem etalePushforward_isRightDerivedFunctor_of_isFinite :
    (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B fbar).mapDerivedCategory.IsRightDerivedFunctor
      (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B fbar).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (AbelianSheaf.{u, u} B Xbar) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
declarations.comment: R f̄_* = f̄_* for finite f̄

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_distTriang_derivedLowerShriek_mayerVietoris
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of schemes with a compactification `j : X ⟶ X̄`, so that
`Rf_! = R(f̄)_* ∘ Rj_!` is defined (`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriek` on `D⁺`,
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnbounded` on `D`), and let `U` and `V` be opens of `X`
with `X = U ∪ V`. Denote `a : U ⟶ Y`, `b : V ⟶ Y` and `c : U ∩ V ⟶ Y` the restrictions of `f`,
with the compactifications induced by `j`. Let `Λ` be a ring. For `K` in `D⁺(X_étale, Λ)`, and
also for `K` in `D(X_étale, Λ)`, there is a distinguished triangle
`Rc_!(K|_{U ∩ V}) ⟶ Ra_!(K|_U) ⊕ Rb_!(K|_V) ⟶ Rf_! K ⟶ Rc_!(K|_{U ∩ V})[1]`
in `D⁺(Y_étale, Λ)`, respectively `D(Y_étale, Λ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distTriang_derivedLowerShriek_mayerVietoris :
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X),
      ∃ (α : (derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ f) (j.restrictOpen (U ⊓ V).ι) Λ).obj
            ((etaleModuleDerivedRestriction.{u, r} Λ (U ⊓ V).ι).obj K) ⟶
          (derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} (U.ι ≫ f) (j.restrictOpen U.ι) Λ).obj
              ((etaleModuleDerivedRestriction.{u, r} Λ U.ι).obj K) ⊞
            (derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} (V.ι ≫ f) (j.restrictOpen V.ι) Λ).obj
              ((etaleModuleDerivedRestriction.{u, r} Λ V.ι).obj K))
        (β : _ ⟶ (derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} f j Λ).obj K) (γ : _ ⟶ _⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        Triangle.mk α β γ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y))) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X),
      ∃ (α : (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ f)
              (j.restrictOpen (U ⊓ V).ι) Λ).obj
            ((etaleModuleRestriction.{u, r} Λ (U ⊓ V).ι).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ⟶
          (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} (U.ι ≫ f) (j.restrictOpen U.ι) Λ).obj
              ((etaleModuleRestriction.{u, r} Λ U.ι).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ⊞
            (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} (V.ι ≫ f) (j.restrictOpen V.ι) Λ).obj
              ((etaleModuleRestriction.{u, r} Λ V.ι).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))
        (β : _ ⟶ (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).obj K) (γ : _ ⟶ _⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        Triangle.mk α β γ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y)))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_distTriang_derivedLowerShriek_openClosed
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0GKP].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of schemes, quasi-compact, with a
compactification `j : X ⟶ X̄` over `Y` (for instance `f` finite type and separated with `X` and
`Y` quasi-compact and quasi-separated), let `j_U : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion and `i : Z ⟶ X` a
closed immersion with complementary images, and let `g = f ∘ j_U` and `h = f ∘ i` be the
restrictions of `f`. Let `Λ` be a ring. Then

* for every `K` in `D⁺(X_étale, Λ)`, in particular for every `K` in `D⁺_tors(X_étale, Λ)`, and
* for every `K` in `D(X_étale, Λ)`, in particular when `Λ` is torsion,

there is a distinguished triangle `Rg_!(K|_U) ⟶ Rf_! K ⟶ Rh_!(K|_Z) ⟶ Rg_!(K|_U)[1]` in
`D⁺(Y_étale, Λ)`, respectively `D(Y_étale, Λ)`. Here `Rf_! = R f̄_* ∘ j_!` is computed through
`j`, and `Rg_!` and `Rh_!` through the compactifications `j` induces on `U` and on `Z`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.CompactificationOf.restrictOpen` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.CompactificationOf.restrictClosed`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distTriang_derivedLowerShriek_openClosed :
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X),
      ∃ (a : (derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} (jU ≫ f) (j.restrictOpen jU) Λ).obj
            ((etaleModuleRestriction.{u, r} Λ jU).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K) ⟶
          (derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} f j Λ).obj K)
        (b : (derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} f j Λ).obj K ⟶
          (derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} (i ≫ f) (j.restrictClosed i) Λ).obj
            ((etaleModuleInverseImage.{u, r} Λ i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K))
        (c : (derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} (i ≫ f) (j.restrictClosed i) Λ).obj
            ((etaleModuleInverseImage.{u, r} Λ i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K) ⟶
          ((derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} (jU ≫ f) (j.restrictOpen jU) Λ).obj
            ((etaleModuleRestriction.{u, r} Λ jU).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        Triangle.mk a b c ∈ distTriang _) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X),
      ∃ (a : (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} (jU ≫ f) (j.restrictOpen jU) Λ).obj
            ((etaleModuleRestriction.{u, r} Λ jU).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ⟶
          (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).obj K)
        (b : (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).obj K ⟶
          (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} (i ≫ f) (j.restrictClosed i) Λ).obj
            ((etaleModuleInverseImage.{u, r} Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))
        (c : (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} (i ≫ f) (j.restrictClosed i) Λ).obj
            ((etaleModuleInverseImage.{u, r} Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ⟶
          ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} (jU ≫ f) (j.restrictOpen jU) Λ).obj
            ((etaleModuleRestriction.{u, r} Λ jU).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        Triangle.mk a b c ∈ distTriang _)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.nonempty_derivedLowerShriek_inverseImage_iso_of_thickening
declarations.doc:
Let `f' : X' ⟶ Y` be a quasi-compact morphism of schemes with a compactification `j'` over
`Y` (for instance `f'` finite type and separated with `X'` and `Y` quasi-compact and
quasi-separated), let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a thickening (a surjective closed immersion, [Stacks,
Tag 04EX]) and `f = f' ∘ i`. Let `Λ` be a ring. Then

* for every `K'` in `D⁺(X'_étale, Λ)`, in particular for every `K'` in `D⁺_tors(X'_étale, Λ)`,
  `Rf_! i⁻¹ K' ≅ Rf'_! K'`, and
* for every `K'` in `D(X'_étale, Λ)`, in particular when `Λ` is torsion, `Rf_! i⁻¹ K' ≅ Rf'_! K'`.

Here `Rf'_! = R f̄'_* ∘ j'_!` is computed through `j'` and `Rf_!` through the compactification
`j'` induces on `X` (`AlgebraicGeometry.CompactificationOf.restrictClosed`).
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_derivedLowerShriek_inverseImage_iso_of_thickening :
    (∀ K' : DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X'),
      Nonempty ((derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} (i ≫ f') (j'.restrictClosed i) Λ).obj
          ((etaleModuleInverseImage.{u, r} Λ i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K') ≅
        (derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} f' j' Λ).obj K')) ∧
    (∀ K' : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X'),
      Nonempty ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} (i ≫ f') (j'.restrictClosed i) Λ).obj
          ((etaleModuleInverseImage.{u, r} Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K') ≅
        (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f' j' Λ).obj K'))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnboundedThickeningIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GKQ.** Let `f' : X' ⟶ Y` be a separated morphism of finite type of
quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes, `i : X ⟶ X'` a thickening (a closed immersion which is
surjective) and `f = f' ∘ i`. Let `Λ` be a ring. Then `Rf_! ∘ i⁻¹ ≅ Rf'_!` on `D(X'_étale, Λ)`,
hence on `D⁺_{tors}(X'_étale, Λ)` and, for `Λ` torsion, on `D(X'_étale, Λ)`. Here `Rf'_!` is
computed through a compactification `j'` of `f'` and `Rf_!` through the compactification
`j'.restrictClosed i` of `f` that `j'` induces on `X`, as for Tags 0GKN and 0GKP.

Here `Rf_! = Rf'_! ∘ Ri_! = Rf'_! ∘ i_*`
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnboundedRestrictClosedIso`), and `i⁻¹` and `i_*`
are inverse equivalences by the topological invariance of the small étale site
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isDenseSubsite_of_universalHomeomorphism`).
declarations.statement:
def derivedLowerShriekUnboundedThickeningIso :
    etaleModuleDerivedInverseImageGeneral.{u, r} Λ i ⋙
        derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} (i ≫ f') (j'.restrictClosed i) Λ ≅
      derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f' j' Λ

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.TorsionModules.module_finite_compactlySupportedCohomologyGroup
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be an algebraically closed field, `X` a separated scheme of finite type over `k` of
dimension at most one, `Λ` a Noetherian ring, and `F` a constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules on
`X_étale` which is torsion. Then `H^q_c(X, F)` is a finite `Λ`-module for every `q`.

`H^q_c(X, F)` is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.compactlySupportedCohomologyGroup` of Definition 0GJZ, the
`q`-th cohomology of `RΓ(Spec k, Rf̄_* j_! F)`, at `F` placed in degree zero; the statement holds
for every compactification `j : X ⟶ X̄` of `X` over `k`, through which it is computed.
Constructibility is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule` (Tag 03RW (3), read
on the small étale site of Tag 021B of a big étale site `B` containing `X`) and torsion is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.IsTorsionEtaleModule`.
declarations.statement:
theorem module_finite_compactlySupportedCohomologyGroup {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.obj ≤ 1)
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) (Λ : Type r) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (F : EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X.obj) (hc : IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B X Λ F)
    (ht : IsTorsionEtaleModule.{u, r} Λ X.obj F) (q : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite Λ ((compactlySupportedCohomologyGroup.{u, r} k f j Λ q).obj

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isZero_cokernel_and_isConstructible_kernel_frobeniusSemilinear_sub_id
declarations.doc:
Let `p` be a prime, let `S` be a scheme over `𝔽_p`, let `E` be a finite locally free module on
the small étale site of `S` and let `F : E ⟶ E` be a morphism of abelian sheaves with
`F (a • e) = a ^ p • F e` for local sections `a` of the structure sheaf and `e` of `E`. Then the
cokernel of `F - 1` is zero and the kernel of `F - 1` is a constructible abelian sheaf.

The kernel is read in the coefficient universe of the constructibility predicate, one above that
of `E`, through the universe lift of abelian groups.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cokernel_and_isConstructible_kernel_frobeniusSemilinear_sub_id
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (E : SheafOfModules.{u} (SmallEtale.structureSheaf B S hS))
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree E]
    (hchar : IsInCharacteristic S p)
    (F : ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (SmallEtale.structureSheaf B S hS)).obj E) ⟶
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (SmallEtale.structureSheaf B S hS)).obj E))
    (hF : ∀ (U : SmallEtale B S hS)
      (a : (SmallEtale.structureSheaf B S hS).obj.obj (op U))
      (e : E.val.obj (op U)),
      SheafOfModules.sectionsAddHom F (op U) (a • e) =
        a ^ p • SheafOfModules.sectionsAddHom F (op U) e) :
    IsZero (cokernel (F - 𝟙 _)) ∧
      IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B (B.obj S hS)
        ((sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
          (kernel (F - 𝟙 _)))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleEtaleModule_rightDerivedConstantUnit_of_isProper_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GKV.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a proper smooth morphism of schemes with
geometrically connected fibres of dimension at most `1` (the source: of dimension `1`), and let
`ℓ` be a prime number. Then `Rᵠ f_* 𝐙/ℓ𝐙` is a constructible sheaf of `𝔽_ℓ`-modules on `S_étale`
for every `q`.

The base `S` is arbitrary: the source's absolute Noetherian approximation
(`isConstructibleEtaleModule_rightDerivedConstantUnit_of_forall_isNoetherian`) reduces to a
Noetherian base, where the statement is
`isConstructibleEtaleModule_rightDerivedConstantUnit_of_isNoetherian` (both cases `ℓ` invertible
and `ℓ = 0` on `S`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleEtaleModule_rightDerivedConstantUnit_of_isProper_of_smooth
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X S : B.Scheme} (f : X.obj ⟶ S.obj) [IsProper f] [Smooth f]
    [GeometricallyConnected f] (hdim : ∀ s : S.obj, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber s) ≤ 1)
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (q : ℕ) :
    IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B S (ZMod ℓ) (rightDerivedConstantUnit f q (ZMod ℓ))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleEtaleModule_rightDerived_constantSheaf_of_isProper_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GKW.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a proper smooth morphism of schemes with
geometrically connected fibres of dimension at most `1` (the source: of dimension `1`), let `Λ`
be a Noetherian ring and let `M` be a finite `Λ`-module annihilated by an integer `n > 0`. Then
`Rᵠ f_* M` is a constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `S_étale` for every `q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleEtaleModule_rightDerived_constantSheaf_of_isProper_of_smooth
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X S : B.Scheme} (f : X.obj ⟶ S.obj) [IsProper f] [Smooth f]
    [GeometricallyConnected f] (hdim : ∀ s : S.obj, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber s) ≤ 1)
    (Λ : Type) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    (hM : Module.Finite Λ M) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hnM : ∀ m : M, n • m = 0) (q : ℕ) :
    IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B S Λ
      (((etaleModuleDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ f).rightDerived q).obj
        ((constantSheaf X.obj.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleEtaleModule_homology_derivedLowerShriek_constantSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GKX.** Let `S` be a Noetherian scheme of `B`, `f : X ⟶ S` a separated, affine,
smooth morphism of relative dimension `1`, `j` a compactification of `f` (through which
`Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ j_!`), `Λ` a Noetherian ring which is torsion (`m = 0` in `Λ` for some `m > 0`),
and `M` a finite `Λ`-module. Then every cohomology sheaf of `Rf_! M̲` is constructible. The source
also assumes `S` affine of finite dimension, which is not needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleEtaleModule_homology_derivedLowerShriek_constantSheaf
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (S : B.Scheme) [IsNoetherian S.obj] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S.obj) [IsSeparated f] [IsAffineHom f] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f]
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) (Λ : Type) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hΛ : (m : Λ) = 0) (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (hM : Module.Finite Λ M)
    (k : ℤ) :
    IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B S Λ ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ k).obj
      ((derivedLowerShriek.{u, 0} f j Λ).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))))
declarations.comment: S Noetherian (affine and finite-dimensional not needed); Rf_! through any compactification j of f; Λ torsion as m = 0 in Λ for some m > 0

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleEtaleModule_homology_derivedLowerShriek_openAffineLine
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GKY.** Let `Y` be a Noetherian affine scheme of `B`, `Λ` a Noetherian ring which is
torsion (`m = 0` in `Λ` for some `m > 0`), `ι : U ⟶ 𝔸¹_Y` an open immersion,
`f = ι ≫ (𝔸¹_Y ⟶ Y)` the structure morphism of `U`, `j` a compactification of `f`, and `F` a
finite type locally constant sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `U`. Then every cohomology sheaf of `Rf_! F`
is constructible. The source also assumes `Y` of finite dimension, which is not needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleEtaleModule_homology_derivedLowerShriek_openAffineLine
    (Y : B.Scheme) [IsNoetherian Y.obj] [IsAffine Y.obj] (U : B.Scheme)
    (ι : U.obj ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) Y.obj) [IsOpenImmersion ι]
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk (ι ≫ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) Y.obj ↘ Y.obj)))
    (Λ : Type) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hΛ : (m : Λ) = 0)
    (F : EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ U.obj)
    (hF : Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteTypeLocallyConstant Λ U.obj.smallEtaleTopology F) (k : ℤ) :
    IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B Y Λ ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ k).obj
      ((derivedLowerShriek.{u, 0} _ j Λ).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))
declarations.comment: Y Noetherian affine (finite dimension not needed); U given with an open immersion ι : U ⟶ A¹_Y; Λ torsion as m = 0 in Λ for some m > 0; Rf_! through any compactification j of f

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleEtaleModule_homology_derivedLowerShriek_affineLine
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GKZ.** Let `Y` be an affine scheme of `B`, `Λ` a Noetherian ring, `ι : X ≅ 𝔸¹_Y`,
`f = ι ≫ (𝔸¹_Y ⟶ Y)` the structure morphism, `j` a compactification of `f`, and `F` a
constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `X = 𝔸¹_Y` which is torsion. Then every cohomology sheaf of
`Rf_! F` is constructible.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleEtaleModule_homology_derivedLowerShriek_affineLine
    (Y : B.Scheme) [IsAffine Y.obj] (X : B.Scheme)
    (ι : X.obj ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) Y.obj) [IsIso ι]
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk (ι ≫ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) Y.obj ↘ Y.obj)))
    (Λ : Type) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (F : EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X.obj)
    (hF : IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B X Λ F) (ht : IsTorsionEtaleModule Λ X.obj F) (k : ℤ) :
    IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B Y Λ ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ k).obj
      ((derivedLowerShriek.{u, 0} _ j Λ).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))
declarations.comment: A¹_Y given as X with an isomorphism ι : X ≅ A¹_Y; Rf_! through any compactification j of f

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleTorsion_homology_derivedLowerShriek_of_isConstructible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GL0.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a separated morphism of finite presentation of schemes of
`B`, with `Y` quasi-compact and quasi-separated (hence so is `X`), `j` a compactification of `f`
(through which `Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ j_!`), and `Λ` a Noetherian ring.
1. If `K ∈ D⁺(X_étale, Λ)` has constructible torsion cohomology sheaves, then so has `Rf_! K`,
   i.e. `Rf_! K ∈ D⁺_{tors,c}(Y_étale, Λ)`.
2. If `Λ` is torsion and `K ∈ D(X_étale, Λ)` has constructible cohomology sheaves, so has
   `Rf_! K`, i.e. `Rf_! K ∈ D_c(Y_étale, Λ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleTorsion_homology_derivedLowerShriek_of_isConstructible
    {X Y : B.Scheme} [CompactSpace Y.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y.obj] (f : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) (Λ : Type) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] :
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X.obj),
      (∀ q : ℤ, IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B X Λ
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K) ∧
        IsTorsionEtaleModule Λ X.obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)) →
      ∀ n : ℤ, IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B Y Λ
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
            ((derivedLowerShriek.{u, 0} f j Λ).obj K)) ∧
        IsTorsionEtaleModule Λ Y.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
            ((derivedLowerShriek.{u, 0} f j Λ).obj K))) ∧
    ((∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ (m : Λ) = 0) →
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X.obj),
        (∀ q : ℤ, IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B X Λ
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)) →
        ∀ n : ℤ, IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B Y Λ ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
          ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, 0} f j Λ).obj K)))
declarations.comment: both cases: K in D+_{tors,c}(X, Λ), and K in D_c(X, Λ) when Λ is torsion (m = 0 in Λ for some m > 0; Rf_! on D(X, Λ) is derivedLowerShriekUnbounded); Rf_! through any compactification j of f

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleEtaleModule_homology_derivedLowerShriek_of_isConstructible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GL0.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a separated morphism of finite presentation of schemes of
`B`, with `Y` quasi-compact and quasi-separated (hence so is `X`), `j` a compactification of `f`
(through which `Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ j_!`), and `Λ` a Noetherian ring.
1. If `K ∈ D⁺(X_étale, Λ)` has constructible torsion cohomology sheaves, so has `Rf_! K`.
2. If `Λ` is torsion and `K ∈ D(X_étale, Λ)` has constructible cohomology sheaves, so has
   `Rf_! K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConstructibleEtaleModule_homology_derivedLowerShriek_of_isConstructible
    {X Y : B.Scheme} [CompactSpace Y.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y.obj] (f : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) (Λ : Type) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] :
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X.obj),
      (∀ q : ℤ, IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B X Λ
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K) ∧
        IsTorsionEtaleModule Λ X.obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)) →
      ∀ n : ℤ, IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B Y Λ
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).obj ((derivedLowerShriek.{u, 0} f j Λ).obj
            K))) ∧
    ((∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ (m : Λ) = 0) →
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X.obj),
        (∀ q : ℤ, IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B X Λ ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)) →
        ∀ n : ℤ, IsBigSiteConstructibleEtaleModule B Y Λ ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
          ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, 0} f j Λ).obj K)))
declarations.comment: both cases: K in D+_{tors,c}(X, Λ), and K in D_c(X, Λ) when Λ is torsion (m = 0 in Λ for some m > 0; Rf_! on D(X, Λ) is derivedLowerShriekUnbounded); Rf_! through any compactification j of f

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedTensor.ExtensionByZero.derivedTensorExtensionIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GL1.** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site, `U` an object of `C` and `j_!` extension by
zero from the localized site `C/U`. For `L` in `D(O_U)` and `K` in `D(O)`,

`j_!L ⊗^L_O K = j_!(L ⊗^L_{O_U} K|_U)`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedTensorExtensionIso (L : DerivedCategory (Modules (X.O.over U)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (Modules X.O)) :
    ((baseDerivedTensor X).tensor.obj ((extension X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj L)).obj K ≅
      (extension X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (((sliceDerivedTensor X U).tensor.obj L).obj
          ((restriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesColimit_isFiniteLocallyConstant_type
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0GL2, clause (1).** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a directed inverse system
of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms. The category of
finite locally constant sheaves of sets on `X_étale` is the colimit of the categories of finite
locally constant sheaves of sets on the `(X_i)_étale`: the comparison is faithful, full and
essentially surjective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleStagesColimit_isFiniteLocallyConstant_type (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesColimit B (Type (u + 1)) Dg c hX
      (isFiniteLocallyConstantSmallEtaleSheaf B (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesColimit_isFiniteLocallyConstant_addCommGrpCat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0GL2, clause (2).** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a directed inverse system
of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms. The category of
finite locally constant abelian sheaves on `X_étale` is the colimit of the categories of finite
locally constant abelian sheaves on the `(X_i)_étale`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleStagesColimit_isFiniteLocallyConstant_addCommGrpCat (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesColimit B AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Dg c hX
      (isFiniteLocallyConstantSmallEtaleSheaf B AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleStagesColimit_isFiniteTypeLocallyConstant_moduleCat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0GL2, clause (3).** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a directed inverse system
of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms and let `Λ` be a
commutative ring (the source assumes `Λ` Noetherian; that is not needed). The category of finite
type, locally constant sheaves of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale` is the colimit of the categories of
finite type, locally constant sheaves of `Λ`-modules on the `(X_i)_étale`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleStagesColimit_isFiniteTypeLocallyConstant_moduleCat
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (hc : IsLimit c)
    (haff : ∀ {p q : Iᵒᵖ} (e : p ⟶ q), IsAffineHom (B.inclusion.map (Dg.map e)))
    (hqc : ∀ p : I, CompactSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj)
    (hqs : ∀ p : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (Dg.obj (op p)).obj) :
    SmallEtaleStagesColimit B (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Dg c hX
      (isFiniteTypeLocallyConstantSmallEtaleSheaf B Λ)
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.derivedWeightedTraceMod_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GL3.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be locally quasi-finite morphisms, `w_f` a
weighting of `f` and `w_g` a weighting of `g`, and `Λ` a ring. For `K` in `D(Z_étale, Λ)` the
composite
`(g ∘ f)_!(g ∘ f)^{-1}K = g_! f_! f^{-1} g^{-1}K ⟶ g_! g^{-1}K ⟶ K`
of `g_! Tr_{f, w_f, g^{-1}K}` and `Tr_{g, w_g, K}` is `Tr_{g ∘ f, w_{g ∘ f}, K}`, where
`w_{g ∘ f}(x) = w_f(x) w_g(f(x))` (a weighting of `g ∘ f` by Stacks 0GK9).

The identification `(g ∘ f)_!(g ∘ f)^{-1}K = g_! f_! f^{-1} g^{-1}K` is the derived form of the
composition laws `(g ∘ f)^{-1} ≅ f^{-1} ∘ g^{-1}` of Stacks 021J and `(g ∘ f)_! ≅ g_! ∘ f_!` of
Stacks 0F6T at `Λ`-coefficients, followed by the identification of the derived functor of a
composite with the composite of the derived functors. The trace maps are those of Stacks 0GKH,
part (3).
declarations.statement:
public theorem derivedWeightedTraceMod_comp (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, v, r} B Z Λ)) :
    (fShriekMod.{u, v, r} B Λ (f ≫ g)).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((CategoryTheory.mapDerivedCategoryIsoComp (pullbackMod.{u, v, r} B Λ g)
          (pullbackMod.{u, v, r} B Λ f) (pullbackMod.{u, v, r} B Λ (f ≫ g))
          (pullbackModCompIso B Λ f g)).hom.app K) ≫
      (CategoryTheory.mapDerivedCategoryIsoComp (fShriekMod.{u, v, r} B Λ f)
          (fShriekMod.{u, v, r} B Λ g) (fShriekMod.{u, v, r} B Λ (f ≫ g))
          (fShriekModCompIso B Λ f g)).hom.app
        ((pullbackMod.{u, v, r} B Λ f).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((pullbackMod.{u, v, r} B Λ g).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) ≫
      (fShriekMod.{u, v, r} B Λ g).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((derivedWeightedTraceMod.{u, v, t, r} B Λ f hw_f).app
          ((pullbackMod.{u, v, r} B Λ g).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) ≫
      (derivedWeightedTraceMod.{u, v, t, r} B Λ g hw_g).app K =
    (derivedWeightedTraceMod.{u, v, t, r} B Λ (f ≫ g) (isWeighting_comp B f g hw_f hw_g)).app K
declarations.comment: the derived trace maps compose: g_! Tr_{f,w_f,g^{-1}K} followed by Tr_{g,w_g,K} is Tr_{g∘f,w_{g∘f},K} for every K in D(Z_étale, Λ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.flatQuasiFiniteWeight_eq_one_of_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GL4.** The canonical weighting of Stacks 0F3D, for an étale morphism of schemes,
takes the value `1` at every point of the source.

This is the reason the trace map of Example 0GKI for an étale `j : U ⟶ X` is the counit of the
adjunction `j_! ⊣ j^{-1}`: the trace for a weighting `w` acts on the stalk
`(j_! j^{-1}ℱ)_ȳ = ⨁_{j(x̄) = ȳ} ℱ_ȳ` by multiplication by `w(x̄)` on the summand indexed by
`x̄`, so for `w = 1` it is the sum map, which is the counit.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatQuasiFiniteWeight_eq_one_of_etale (u : U) :
    flatQuasiFiniteWeight j u = 1
declarations.comment:
The canonical weighting of Example 0GKI is identically 1 for an étale morphism —
the computation that makes its trace map the counit of `j_! ⊣ j^{-1}`. The remark's own equality
of the two morphisms is
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalks_iff_eq_counit` in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleCohomology.WeightedTrace.EtaleTraceIsCounit`, which uses
this computation together with the stalk characterisation of Lemma 0GKG.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.flatQuasiFiniteWeight_etale_eq_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GL4.** The canonical weighting of an étale morphism is the constant function
`1`, as an equality of functions `U → ℤ`.
declarations.statement: theorem flatQuasiFiniteWeight_etale_eq_one : flatQuasiFiniteWeight j = 1
declarations.comment:
The canonical weighting of Example 0GKI is identically 1 for an étale morphism,
as an equality of functions. Same scope as
`AlgebraicGeometry.flatQuasiFiniteWeight_eq_one_of_etale`; the remark's equality of the trace
with the counit is `AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalks_iff_eq_counit`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etaleCanonicalTrace_eq_comparison_comp_abelianTrace
declarations.doc:
For a finite étale `j` the trace map of Stacks 03SE is defined on `j_* j^{-1}` rather than on
`j_! j^{-1}`, through the comparison isomorphism `j_! ≅ j_*`. Composing the comparison with it
returns the counit: the morphism for which the terminology "trace" was already used in Étale
Cohomology, Section 03SH is the counit of `j_! ⊣ j^{-1}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleCanonicalTrace_eq_comparison_comp_abelianTrace :
    etaleCanonicalTrace B X hX U =
      Functor.whiskerLeft (abelianRestriction B X hX U)
        (abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U) ≫ abelianTrace B X hX U
declarations.comment:
The Étale Cohomology, Section 03SH half of the remark: the counit of
`j_! ⊣ j^{-1}` is the morphism already called the trace there, namely the trace map of Stacks
03SE read through the comparison `j_! ⟶ j_*`. Stated for a FINITE étale `j`, because that is
where the 03SE trace is defined in this library. The remark's own equality — counit versus the
trace map of Example 0GKI — is
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalks_iff_eq_counit` in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleCohomology.WeightedTrace.EtaleTraceIsCounit`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleEtaleCanonicalTrace_eq_comparison_comp_moduleTrace
declarations.doc:
On sheaves of `Λ`-modules: for a finite étale `j`, composing the comparison `j_! ⟶ j_*` with
the trace map of Stacks 03SE returns the counit of `j_! ⊣ j^{-1}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleEtaleCanonicalTrace_eq_comparison_comp_moduleTrace :
    moduleEtaleCanonicalTrace B X hX U Λ =
      Functor.whiskerLeft (moduleRestriction B X hX U Λ)
        (moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U Λ) ≫ moduleTrace B X hX U Λ
declarations.comment:
The Étale Cohomology, Section 03SH half of the remark on sheaves of
`Λ`-modules: the counit of `j_! ⊣ j^{-1}` is the morphism already called the trace there,
namely the trace map of Stacks 03SE read through the comparison `j_! ⟶ j_*`. Stated for a
FINITE étale `j`, where the 03SE trace is defined. The remark's own equality against the trace
map of Example 0GKI, with abelian coefficients, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalks_iff_eq_counit`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalks_iff_eq_counit
declarations.doc:
For an étale morphism `j : U ⟶ X` the trace map `Tr : j_! j^{-1}ℱ ⟶ ℱ` of Example 0GKI is
the counit of the adjunction between `j_!` and `j^{-1}`.

The trace map of Example 0GKI is the morphism Stacks 0GKG attaches to the canonical weighting of
Stacks 0F3D, characterised by its behaviour on geometric stalks; so the identification is stated
as an equivalence: a morphism `j_! j^{-1}ℱ ⟶ ℱ` has that behaviour exactly when it is the
counit. The forward direction is the remark's equality and the backward direction produces the
trace map.
declarations.statement:
public theorem hasWeightedTraceStalks_iff_eq_counit
    (τ : (SmallEtale.fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B U.obj.hom).obj
      ((SmallEtale.abPullback.{u, u + 1} B U.obj.hom).obj F) ⟶ F) :
    SmallEtale.HasWeightedTraceStalks.{u, u + 1} B U.obj.hom
        (flatQuasiFiniteWeight (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom)) F τ ↔
      τ = (etaleFShriekAbPullbackAdjunction B X hX U).counit.app F
declarations.comment:
For an abelian étale sheaf `ℱ`: a morphism `j_! j^{-1}ℱ ⟶ ℱ` has the behaviour
on geometric stalks by which Lemma 0GKG characterises the trace map of Example 0GKI, for the
canonical weighting of Stacks 0F3D, exactly when it is the counit of the adjunction
`j_! ⊣ j^{-1}`. The forward implication is the remark's equality; the backward implication
produces the trace map, so nothing about it is assumed.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.derivedWeightedTraceFamily_eq_derivedCounit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GL4 on the unbounded derived category of abelian étale sheaves.** Let
`j : U ⟶ X` be étale and let `τ` be the family of trace maps of Example 0GKI, that is a morphism
`j_! j^{-1}ℱ ⟶ ℱ` for each abelian étale sheaf `ℱ` on `X` with the behaviour on geometric stalks
by which Lemma 0GKG characterises the trace for the canonical weighting of Stacks 0F3D. Both
`j_!` and `j^{-1}` are exact, so the family descends to a natural transformation
`j_! j^{-1} ⟶ id` of the unbounded derived category, and the adjunction of Stacks 03S3 descends
to an adjunction of the descended functors. Then the descended trace is the counit of the
descended adjunction.

The weighting hypothesis of Stacks 0GKG is not needed and the trace maps are not assumed to
exist: the counit itself is such a family, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalks_counit`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem derivedWeightedTraceFamily_eq_derivedCounit :
    NatTrans.mapDerivedCategoryCompToId (abPullback.{u, u + 1} B U.obj.hom)
        (fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B U.obj.hom)
        (weightedTraceFamilyNatTrans.{u, u + 1} B U.obj.hom
          (flatQuasiFiniteWeight (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom)) τ hτ) =
      (Adjunction.mapDerivedCategory (etaleFShriekAbPullbackAdjunction B X hX U)).counit
declarations.comment: At derived coefficients, on the unbounded derived category of abelian étale sheaves: for an étale j the derived form of the family of trace maps of Example 0GKI -- each of them characterised on geometric stalks by Lemma 0GKG for the canonical weighting of 0F3D -- is the counit of the adjunction between the derived functors of j_! and j^{-1}, which is the derived form of the adjunction of Stacks 03S3. Both descents are constructed here: the trace by `CategoryTheory.NatTrans.mapDerivedCategoryCompToId` as in 0GKH part (3), the adjunction by `CategoryTheory.Adjunction.mapDerivedCategory`, and they are compared by the coherence lemma `CategoryTheory.Adjunction.mapDerivedCategory_counit`. The sheaf-level input is `AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalks_iff_eq_counit`. Coefficients in AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}, the universe at which 03S3 is available here; the universe of the derived category is arbitrary.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalksMod_iff_eq_counit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GL4 at `Λ`-coefficients, on a single sheaf of `Λ`-modules.** For an étale `j`, a
ring `Λ` and a sheaf of `Λ`-modules `M` on the small étale site of `X`, a morphism
`τ : j_! j^{-1}M ⟶ M` is the trace map of Stacks 0GKH part (3) for the canonical weighting of
`j` — that is, the morphism of abelian sheaves underlying it has the behaviour on geometric
stalks prescribed by Lemma 0GKG — if and only if it is the counit of the `Λ`-linear adjunction
`j_! ⊣ j^{-1}` at `M`. The backward direction produces the trace map, so the equivalence also
says that the trace map exists.
declarations.statement:
public theorem hasWeightedTraceStalksMod_iff_eq_counit
    (M : ModuleSheaf.{u, u + 1, u} B (B.obj X hX) Λ)
    (τ : (fShriekMod.{u, u + 1, u} B Λ U.obj.hom).obj
      ((pullbackMod.{u, u + 1, u} B Λ U.obj.hom).obj M) ⟶ M) :
    HasWeightedTraceStalksMod.{u, u + 1, u} B Λ U.obj.hom
        (pullbackMod.{u, u + 1, u} B Λ U.obj.hom)
        (pullbackModForgetIso.{u, u + 1, u} B Λ U.obj.hom)
        (flatQuasiFiniteWeight (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom)) M τ ↔
      τ = (etaleFShriekModPullbackAdjunction B X hX U Λ).counit.app M
declarations.comment: At Lambda-coefficients on a single sheaf of Lambda-modules, for an arbitrary ring Lambda: a morphism j_!j^{-1}M ⟶ M of sheaves of Lambda-modules is the trace map of 0GKH part (3) for the canonical weighting of 0F3D -- its underlying morphism of abelian sheaves having the behaviour on geometric stalks prescribed by 0GKG -- if and only if it is the counit of the Lambda-linear adjunction `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.etaleFShriekModPullbackAdjunction` at M. The backward direction is the existence of the trace map at Lambda-coefficients, the forward direction is the remark. The Lambda-linear form of `AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalks_iff_eq_counit`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.derivedWeightedTraceMod_eq_derivedCounit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GL4 on `D(X_étale, Λ)`.** Let `j : U ⟶ X` be étale and let `Λ` be a ring. The
derived trace `Tr_{j, w} : j_! j^{-1} ⟶ id` of `D(X_étale, Λ)` of Stacks 0GKH part (3), for the
canonical weighting `w` of `j` of Stacks 0F3D, is the counit of the adjunction between the
derived functors of the `Λ`-linear `j_!` and `j^{-1}`.

Every object in the statement is constructed. The trace is
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.derivedWeightedTraceMod`, the derived form of the sheaf-level
trace `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.weightedTraceMod`, which has at each sheaf of `Λ`-modules
the behaviour on geometric stalks by which Lemma 0GKG characterises the trace — that is
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.weightedTraceMod_hasWeightedTraceStalksMod` — and is by
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.hasWeightedTraceStalksMod_unique` the only such morphism, so it is
*the* trace map and `Tr_{j, w}` is *the* derived trace rather than one of a family of candidates.
The `Λ`-linear inverse image is `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.pullbackMod` and the `Λ`-linear
adjunction `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.etaleFShriekModPullbackAdjunction`, the lift of the
adjunction of Stacks 03S3, whose counit is the abelian counit on underlying abelian sheaves by
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.forgetModuleSheaf_map_etaleFShriekModPullbackAdjunction_counit`;
the weighting is the canonical one, a weighting by
`AlgebraicGeometry.flatQuasiFiniteWeight_isWeighting`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.derivedWeightedTrace_pullbackMod_eq_derivedCounit`, which leaves the
trace family general, instantiated at that constructed trace.
declarations.statement:
public theorem derivedWeightedTraceMod_eq_derivedCounit :
    SmallEtale.derivedWeightedTraceMod.{u, u + 1, t, u} B Λ U.obj.hom
        (flatQuasiFiniteWeight_isWeighting (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom)) =
      (Adjunction.mapDerivedCategory
        (etaleFShriekModPullbackAdjunction B X hX U Λ)).counit
declarations.comment: At the derived coefficients of the remark, D(X_etale, Lambda) for an arbitrary ring Lambda: for an étale j the derived trace Tr_{j,w} of 0GKH part (3) -- `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.derivedWeightedTraceMod` for the canonical weighting of 0F3D -- is the counit of the adjunction between the derived functors of the Lambda-linear j_! and j^{-1}, so for each K in D(X_etale, Lambda) the morphism Tr_{j,w,K} : j_!j^{-1}K ⟶ K is the counit at K. Every object the statement names is constructed and nothing is quantified over: the derived trace is `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.derivedWeightedTraceMod`, the derived form of the sheaf-level `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.weightedTraceMod`, which is the trace of 0GKG by `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.weightedTraceMod_hasWeightedTraceStalksMod` and the unique such morphism by `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.hasWeightedTraceStalksMod_unique`; the Lambda-linear inverse image is `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.pullbackMod`, the lift of the abelian j^{-1} of 03Q1; the Lambda-linear adjunction is `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.etaleFShriekModPullbackAdjunction`, the lift of the abelian adjunction of 03S3, whose counit is the abelian counit on underlying abelian sheaves by `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.forgetModuleSheaf_map_etaleFShriekModPullbackAdjunction_counit`; and the weighting is the canonical one of 0F3D, a weighting by `AlgebraicGeometry.flatQuasiFiniteWeight_isWeighting`. The identification of the derived trace with the derived counit comes from the abelian case `AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalks_iff_eq_counit` through the coherence lemma `CategoryTheory.Adjunction.mapDerivedCategory_counit`, which says that the counit of a derived adjunction is the derived counit, and the sheaf-level trace is the counit by `AlgebraicGeometry.hasWeightedTraceStalksMod_counit_etale` with the uniqueness of 0GKG at Lambda-coefficients. Coefficient universes ModuleSheaf.{u, u+1, u} with Lambda : Type u, those of 0GKH part (3); the universe of the derived category is arbitrary.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.derivedWeightedTraceMod_app_eq_derivedCounit_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GL4 on `D(X_étale, Λ)`, at a fixed object.** For an étale `j`, a ring `Λ` and an
object `K` of `D(X_étale, Λ)`, the trace map `Tr_{j, w, K} : j_! j^{-1}K ⟶ K` of Stacks 0GKH
part (3), for the canonical weighting `w` of `j`, is the counit at `K` of the adjunction between
the derived functors of the `Λ`-linear `j_!` and `j^{-1}`. This is the form in which the remark
reads, and it is the component at `K` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.derivedWeightedTraceMod_eq_derivedCounit`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem derivedWeightedTraceMod_app_eq_derivedCounit_app
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u + 1, u} B (B.obj X hX) Λ)) :
    (SmallEtale.derivedWeightedTraceMod.{u, u + 1, t, u} B Λ U.obj.hom
          (flatQuasiFiniteWeight_isWeighting (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom))).app K =
      (Adjunction.mapDerivedCategory
        (etaleFShriekModPullbackAdjunction B X hX U Λ)).counit.app K
declarations.comment: At a fixed object K of D(X_etale, Lambda) for an arbitrary ring Lambda, which is how the remark reads: for an étale j the trace map Tr_{j,w,K} : j_!j^{-1}K ⟶ K of 0GKH part (3) -- the component at K of `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.derivedWeightedTraceMod` for the canonical weighting of 0F3D -- is the counit at K of the adjunction between the derived functors of the Lambda-linear j_! and j^{-1}. The trace, the two functors and the adjunction are all constructed and nothing is quantified over; this is the component form of `AlgebraicGeometry.derivedWeightedTraceMod_eq_derivedCounit`.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_derivedLowerShriekUnboundedTensorMap
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0GL5].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a separated finite type morphism of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes and let `Λ` be a torsion ring (`n = 0` in `Λ` for some `n ≥ 1`). Then
`f` has a compactification `j : X ⟶ X̄` over `Y`, and for every compactification `j`, every
`E ∈ D(X_étale, Λ)` and every `K ∈ D(Y_étale, Λ)` the canonical map
`Rf_!E ⊗^L_Λ K ⟶ Rf_!(E ⊗^L_Λ f^{-1}K)`, with `Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ j_!` computed through `j`, is an
isomorphism in `D(Y_étale, Λ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedLowerShriekUnboundedTensorMap (Λ : Type) [CommRing Λ] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hΛ : (n : Λ) = 0) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] :
    (∃ j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f), QuasiCompact j.immersion) ∧
      ∀ (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) (E : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X))
        (K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ Y)),
        IsIso (derivedLowerShriekUnboundedTensorMap.{u, 0} Λ j E K)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_derivedLowerShriekUnboundedExtendScalarsMap_of_torsion
declarations.doc:
**The second diagram of [Stacks, Remark 0GL6].**  Let `φ : Λ₁ → Λ₂` be a homomorphism of
commutative rings with `Λ₁` torsion, `f : X ⟶ Y` a morphism of schemes with `Y` quasi-compact and
`j` a compactification of `X` over `Y`, so that `Rf_! = R(f̄)_* ∘ j_!` as in [Stacks, Tag 0F7H].
Then the comparison `Rf_!(E) ⊗^L_{Λ₁} Λ₂ ⟶ Rf_!(E ⊗^L_{Λ₁} Λ₂)`, natural in
`E ∈ D(X_étale, Λ₁)`, is an isomorphism: the square of `Rf_!` and `- ⊗^L_{Λ₁} Λ₂` commutes.

This is `isIso_derivedLowerShriekUnboundedExtendScalarsMap_of_properBaseChange` applied to the
proper base change theorem, [Stacks, Tag 095T]
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_etaleAbelianSheafDerivedBaseChange_of_isProper`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedLowerShriekUnboundedExtendScalarsMap_of_torsion
    (hΛ₁ : ∀ x : Λ₁, ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ (n : Λ₁) * x = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) :
    IsIso (derivedLowerShriekUnboundedExtendScalarsMap.{u, r} φ f j)
declarations.comment: diagram (2): Rf_! commutes with - ⊗^L_{Λ₁} Λ₂

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnbounded_commutes_restrictScalars_and_extendScalars
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Remark 0GL6], both diagrams.**  Let `φ : Λ₁ → Λ₂` be a homomorphism of commutative
rings with `Λ₁` torsion, `f : X ⟶ Y` a morphism of schemes with `Y` quasi-compact and `j` a
compactification of `X` over `Y`, so that `Rf_! = R(f̄)_* ∘ j_!` as in [Stacks, Tag 0F7H].  Then
1. `Rf_!` commutes with restriction of coefficients: `res_φ ∘ Rf_! ≅ Rf_! ∘ res_φ` as functors
   `D(X_étale, Λ₂) ⥤ D(Y_étale, Λ₁)` (`derivedLowerShriekUnboundedRestrictScalarsIso`);
2. `Rf_!` commutes with derived extension of coefficients:
   `Rf_!(-) ⊗^L_{Λ₁} Λ₂ ≅ Rf_!(- ⊗^L_{Λ₁} Λ₂)` as functors `D(X_étale, Λ₁) ⥤ D(Y_étale, Λ₂)`
   (`isIso_derivedLowerShriekUnboundedExtendScalarsMap_of_torsion`).
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLowerShriekUnbounded_commutes_restrictScalars_and_extendScalars
    (hΛ₁ : ∀ x : Λ₁, ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ (n : Λ₁) * x = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) :
    Nonempty (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ₂ ⋙
        etaleModuleDerivedRestrictScalars.{u, r} φ Y ≅
      etaleModuleDerivedRestrictScalars.{u, r} φ X ⋙ derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ₁) ∧
    Nonempty (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ₁ ⋙
        etaleModuleDerivedExtendScalars.{u, r} φ Y ≅
      etaleModuleDerivedExtendScalars.{u, r} φ X ⋙ derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ₂)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnboundedRestrictScalarsIso
declarations.doc:
**The first diagram of [Stacks, Remark 0GL6].**  Cohomology with compact support commutes
with restriction of coefficients: for a compactification `j` of `X` over `Y` and
`Rf_! = R(f̄)_* ∘ Rj_!` the resulting functor on unbounded derived categories, restricting the
coefficients along `φ : Λ₁ → Λ₂` before or after `Rf_!` gives canonically isomorphic functors.

The second diagram asserted in the same remark, that `Rf_!` commutes with
`- ⊗^L_{Λ₁} Λ₂`, is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_derivedLowerShriekUnboundedExtendScalarsMap_of_torsion`; see the
module docstring.

No separatedness, finite type or quasi-compactness hypothesis on `f` appears: the source needs
them only to produce the compactification, which is data here, so this is more general than the
source's phrasing.  Neither coefficient ring is assumed torsion, for the same reason — the
torsion hypothesis of the remark is consumed by Tag 0GL5, which only the second diagram uses.
declarations.statement:
def derivedLowerShriekUnboundedRestrictScalarsIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) :
    derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ₂ ⋙
        etaleModuleDerivedRestrictScalars.{u, r} φ Y ≅
      etaleModuleDerivedRestrictScalars.{u, r} φ X ⋙ derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ₁
declarations.comment:
the first of the two diagrams: Rf_! commutes with restriction of coefficients
res_φ along φ : Λ₁ → Λ₂, for a chosen compactification. The second diagram, that Rf_! commutes
with - ⊗^L_{Λ₁} Λ₂, is isIso_derivedLowerShriekUnboundedExtendScalarsMap_of_torsion.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.DerivedUpperShriek.CompactificationData.lowerShriekHomMap
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map `α` of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7]**,

`α : Rf_*RHom_Λ(K, L) ⟶ RHom_Λ(Rf_!K, Rf_!L)`,

for a chosen compactification `f = f̄ ∘ j`. It is `γ ∘ Rf̄_*β`, with `Rf_! = Rf̄_*j_!` and
`Rf_* = Rf̄_*Rj_*`.
declarations.statement:
def lowerShriekHomMap (K L : DU) :
    data.derivedPushforward.obj ((data.homU.obj (op K)).obj L) ⟶
      (data.homY.obj (op (data.derivedLowerShriek.obj K))).obj
        (data.derivedLowerShriek.obj L)
declarations.comment: the canonical map α, for a chosen compactification, at abstract compactification data; its instance at the étale derived categories, which is the faithful registration of 0GL7, is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleLowerShriekHomMap`

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.DerivedUpperShriek.CompactificationData.lowerShriekHomMap_eq
declarations.doc:
**`α = γ ∘ Rf̄_*β`**, the factorisation along the chosen compactification by which the
canonical map of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7] is defined.
declarations.statement:
theorem lowerShriekHomMap_eq (K L : DU) :
    data.lowerShriekHomMap K L =
      data.pushforwardFbar.map (data.openImmersionHomMap K L) ≫
        data.pushforwardHomMap (data.shriek.obj K) (data.shriek.obj L)
declarations.comment: the factorisation α = γ ∘ Rf̄_*β, at abstract compactification data; at the étale derived categories it is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleLowerShriekHomMap_eq`

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.DerivedUpperShriek.CompactificationData.lowerShriekHomMap_naturality_target
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7] is covariant in `L`**, one half of the
functoriality the source asserts.
declarations.statement:
theorem lowerShriekHomMap_naturality_target (K : DU) {L L' : DU} (l : L ⟶ L') :
    data.derivedPushforward.map ((data.homU.obj (op K)).map l) ≫
        data.lowerShriekHomMap K L' =
      data.lowerShriekHomMap K L ≫
        (data.homY.obj (op (data.derivedLowerShriek.obj K))).map
          (data.derivedLowerShriek.map l)
declarations.comment: functoriality of α in L, at abstract compactification data; at the étale derived categories it is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleLowerShriekHomMap_naturality_target`

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.DerivedUpperShriek.CompactificationData.lowerShriekHomMap_naturality_source
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7] is contravariant in `K`**, the other half of the
functoriality the source asserts.
declarations.statement:
theorem lowerShriekHomMap_naturality_source {K K' : DU} (k : K' ⟶ K) (L : DU) :
    data.derivedPushforward.map ((data.homU.map k.op).app L) ≫
        data.lowerShriekHomMap K' L =
      data.lowerShriekHomMap K L ≫
        (data.homY.map (data.derivedLowerShriek.map k).op).app
          (data.derivedLowerShriek.obj L)
declarations.comment: functoriality of α in K, at abstract compactification data; at the étale derived categories it is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleLowerShriekHomMap_naturality_source`

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleLowerShriekHomMap
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map `α` of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7]**,

`α : Rf_*RHom_Λ(K, L) ⟶ RHom_Λ(Rf_!K, Rf_!L)`,

for `K`, `L` in `D(X_étale, Λ)`, with `Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ j_!` computed through the compactification
`j`: Leray `Rf_* = Rf̄_* ∘ Rj_*`, followed by `Rf̄_*β` and by the map `γ` of
[Stacks, Tag 0B6D] for `f̄`.
declarations.statement:
def etaleLowerShriekHomMap (K L : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X)) :
    (etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageUnbounded.{u, r} Λ f).obj
        (((etaleDerivedHom.{u, r} Λ X).obj (op K)).obj L) ⟶
      ((etaleDerivedHom.{u, r} Λ Y).obj (op ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).obj K))).obj
        ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).obj L)
declarations.comment:
the canonical map α on étale derived categories, for a compactification of f;
  β is built from 08J8, 0GL1 and j^{-1}Rj_* = id, γ from 0B6C/0B6D, Rf_* = Rf̄_* Rj_* by Leray

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleLowerShriekHomMap_eq
declarations.doc:
**`α = γ ∘ Rf̄_*β`**, preceded by Leray `Rf_* = Rf̄_* ∘ Rj_*`: the factorization of the
canonical map of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7] along the compactification, with `β` the open-immersion map
and `γ` the direct-image map of [Stacks, Tag 0B6D].
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleLowerShriekHomMap_eq (K L : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X)) :
    etaleLowerShriekHomMap.{u, r} Λ f j K L =
      (etaleCompactificationLerayIso.{u, r} Λ f j).hom.app _ ≫
        (etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageUnbounded.{u, r} Λ j.toBase).map
          ((etaleCompactificationData.{u, r} Λ f j).openImmersionHomMap K L) ≫
        (etaleCompactificationData.{u, r} Λ f j).pushforwardHomMap
          ((etaleModuleDerivedExtensionByZeroUnbounded.{u, r} Λ j.immersion).obj K)
          ((etaleModuleDerivedExtensionByZeroUnbounded.{u, r} Λ j.immersion).obj L)
declarations.comment: α = γ ∘ Rf̄_*β (after Leray), on étale derived categories

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleLowerShriekHomMap_naturality_target
declarations.doc: **The canonical map of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7] is covariant in `L`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleLowerShriekHomMap_naturality_target (K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X))
    {L L' : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X)} (l : L ⟶ L') :
    (etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageUnbounded.{u, r} Λ f).map
        (((etaleDerivedHom.{u, r} Λ X).obj (op K)).map l) ≫
          etaleLowerShriekHomMap.{u, r} Λ f j K L' =
      etaleLowerShriekHomMap.{u, r} Λ f j K L ≫
        ((etaleDerivedHom.{u, r} Λ Y).obj
            (op ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).obj K))).map
          ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).map l)
declarations.comment: functoriality of α in L, on étale derived categories

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleLowerShriekHomMap_naturality_source
declarations.doc: **The canonical map of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7] is contravariant in `K`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleLowerShriekHomMap_naturality_source {K K' : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X)}
    (k : K' ⟶ K) (L : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X)) :
    (etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageUnbounded.{u, r} Λ f).map
        (((etaleDerivedHom.{u, r} Λ X).map k.op).app L) ≫ etaleLowerShriekHomMap.{u, r} Λ f j K' L =
      etaleLowerShriekHomMap.{u, r} Λ f j K L ≫
        ((etaleDerivedHom.{u, r} Λ Y).map ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).map k).op).app
          ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).obj L)
declarations.comment: functoriality of α in K, on étale derived categories

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleLowerShriekHomNatTrans
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7], functorial in `K` and `L`**: `α` as a natural
transformation between the bifunctors `(K, L) ↦ Rf_*RHom_Λ(K, L)` and
`(K, L) ↦ RHom_Λ(Rf_!K, Rf_!L)` on `D(X_étale, Λ)ᵒᵖ × D(X_étale, Λ)`.
declarations.statement:
def etaleLowerShriekHomNatTrans :
    etaleDerivedHom.{u, r} Λ X ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj (etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageUnbounded.{u, r} Λ f) ⟶
      (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).op ⋙ etaleDerivedHom.{u, r} Λ Y ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ _).obj (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ)
declarations.comment:
the canonical map α : Rf_*RHom(K, L) ⟶ RHom(Rf_!K, Rf_!L) on étale derived
  categories, functorial in K and L, for a compactification of f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_compactification_rightAdjointIso_moduleRUpperShriekFunctor
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0GL8].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a separated quasi-finite morphism of a big
étale site with `Y` quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and let `Λ` be a ring. Then `f` factors
as an open immersion `j : X ⟶ X̄` followed by a finite morphism `f̄ : X̄ ⟶ Y` (Zariski's main
theorem, [Stacks, Tag 05K0]), and for every model of `D(X̄_étale, Λ)` and every total right
derived functor `Rf̄_*` of `f̄_*`, the derived lower shriek `Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ j_!` of
[Stacks, Tag 0G2C] has a right adjoint, and every right adjoint `Rf^!` of it is isomorphic to
the derived upper shriek `Rf^! : D(Y_étale, Λ) ⥤ D(X_étale, Λ)` of [Stacks, Tag 0F5N].

Quasi-finiteness is [Stacks, Tag 02NG]: locally quasi-finite, locally of finite type and
quasi-compact together. The compactification is produced, not assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_compactification_rightAdjointIso_moduleRUpperShriekFunctor
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (Λ : Type u) [Ring Λ] {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)] [QuasiCompact (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [CompactSpace Y.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y.obj]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y Λ)] :
    ∃ (Xbar : B.Scheme) (j : X ⟶ Xbar) (fbar : Xbar ⟶ Y)
      (_ : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)) (_ : IsFinite (B.inclusion.map fbar)),
      f = j ≫ fbar ∧
      ∀ [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Xbar Λ)]
        (RFbar : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Xbar Λ) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y Λ))
        (α : (etalePushforwardMod B Λ fbar).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RFbar),
        RFbar.IsRightDerivedFunctor α
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Xbar Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) →
        ((fShriekMod.{u, u, u} B Λ j).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RFbar).IsLeftAdjoint ∧
        ∀ (G : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y Λ) ⥤
            DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ)),
          ((fShriekMod.{u, u, u} B Λ j).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RFbar ⊣ G) →
          Nonempty (G ≅ moduleRUpperShriekFunctor.{u, u, w, u} B Λ f)
declarations.comment: Rf^! of Tag 0G2C is the Rf^! of Tag 0F5N, for every right adjoint of Rf_!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_compactification_rightAdjointIso_pullbackMod_mapDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0GL9].** Let `j : U ⟶ X` be a separated étale morphism of a big étale site
with `U` quasi-compact and `X` quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and let `Λ` be a ring. Then
`j` factors as an open immersion `j' : U ⟶ X̄` followed by a finite morphism `j̄ : X̄ ⟶ X`
(Zariski's main theorem), and for every model of `D(X̄_étale, Λ)` and every total right derived
functor `Rj̄_*` of `j̄_*`, the derived lower shriek `Rj_! = Rj̄_* ∘ j'_!` of [Stacks, Tag 0G2C]
has a right adjoint, and every right adjoint `Rj^!` of it is isomorphic to the inverse image
`j^{-1} : D(X_étale, Λ) ⥤ D(U_étale, Λ)`.

The compactification is produced, not assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_compactification_rightAdjointIso_pullbackMod_mapDerivedCategory
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (Λ : Type u) [Ring Λ] {U X : B.Scheme} (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map j)] [Etale (B.inclusion.map j)]
    [CompactSpace U.obj] [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B U Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ)] :
    ∃ (Xbar : B.Scheme) (j' : U ⟶ Xbar) (fbar : Xbar ⟶ X)
      (_ : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j')) (_ : IsFinite (B.inclusion.map fbar)),
      j = j' ≫ fbar ∧
      ∀ [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Xbar Λ)]
        (RFbar : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Xbar Λ) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ))
        (α : (etalePushforwardMod B Λ fbar).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RFbar),
        RFbar.IsRightDerivedFunctor α
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Xbar Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) →
        ((fShriekMod.{u, u, u} B Λ j').mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RFbar).IsLeftAdjoint ∧
        ∀ (G : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ) ⥤
            DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B U Λ)),
          ((fShriekMod.{u, u, u} B Λ j').mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RFbar ⊣ G) →
          Nonempty (G ≅ (pullbackMod.{u, u, u} B Λ j).mapDerivedCategory)
declarations.comment: Rj^! of Tag 0G2C is j^{-1}, for every right adjoint of Rj_!

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.DerivedUpperShriek.exists_isZero_homology_derivedUpperShriek_obj
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a separated morphism of finite type between quasi-compact and
quasi-separated schemes, let `j` be a compactification of `f`, and let `Λ` be a torsion ring
(`n = 0` in `Λ` for some `n ≥ 1`). The functor `Rf^!`, the right adjoint of
`Rf_! = R(fbar)_* ∘ j_! : D(X_étale, Λ) ⟶ D(Y_étale, Λ)` of [Stacks, Tag 0G2C], sends
`D^+(Y_étale, Λ)` into `D^+(X_étale, Λ)`. More precisely, there is an integer `N ≥ 0` such that
if `K ∈ D(Y_étale, Λ)` has `H^i(K) = 0` for `i < a`, then `H^i(Rf^!K) = 0` for `i < a - N`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_homology_derivedUpperShriek_obj {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) :
    letI := isLeftAdjoint_derivedLowerShriekUnbounded Λ n hn hΛ f j
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ Y),
      (∃ a : ℤ, ∀ i < a, IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K)) →
      ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i < b, IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
        ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, 0} f j Λ).rightAdjoint.obj K))) ∧
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ Y)) (a : ℤ),
      (∀ i < a, IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K)) →
      ∀ i < a - N, IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
        ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, 0} f j Λ).rightAdjoint.obj K))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedUpperShriekUnboundedSheafyTrace
declarations.doc:
Let `Λ` be a torsion ring and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of schemes with a
compactification `f = f̄ ∘ j`, so that `Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ Rj_! : D(X_étale, Λ) ⟶ D(Y_étale, Λ)`
has the right adjoint `Rf^!` of [Stacks, Tag 0G2C]. For every `K` in `D(Y_étale, Λ)` and `L` in
`D(X_étale, Λ)` this is the canonical map

`Rf_*RHom_Λ(L, Rf^!K) ⟶ RHom_Λ(Rf_!L, K)`,

the composite `Rf_*RHom_Λ(L, Rf^!K) ⟶ RHom_Λ(Rf_!L, Rf_!Rf^!K) ⟶ RHom_Λ(Rf_!L, K)` of the map of
[Stacks, Tag 0GL7] and the counit `Rf_!Rf^!K ⟶ K` of the adjunction
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedUpperShriekUnboundedSheafyTrace_eq`).

A compactification exists when `f` is separated of finite type between quasi-compact and
quasi-separated schemes, [Stacks, Tag 0F41].
declarations.statement:
def derivedUpperShriekUnboundedSheafyTrace
    (L : letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X)
      DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X))
    (K : letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y)
      DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y)) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y)
    (etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageUnbounded.{u, r} Λ f).obj
        (((etaleDerivedHom.{u, r} Λ X).obj (op L)).obj
          ((derivedUpperShriekUnbounded.{u, r} Λ j hΛ).obj K)) ⟶
      ((etaleDerivedHom.{u, r} Λ Y).obj (op ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, r} f j Λ).obj L))).obj
        K

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.DerivedUpperShriek.CompactificationData.sheafyTrace
declarations.doc:
The sheafy trace map

`Rf_*RHom_Λ(L, Rf^!K) ⟶ RHom_Λ(Rf_!L, K)`,

the composite of the canonical map `α` of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7] at `(L, Rf^!K)` with the internal
Hom of the counit `Rf_!Rf^!K ⟶ K` of the adjunction `Rf_! ⊣ Rf^!`.
declarations.comment: the map, for a chosen compactification and a chosen adjunction Rf_! ⊣ Rf^!

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.DerivedUpperShriek.CompactificationData.sheafyTrace_eq
declarations.doc:
The sheafy trace map is the canonical map of [Stacks, Tag 0GL7] followed by the internal Hom
of the counit of `Rf_! ⊣ Rf^!`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafyTrace_eq (L : DU) (K : DY) :
    sheafyTrace data adj L K =
      data.lowerShriekHomMap L (upperShriek.obj K) ≫
        (data.homY.obj (op (data.derivedLowerShriek.obj L))).map (adj.counit.app K)
declarations.comment: the defining composite through RHom(Rf_!L, Rf_!Rf^!K)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.DerivedUpperShriek.CompactificationData.sheafyTrace_naturality_target
declarations.doc: The sheafy trace map is natural in `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafyTrace_naturality_target (L : DU) {K K' : DY} (k : K ⟶ K') :
    data.derivedPushforward.map ((data.homU.obj (op L)).map (upperShriek.map k)) ≫
        sheafyTrace data adj L K' =
      sheafyTrace data adj L K ≫
        (data.homY.obj (op (data.derivedLowerShriek.obj L))).map k
declarations.comment: functoriality in K

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.DerivedUpperShriek.CompactificationData.sheafyTrace_naturality_source
declarations.doc: The sheafy trace map is natural in `L`, contravariantly.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafyTrace_naturality_source {L L' : DU} (l : L' ⟶ L) (K : DY) :
    data.derivedPushforward.map ((data.homU.map l.op).app (upperShriek.obj K)) ≫
        sheafyTrace data adj L' K =
      sheafyTrace data adj L K ≫
        (data.homY.map (data.derivedLowerShriek.map l).op).app K
declarations.comment: functoriality in L

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_derivedUpperShriekUnboundedSheafyTrace
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0GLC].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a separated finite type morphism of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes and let `Λ` be a torsion ring (`m = 0` in `Λ` for some `m ≥ 1`). Then
`f` has a compactification `j : X ⟶ X̄` over `Y`, and for every compactification `j`, every
`K ∈ D(Y_étale, Λ)` and every `L ∈ D(X_étale, Λ)` the map
`Rf_*RHom_Λ(L, Rf^!K) ⟶ RHom_Λ(Rf_!L, K)` of [Stacks, Tag 0GLB], with `Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ j_!` and
`Rf^!` its right adjoint of [Stacks, Tag 0G2C], is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedUpperShriekUnboundedSheafyTrace (Λ : Type) [CommRing Λ]
    (hΛ : ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ (m : Λ) = 0) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    (∃ j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f), QuasiCompact j.immersion) ∧
      ∀ (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) (K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ Y))
        (L : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X)),
        IsIso (derivedUpperShriekUnboundedSheafyTrace.{u, 0} f j hΛ L K)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_derivedUpperShriekUnboundedGlobalTrace
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0GLD].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a separated finite type morphism of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes and let `Λ` be a torsion ring (`m = 0` in `Λ` for some `m ≥ 1`). Then
`f` has a compactification `j : X ⟶ X̄` over `Y`, and for every compactification `j`, every
`K ∈ D(Y_étale, Λ)` and every `L ∈ D(X_étale, Λ)` the map of [Stacks, Tag 0GLB] induces an
isomorphism `RHom_X(L, Rf^!K) ⟶ RHom_Y(Rf_!L, K)` of global derived homs
`RHom_X(-, -) = RΓ(X, RHom_Λ(-, -))` ([Stacks, Tag 0B6E]), with `Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ j_!` and `Rf^!`
its right adjoint of [Stacks, Tag 0G2C].
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedUpperShriekUnboundedGlobalTrace (Λ : Type) [CommRing Λ]
    (hΛ : ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ (m : Λ) = 0) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    (∃ j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f), QuasiCompact j.immersion) ∧
      ∀ (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) (K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ Y))
        (L : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X)),
        IsIso (derivedUpperShriekUnboundedGlobalTrace.{u, 0} f j hΛ L K)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedUpperShriekBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GLE.** Let
```
X' --g'--> X
|f'        |f
v          v
Y' --g---> Y
```
be a cartesian square of schemes, let `Λ` be a ring, and let `j`, `j'` be compactifications of
`f`, `f'`.  Let `Uf`, `Uf'` be right adjoints of `Rf_!`, `Rf'_!` and let `Pg`, `Pg'` be left
adjoints of `Rg_*`, `Rg'_*`.  Given the base change isomorphism
`Rf_! ⋙ Pg ≅ Pg' ⋙ Rf'_!` of Stacks Tag 0F7L for derived lower shriek, the derived upper
shrieks satisfy `Rf^! ∘ Rg_* ≅ Rg'_* ∘ R(f')^!`.

Both sides of the conclusion are right adjoint to `Rf_! ⋙ Pg`, so the isomorphism is the
uniqueness of right adjoints applied to the given base change isomorphism of the left
adjoints.
declarations.statement:
def derivedUpperShriekBaseChange {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (_sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) (j' : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f'))
    (Λ : Type r) [Ring Λ]
    {Uf : DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y) ⥤
      DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X)}
    (adjF : derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} f j Λ ⊣ Uf)
    {Uf' : DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y') ⥤
      DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X')}
    (adjF' : derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} f' j' Λ ⊣ Uf')
    {Pg : DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y) ⥤
      DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y')}
    (adjG : Pg ⊣ etaleModuleDerivedDirectImage.{u, r} Λ g)
    {Pg' : DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X) ⥤
      DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X')}
    (adjG' : Pg' ⊣ etaleModuleDerivedDirectImage.{u, r} Λ g')
    (baseChange : derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} f j Λ ⋙ Pg ≅
      Pg' ⋙ derivedLowerShriek.{u, r} f' j' Λ) :
    etaleModuleDerivedDirectImage.{u, r} Λ g ⋙ Uf ≅
      Uf' ⋙ etaleModuleDerivedDirectImage.{u, r} Λ g'

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedUpperShriekUnboundedBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GLE.** Consider a cartesian square
```
X' --g'--> X
|f'        |f
v          v
Y' --g---> Y
```
of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with `f` separated and of finite type, and let `Λ`
be a torsion ring (`n = 0` in `Λ` for some `n ≥ 1`). Let `Rf^!` and `R(f')^!` be the right
adjoints ([Stacks, Tag 0G2C]) of the derived lower shrieks `Rf_! : D(X_étale, Λ) ⥤ D(Y_étale, Λ)`
and `Rf'_! : D(X'_étale, Λ) ⥤ D(Y'_étale, Λ)` of arbitrary compactifications `j` of `f` and `j'`
of `f'`. Then `Rf^! ∘ Rg_* ≅ Rg'_* ∘ R(f')^!` as functors `D(Y'_étale, Λ) ⥤ D(X_étale, Λ)`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedUpperShriekUnboundedBaseChange :
    letI := DerivedUpperShriek.isLeftAdjoint_derivedLowerShriekUnbounded Λ n hn hΛ f j
    letI := DerivedUpperShriek.isLeftAdjoint_derivedLowerShriekUnbounded Λ n hn hΛ f' j'
    etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageUnbounded.{u, 0} Λ g ⋙
        (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, 0} f j Λ).rightAdjoint ≅
      (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, 0} f' j' Λ).rightAdjoint ⋙
        etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageUnbounded.{u, 0} Λ g'

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.ChangeOfRings.upperShriek_restrictScalars
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0GLF].** Let `φ : Λ₁ ⟶ Λ₂` be a homomorphism of torsion rings (`n = 0` in
`Λ₁` for some `n ≥ 1`, hence also in `Λ₂`) and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a separated morphism of finite
type between quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes. Then `f` has a compactification
([Stacks, Tag 0F41]), and for every compactification `j`, with `Rf_! = R(fbar)_* ∘ j_!` and `Rf^!`
its right adjoint over `Λ₁` and over `Λ₂` ([Stacks, Tag 0G2C]),

`res ∘ Rf^! ≅ Rf^! ∘ res : D(Y_étale, Λ₂) ⥤ D(X_étale, Λ₁)`,

`res` being restriction of scalars along `φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem upperShriek_restrictScalars (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hΛ₁ : (n : Λ₁) = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] :
    Nonempty (CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) ∧
      ∀ j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f),
        letI := DerivedUpperShriek.isLeftAdjoint_derivedLowerShriekUnbounded Λ₁ n hn hΛ₁ f j
        letI := DerivedUpperShriek.isLeftAdjoint_derivedLowerShriekUnbounded Λ₂ n hn
          (natCast_eq_zero_of_ringHom φ hΛ₁) f j
        Nonempty ((derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, 0} f j Λ₂).rightAdjoint ⋙
            derivedRestrictScalars.{u, 0} φ X ≅
          derivedRestrictScalars.{u, 0} φ Y ⋙
            (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, 0} f j Λ₁).rightAdjoint)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.module_finite_compactlySupportedCohomologyGroup_of_isConstructible
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be an algebraically closed field, `X` a separated scheme of finite type over `k` (a
scheme of a big étale site `B`, with structure morphism `f`), `j` a compactification of `X` over
`k`, through which `Hⁱ_c(X, -)` is formed, and `Λ` a Noetherian ring.
1. If `K ∈ D⁺(X_étale, Λ)` has constructible torsion cohomology sheaves, every `Hⁱ_c(X, K)` is a
   finite `Λ`-module.
2. If `Λ` is torsion and `K ∈ D(X_étale, Λ)` has constructible cohomology sheaves, every
   `Hⁱ_c(X, K)` is a finite `Λ`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem module_finite_compactlySupportedCohomologyGroup_of_isConstructible
