**Stacks 0GPU, the extension class.**  Let `α : P → B` be a presentation of the
`A`-algebra `B` with relation ideal `J`, let `0 → N → B' → B → 0` be a square-zero extension
of `A`-algebras, let `α' : P → B'` be an `A`-algebra lift of `α`, and let `δ : J/J² → N` be
the `B`-linear factorisation of `α'|_J`.  Then the classification of Stacks 0GPT, carried to
the cokernel `Coker(Hom_B(Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B, N) → Hom_B(J/J², N))` which computes
`Ext¹_B(NL(α), N)`, sends the extension to the class of `δ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extensionClass_eq_conormalCokernelClass
    {ι : Type uι} (P : Algebra.Generators A B ι)
    (X : (algebraExtensionProblem A B N).CompatibleExtension.{max uB uN})
    (lift : P.Ring →ₐ[A] X.B')
    (hlift : ∀ p, X.toB (lift p) = algebraMap P.Ring B p)
    (δ : P.toExtension.Cotangent →ₗ[B] N)
    (hδ : ∀ y : P.toExtension.ker,
      kernelVal X (δ (Algebra.Extension.Cotangent.mk y)) = lift (y : P.toExtension.Ring))
    (ψ : P.toExtension.Hom (Algebra.Generators.self A B).toExtension) :
    presentationComparison P ψ
        (extCokernelIso A B N (squareZeroAlgebraExtensionClassesEquivExtOne A B N
          (Quotient.mk (SquareZeroExtensionProblem.CompatibleExtension.isomorphicSetoid
            (algebraExtensionProblem A B N)) X))) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk δ
declarations.comment: extension_class

declarations.name: NaiveCotangent.extOne_naiveCotangentComplex_addEquiv_cokernel
declarations.doc:
The comparison which computes the first Ext group of the naive cotangent complex of a
polynomial presentation. On the right, the cokernel is represented as the quotient by the
range of precomposition with the conormal differential.

It is the underlying additive equivalence of
`extOne_naiveCotangentComplex_linearEquiv_cokernel`, so the two cannot drift apart; use that
one for anything involving scalars.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def extOne_naiveCotangentComplex_addEquiv_cokernel
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {ι : Type uι} {N : Type uN}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (P : Algebra.Generators A B ι) [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N] :
    DerivedCategory.Ext
        ((DerivedCategory.Q :
            CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max uA uB uι uN} B) ℤ ⥤ _).obj
          (CochainComplex.mappingCone
            ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max uA uB uι uN} B) 0).map
              (ModuleCat.ofHom
                (ULift.moduleEquiv.{uB, max (max uA uB) uι,
                  max uA uB uι uN}.symm.toLinearMap.comp
                  ((NaiveCotangent.NL P).d.comp
                    ULift.moduleEquiv.{uB, max uA uι,
                      max uA uB uι uN}.toLinearMap))))))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max uA uB uι uN} B) 0).obj
          (ModuleCat.of B (ULift.{max uA uB uι uN} N))) 1 ≃+
      ((P.toExtension.Cotangent →ₗ[B] N) ⧸ LinearMap.range
        ((LinearMap.lcomp B N (NaiveCotangent.NL P).d) :
          (P.toExtension.CotangentSpace →ₗ[B] N) →ₗ[B]
            (P.toExtension.Cotangent →ₗ[B] N)))
declarations.comment: ext_cokernel

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.exists_compatible_algebraMap_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GPV.**  Given ring maps `A → B → C`, a `B`-module `M`, a `C`-module `N`, a
`B`-linear map `c : M → N`, a square-zero extension `0 → M → B' → B → 0` of `A`-algebras with
class `ξ ∈ Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, M)` and a square-zero extension `0 → N → C' → C → 0` of
`A`-algebras with class `ζ ∈ Ext¹_C(NL_{C/A}, N)`, there is an `A`-algebra map `B' → C'`
compatible with `B → C` and with `c` if and only if `ξ` and `ζ` have the same image in
`Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, N)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_compatible_algebraMap_iff :
    (∃ h : X.B' →ₐ[A] Y.B',
        (∀ z : X.B', Y.toB (h z) = algebraMap B C (X.toB z)) ∧
          ∀ m : M, h (kernelInclusion X m) = kernelInclusion Y (c m)) ↔
      naiveCotangentExtOneMap A B c (squareZeroAlgebraExtensionClassesEquivExtOne A B M
          (Quotient.mk (SquareZeroExtensionProblem.CompatibleExtension.isomorphicSetoid
            (algebraExtensionProblem A B M)) X))
        = naiveCotangentExtOneTowerMap A B C
          (squareZeroAlgebraExtensionClassesEquivExtOne A C N
            (Quotient.mk (SquareZeroExtensionProblem.CompatibleExtension.isomorphicSetoid
              (algebraExtensionProblem A C N)) Y))

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.pullbackExtension
declarations.doc:
**The pullback extension `B'₂ = C' ×_C B`.**  Pulling the square-zero extension
`0 → N → C' → C → 0` of `A`-algebras back along `B → C` gives a square-zero extension
`0 → N → B'₂ → B → 0` of the `A`-algebra `B` by `N`.
declarations.statement:
public def pullbackExtension :
    (algebraExtensionProblem A B N).CompatibleExtension.{u}
declarations.comment: the pullback extension B'₂ = C' ×_C B; all five rings and modules in one universe

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.pullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**The map `B'₂ → C'`** of the remark's second displayed diagram: the first projection of the
fibre product.
declarations.statement: public def pullbackMap : ↥(pullbackSubalgebra A B C Y) →ₐ[A] Y.B'
declarations.comment: the map B'₂ → C' of the second displayed diagram

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.pushoutExtension
declarations.doc:
**The pushout extension `B'₁ = (N × B')/M`.**  Pushing the square-zero extension
`0 → M → B' → B → 0` of `A`-algebras out along `c : M → N` gives a square-zero extension
`0 → N → B'₁ → B → 0` of the `A`-algebra `B` by `N`.
declarations.statement: public def pushoutExtension : (algebraExtensionProblem A B N).CompatibleExtension.{u}
declarations.comment: the pushout extension B'₁ = (N × B')/M; all five rings and modules in one universe

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.pushoutMap
declarations.doc: **The map `B' → B'₁`** of the remark's first displayed diagram: `x ↦ [(0, x)]`.
declarations.statement: public def pushoutMap : X.B' →ₐ[A] (pushoutExtension c X).B'
declarations.comment: the map B' → B'₁ of the first displayed diagram

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.extClass_pushoutExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GPW.**  The pushout extension `B'₁` corresponds, under the classification of
**Stacks 0GPT**, to the image of the class of `B'` by the map
`Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, M) → Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, N)` induced by `c : M → N`.

This is **Stacks 0GPV** for the trivial tower `A → B → B`, applied to the map `B' → B'₁`
produced by the construction, together with the fact that the restriction map for that tower
is the identity.
declarations.comment: B'₁ corresponds to the image of ξ under Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, M) → Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, N)

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.extClass_pullbackExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GPW.**  The pullback extension `B'₂` corresponds, under the classification of
**Stacks 0GPT**, to the image of the class of `C'` by the map
`Ext¹_C(NL_{C/A}, N) → Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, N)`.

This is **Stacks 0GPV** applied to the projection `B'₂ → C'`, which is compatible with
`B → C` and with the identity of `N`, together with the fact that the map on first Ext
induced by the identity of `N` is the identity.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extClass_pullbackExtension
    (Y : (algebraExtensionProblem A C N).CompatibleExtension.{u}) :
    extClass (pullbackExtension A B C Y) = naiveCotangentExtOneTowerMap A B C (extClass Y)
declarations.comment: B'₂ corresponds to the image of ζ under Ext¹_C(NL_{C/A}, N) → Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, N)

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.isomorphic_pushoutExtension_pullbackExtension_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GPW**, the diagram chase.  There is an `A`-algebra map `B' → C'` compatible with
`B → C` and with `c : M → N` if and only if the pushout `B'₁` is isomorphic to the pullback
`B'₂` as `A`-algebra extensions of `B` by `N`.

The two directions are obtained from **Stacks 0GPV** together with the two class
identifications above and the injectivity of the classification of **Stacks 0GPT**.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isomorphic_pushoutExtension_pullbackExtension_iff (c : M →ₗ[B] N)
    (X : (algebraExtensionProblem A B M).CompatibleExtension.{u})
    (Y : (algebraExtensionProblem A C N).CompatibleExtension.{u}) :
    SquareZeroExtensionProblem.CompatibleExtension.Isomorphic
        (pushoutExtension c X) (pullbackExtension A B C Y) ↔
      ∃ h : X.B' →ₐ[A] Y.B',
        (∀ z : X.B', Y.toB (h z) = algebraMap B C (X.toB z)) ∧
          ∀ m : M, h (kernelInclusion X m) = kernelInclusion Y (c m)
declarations.comment: a compatible A-algebra map B' → C' exists iff B'₁ and B'₂ are isomorphic

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.baseExtClass
declarations.doc:
The canonical class `ξ ∈ Ext¹_A(NL_{A/A'}, I)` of the square-zero thickening `A'`: the
value of the classification of **Stacks 0GPT** on `baseExtension`.
declarations.statement: public def baseExtClass : naiveCotangentExtOne S.A' S.A S.I
declarations.comment: the class ξ of the thickening A', via Lemma 0GPT

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.solutionsFibre
declarations.doc:
The fibre of `Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A'}, N) → Ext¹_A(NL_{A/A'}, N)` over the image of the canonical
class `ξ` of the thickening `A'` under the map `Ext¹_A(NL_{A/A'}, I) → Ext¹_A(NL_{A/A'}, N)`
induced by `c : I → N`.
declarations.statement: public abbrev solutionsFibre
declarations.comment: the fibre over the image of the class of the thickening

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.solutionsEquivFibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GPX.**  Let `0 → I → A' → A → 0`, `A → B` and `c : I → N` be as in
**Stacks 08S4**, and let `ξ ∈ Ext¹_A(NL_{A/A'}, I)` be the class of the extension `A'` of `A`
by `I` under **Stacks 0GPT**.  The set of isomorphism classes of solutions of the extension
problem is canonically bijective to the fibre of
`Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A'}, N) → Ext¹_A(NL_{A/A'}, N)` over the image of `ξ`.

The bijection is the canonical one: it sends the class of a solution to the class of its
underlying square-zero extension of the `A'`-algebra `B` by `N`, as recorded by
`solutionsEquivFibre_apply`.
declarations.comment: solutions with middle ring in the universe max uB uN, as in Lemma 0GPT

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.solutionsEquivFibre_apply
declarations.doc:
The bijection of **Stacks 0GPX** sends the class of a solution to the class in
`Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A'}, N)` of its underlying square-zero extension of the `A'`-algebra `B` by
`N`.
declarations.statement:
public lemma solutionsEquivFibre_apply (P : S.CompatibleExtension.{max u₃ u₄}) :
    (solutionsEquivFibre S (Quotient.mk
      (SquareZeroExtensionProblem.CompatibleExtension.isomorphicSetoid S) P)).1
      = solutionExtClass S P
declarations.comment: the bijection sends a solution to the class of its underlying extension

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.naiveCotangentExtOneDerivedBaseChangeEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GPY**, first identification.  For `A' → A → B` and a `B`-module `M`, extension
classes of the naive cotangent complex of `A` over `A'` with coefficients in `M` regarded as an
`A`-module are the same as extension classes over `B` of its derived base change.  This is the
adjunction of Stacks 0GMT.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def naiveCotangentExtOneDerivedBaseChangeEquiv
    (A' : Type u₁) (A : Type u₂) (B : Type u₃) [CommRing A'] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A' A] [Algebra A B] (M : ModuleCat.{max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} B) :
    DerivedCategory.Ext
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (naiveCotangentCochainComplex.{u₁, u₂, max u₃ v} A' A))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} A) 0).obj
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A B)).obj M)) 1 ≃+
      DerivedCategory.Ext
        ((totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ v} (algebraMap A B)).functor.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (naiveCotangentCochainComplex.{u₁, u₂, max u₃ v} A' A)))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} B) 0).obj M) 1
declarations.comment: Ext¹_A(NL_{A/A'}, N) = Ext¹_B(NL_{A/A'} ⊗^L_A B, N), via Tag 0GMT

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.naiveCotangentDerivedBaseChangeExtOneEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GPY**, second identification.  Extension classes over `B` out of the derived base
change of the naive cotangent complex are the same as extension classes out of its termwise base
change.  The coefficient `M`, placed in degree `0` and shifted into degree `-1`, only sees the
truncation `τ_{≥ -1}`, which the termwise base change computes by Stacks 0FUY.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def naiveCotangentDerivedBaseChangeExtOneEquiv
    (A' : Type u₁) (A : Type u₂) (B : Type u₃) [CommRing A'] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A' A] [Algebra A B] (M : ModuleCat.{max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} B) :
    letI : (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} (algebraMap A B)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      ModuleCat.instIsLeftAdjointExtendScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ u₂ v} (algebraMap A B)
    DerivedCategory.Ext
        ((totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ v} (algebraMap A B)).functor.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (naiveCotangentCochainComplex.{u₁, u₂, max u₃ v} A' A)))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} B) 0).obj M) 1 ≃+
      DerivedCategory.Ext
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ u₂ u₃ v}
            (algebraMap A B)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
              (naiveCotangentCochainComplex.{u₁, u₂, max u₃ v} A' A)))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} B) 0).obj M) 1
declarations.comment: Ext¹_B(NL_{A/A'} ⊗^L_A B, N) = Ext¹_B(NL_{A/A'} ⊗_A B, N), via Tag 0FUY

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.naiveCotangentExtOneBaseChangeEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GPY**.  For `A' → A → B` and a `B`-module `M`, the first extension group of the
naive cotangent complex of `A` over `A'` with coefficients in `M` regarded as an `A`-module is
canonically the first extension group over `B` of the termwise base change `NL_{A/A'} ⊗_A B`
with coefficients in `M`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def naiveCotangentExtOneBaseChangeEquiv
    (A' : Type u₁) (A : Type u₂) (B : Type u₃) [CommRing A'] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A' A] [Algebra A B] (M : ModuleCat.{max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} B) :
    letI : (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} (algebraMap A B)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      ModuleCat.instIsLeftAdjointExtendScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ u₂ v} (algebraMap A B)
    DerivedCategory.Ext
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (naiveCotangentCochainComplex.{u₁, u₂, max u₃ v} A' A))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} A) 0).obj
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A B)).obj M)) 1 ≃+
      DerivedCategory.Ext
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ u₂ u₃ v}
            (algebraMap A B)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
              (naiveCotangentCochainComplex.{u₁, u₂, max u₃ v} A' A)))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ u₂ u₃ v} B) 0).obj M) 1

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.naiveCotangentExtOneBaseChangeModuleEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GPY**, stated for a `B`-module `N` and the Ext group
`Stacks.Deformation.naiveCotangentExtOne`: the first extension group over `A` of the naive
cotangent complex of `A` over `A'` with coefficients in `N`, which is an `A`-module by
restriction of scalars, is the first extension group over `B` of `NL_{A/A'} ⊗_A B`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def naiveCotangentExtOneBaseChangeModuleEquiv
    (A' : Type u₁) (A : Type u₂) (B : Type u₃) [CommRing A'] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A' A] [Algebra A B] (N : Type u₄) [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N] :
    letI : (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ u₂ u₃ u₄} (algebraMap A B)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      ModuleCat.instIsLeftAdjointExtendScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ u₂ u₄} (algebraMap A B)
    letI : Module A (ULift.{u₃} N) := Module.compHom _ (algebraMap A B)
    naiveCotangentExtOne A' A (ULift.{u₃} N) ≃+
      DerivedCategory.Ext
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u₂, u₃, max u₁ u₂ u₃ u₄}
            (algebraMap A B)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
              (naiveCotangentCochainComplex.{u₁, u₂, max u₃ u₄} A' A)))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ u₂ u₃ u₄} B) 0).obj
          ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{max u₁ u₂} B).obj
            (ModuleCat.of B (ULift.{u₃} N)))) 1
declarations.comment: for a module `N` and the Ext group `naiveCotangentExtOne`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.SquareZeroAlgebraExtension.isomorphismClassesEquivExt
declarations.doc:
Let `f : (X, 𝒪_X) ⟶ (S, 𝒪_S)` be a morphism of ringed spaces and `𝒢` an `𝒪_X`-module. The set
of isomorphism classes of extensions `0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪_{X'} ⟶ 𝒪_X ⟶ 0` of `f⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebras with `𝒢` an
ideal of square zero is canonically bijective to `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)`.

The bijection is the class map of **Stacks 0GQ0**: an extension goes to the class of the
homomorphism `𝒥/𝒥² ⟶ 𝒢` of the presentation of `𝒪_X` by the sheaf of sets underlying
`𝒪_{X'}`, read through the quasi-isomorphism of **Stacks 08TL**
(`isomorphismClassesEquivExt_apply`).
declarations.statement: def isomorphismClassesEquivExt : IsomorphismClasses f G ≃ extOneNaiveCotangent f G

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.trivialSolution
declarations.doc:
**The trivial square-zero extension is a solution of the problem of Stacks 08U7** over the
identity thickening of the base: `X' = (X, 𝒪_X ⋉ 𝒢)` is a first order thickening of `X` over
`S` whose ideal is `𝒢`. This is the base point the torsor of **Stacks 08UC** needs.
declarations.comment: the existence of a solution: the trivial extension 𝒪_X ⋉ 𝒢; not the bijection with Ext¹, which needs the torsor statement of 08UC

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.nonempty_deformationSolution
declarations.doc:
**The deformation problem of Stacks 08U7 over the identity thickening of the base has a
solution**, namely the trivial square-zero extension. This is the source's "there exists a
solution", i.e. what `[Nonempty Sol]` asks of `SolutionObstruction.addTorsor`.
declarations.comment: the existence of a solution, which is what the torsor of 08UC requires of the type of solutions; not the bijection with Ext¹

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.classesEquivExt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GPZ.** The isomorphism classes of square-zero extensions
`0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪_{X'} ⟶ 𝒪_X ⟶ 0` of `f⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebras — equivalently, of first order thickenings
`i : X ⟶ X'` over `S` with `Ker(i^♯) ≅ 𝒢`, i.e. of solutions of the problem of **Stacks 08U7**
over the identity thickening of the base — are in bijection with `Ext¹(NL(α), 𝒢)`.

The bijection is the torsor of **Stacks 08UC** evaluated at the base point supplied by the
trivial extension `𝒪_X ⋉ 𝒢`: a class `q` goes to the obstruction class separating it from the
class of `𝒪_X ⋉ 𝒢`, and a class `ξ` of `Ext¹` goes to the class of the solution obtained from
`𝒪_X ⋉ 𝒢` by twisting with `ξ`. The four fields of `SolutionObstruction` remain inputs; see
the implementation notes of this file and of
`StacksFrontier/Deformation/RingedSpaceThickening/SolutionTorsor.lean`.
declarations.statement:
def classesEquivExt (P : NaiveCotangentTwoTerm single)
    (xi : DeformationSolution (𝟙 S) ht f G 0 → DeformationSolution (𝟙 S) ht f G 0 →
      (P.conormal ⟶ G))
    (hxi : ∀ Q₁ Q₂ Q₃ : DeformationSolution (𝟙 S) ht f G 0, xi Q₁ Q₂ + xi Q₂ Q₃ = xi Q₁ Q₃)
    (rep : ∀ ξ : P.obj ⟶ (single.obj G)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      { δ : P.conormal ⟶ G // liftingObstruction P G δ = ξ })
    (pushout : ∀ (Q : DeformationSolution (𝟙 S) ht f G 0) (δ : P.conormal ⟶ G),
      { Q' : DeformationSolution (𝟙 S) ht f G 0 // xi Q Q' = δ }) :
    (liftingObstructionSolution P G xi hxi rep pushout).IsomorphismClasses ≃
      (P.obj ⟶ (single.obj G)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
declarations.comment: the bijection, subject to four conditions on the type of solutions that remain inputs — the fields of SolutionObstruction: the difference cocycle xi of two solutions, its additivity hxi, the pushout construction realizing every class as a difference, and the representation rep of every class by a conormal homomorphism (08UB, whose change of presentation is 08TL). The two-term complex P is arbitrary, so the acting group is the Ext¹ of P — for P the complex of a fixed presentation α, that of α rather than Ext¹(NL_{X/S}, 𝒢), whose identification is 08TL

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.classesEquivExtRelative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GPZ.** The classes of square-zero extensions
`0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪_{X'} ⟶ 𝒪_X ⟶ 0` of `f⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebras are in bijection with
`Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)`, by sending an extension to its class.

Both halves are proved. Injectivity is by construction: the classes are the quotient of the
type of extensions by equality of their class in `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)`, a relation which a
morphism of extensions forces by
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.extClassDiff_eq_zero_of_hom` and which is read as the
vanishing of an obstruction class over a common refinement by
`...extClassDiff_eq_zero_iff_pairRefinement`. Surjectivity is
`...exists_extension_extClass_eq`: the square-zero pushout of a presentation along a conormal
homomorphism representing the class, which exists by **Stacks 08UB**.

The acting group is the group of the tag, and the bijection is the one of the torsor
`addTorsorExtensionClasses` read at a base point.
declarations.statement:
def classesEquivExtRelative :
    ExtensionClasses (realizeExtClassDiff (f := f) (G := G)) ≃
      (PresentedSquareZeroExtension.relativeObj f ⟶
        PresentedSquareZeroExtension.shiftedSingleObj G)
declarations.comment: the bijection, unconditional, with the acting group of the tag: Ext¹(𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢) itself. The set counted is the classes of square-zero extensions of f⁻¹𝒪_S-algebras under equality of their class in that group; a morphism of extensions forces that equality by extClass_eq_extClass_of_hom, and that the converse holds too — so that the relation is isomorphism of extensions — is clause (1) of 08U8, a separate tag, not reproved here

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.TrivialSqZero.isFirstOrderThickening_thickening
declarations.doc:
**`i : X ⟶ X'` is a first order thickening**: the square of the kernel ideal of `i^♯`
over an open is generated by products of sections killed by `i^♯`, all of which vanish.
declarations.statement: theorem isFirstOrderThickening_thickening : IsFirstOrderThickening (thickening X G)
declarations.comment: the solution 𝒢 ⊕ 𝒪_X of the proof: it is a first order thickening of X; not the bijection with Ext¹, which needs the torsor statement of 08UC

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.TrivialSqZero.idealSheafIso
declarations.doc:
**The ideal of the trivial square-zero thickening is `𝒢`**: the canonical isomorphism
`Ker(i^♯) ≅ i_* 𝒢` of `𝒪_{X'}`-modules coming from the kernel property of the inclusion.
declarations.comment: the solution 𝒢 ⊕ 𝒪_X of the proof: the identification of 𝒢 with Ker(i^♯); not the bijection with Ext¹, which needs the torsor statement of 08UC

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.TrivialSqZero.thickening_comp_over
declarations.doc: `i : X ⟶ X'` is a morphism over `S`.
declarations.statement: theorem thickening_comp_over (f : X ⟶ S) : thickening X G ≫ over (G := G) f = f
declarations.comment: the solution 𝒢 ⊕ 𝒪_X of the proof: the thickening is a thickening over S; not the bijection with Ext¹, which needs the torsor statement of 08UC

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.AlgebraSquareZeroExtension.lift_comp_reduction
declarations.doc:
The map determined by `α'` followed by the reduction `𝒪_{X'} ⟶ 𝒪_X` is the presentation
attached to `α`.
declarations.statement: theorem lift_comp_reduction : P.lift ≫ P.reduction = P.presentation
declarations.comment: the commutative diagram over 𝒪_{X'} ⟶ 𝒪_X for the choice of sheaf of sets ℰ that the source gives, namely the one underlying 𝒪_{X'} with α' the identity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.AlgebraSquareZeroExtension.presentation_isLocallySurjective
declarations.doc: The presentation `f⁻¹𝒪_S[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪_X` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
instance presentation_isLocallySurjective :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) P.presentation.hom
declarations.comment: surjectivity of f⁻¹𝒪_S[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪_X, which is what makes 𝖭𝖫(α) defined

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.AlgebraSquareZeroExtension.conormalToIdeal
declarations.doc: The map `𝒥/𝒥² ⟶ 𝒢` determined by `α'`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev conormalToIdeal :
    conormalSheaf.{u, u, u, u} (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      (freeAlgebraSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) (inverseImageBaseRing f)
        P.generators) X.sheaf P.presentation ⟶ G
declarations.comment: the map 𝒥/𝒥² ⟶ 𝒢 determined by α'; not the resulting element of Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫(α), 𝒢), whose agreement with the class of 𝒪_{X'} under the bijection of 0GPZ is not proved here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.AlgebraSquareZeroExtension.naiveCotangentIso
declarations.doc: The identification `𝖭𝖫(α) ≅ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}` in `D(𝒪_X)` given by the canonical comparison map.
declarations.comment: the identification 𝖭𝖫_{X/S} ≅ 𝖭𝖫(α) in D(𝒪_X) for the chosen ℰ, by 08TL

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.SquareZeroAlgebraExtension.isomorphismClassesEquivExt_mk_eq_presented
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ0.** Let `0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪_{X'} ⟶ 𝒪_X ⟶ 0` be an extension of
`f⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebras with `𝒢` an ideal of square zero, and let `ℰ` be any (pre)sheaf of sets with a
commutative diagram `α' : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪_{X'}`, `α : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪_X` over the reduction (`hα`) such that
`f⁻¹𝒪_S[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪_X` is surjective, with kernel `𝒥`. The map `f⁻¹𝒪_S[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪_{X'}` determined by
`α'` induces `𝒥/𝒥² ⟶ 𝒢` (`conormalToIdeal`); its class in `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫(α), 𝒢)`
(`conormalExtClass` on `𝖭𝖫(α) = (𝒥/𝒥² ⟶ Ω ⊗ 𝒪_X)`), carried to `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)` along
the identification `𝖭𝖫(α) ≅ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}` of **Stacks 08TL** (`naiveCotangentIso`), is the element
the canonical bijection of **Stacks 0GPZ** attaches to the class of `𝒪_{X'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isomorphismClassesEquivExt_mk_eq_presented (P : SquareZeroAlgebraExtension f G)
    (E : Functor (Opens X.carrier)ᵒᵖ (Type u))
    (α : E ⟶ underlyingPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.sheaf)
    (α' : E ⟶ underlyingPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) P.sheaf)
    (hα : α' ≫ P.generatorsMap = α)
    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      (generatorsPresentation f E α).hom] :
    (PresentedSquareZeroExtension.naiveCotangentIso f E α).inv ≫
        (PresentedSquareZeroExtension.twoTerm f E α).conormalExtClass G
          (P.withGenerators E α α' hα).conormalToIdeal =
      isomorphismClassesEquivExt f G ⟦P⟧

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff_pullbackExtClass_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ1.** Let `f : (X, 𝒪_X) ⟶ (S, 𝒪_S)` and `g : (Y, 𝒪_Y) ⟶ (X, 𝒪_X)` be
morphisms of ringed spaces, `ℱ` an `𝒪_X`-module, `𝒢` an `𝒪_Y`-module and `c : ℱ ⟶ g_*𝒢` a
`g`-map. Let `P : 0 ⟶ ℱ ⟶ 𝒪_{X'} ⟶ 𝒪_X ⟶ 0` be an extension of `f⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebras corresponding to
`ξ ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, ℱ)` and `Q : 0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪_{Y'} ⟶ 𝒪_Y ⟶ 0` an extension of
`g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebras corresponding to `ζ ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(𝖭𝖫_{Y/S}, 𝒢)` under the bijections of
Stacks 0GPZ. Then there is an `S`-morphism `g' : Y' ⟶ X'` compatible with `g` and `c` if and
only if `ξ` and `ζ` map to the same element of `Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(Lg^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)`: `ξ` through `Lg^*`
and the coefficient map `Lg^*ℱ ⟶ g^*ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` (the last map the adjoint of `c`), and `ζ` through
the canonical map `Lg^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{Y/S}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff_pullbackExtClass_eq (P : SquareZeroAlgebraExtension f F)
    (Q : SquareZeroAlgebraExtension (g ≫ f) G) (c : F ⟶ (modulePushforward g).obj G) :
    Nonempty (CompatibleMorphism P Q c) ↔
      pullbackExtClass g f (((modulePullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm c)
          (isomorphismClassesEquivExt f F (Quotient.mk _ P)) =
        restrictDerivedExtClass (derivedPullbackNaiveCotangentMap g f)
          (isomorphismClassesEquivExt (g ≫ f) G (Quotient.mk _ Q))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.exists_compatibleLift_iff_eq_pullbackExtClass
declarations.doc:
For the derived pullback `Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}`: a lift compatible with `f` and the prescribed map `c`
exists if and only if the class of the extension `𝒪_{X'}`, restricted along a comparison
`q : Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'}`, agrees with the image `pullbackExtClass f t c xi` of
`ξ ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_S}(𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}, 𝒥)` in `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}, 𝒢)`.  The compatible lifts are the
type `Lift`, identified by `e` with the factorizations of the difference homomorphism `δ` through
the degree `0` term, and `hcompat` says that the difference of the two classes is the
obstruction class.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_compatibleLift_iff_eq_pullbackExtClass {f : X ⟶ S} {t : S ⟶ S'}
    {J : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S)} {G : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)}
    (c : (modulePullback f).obj J ⟶ G)
    (q : derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t ⟶ relativeNaiveCotangentObj (f ≫ t))
    (P : NaiveCotangentTwoTerm
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0))
    (hP : P.obj = derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t)
    (δ : P.conormal ⟶ G) {Lift : Type*}
    (e : Lift ≃ {θ : P.base ⟶ G // P.d ≫ θ = δ})
    (xi : extOneNaiveCotangent t J) (ζ : extOneNaiveCotangent (f ≫ t) G)
    (hcompat : eqToHom hP ≫ (pullbackExtClass f t c xi - restrictDerivedExtClass q ζ) =
      P.conormalExtClass G δ) :
    Nonempty Lift ↔ pullbackExtClass f t c xi = restrictDerivedExtClass q ζ
declarations.comment: the criterion for the DERIVED pullback Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} of the source's statement, with the image of ξ the constructed map pullbackExtClass. Carried, exactly as in the degreewise form: the two-term structure P with hP, the bijection e of Steps 1 to 3 of 08U8, and hcompat, the 0GPZ/08U8 compatibility whose statement and proof the source omits

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.isSolutionClass_iff_eq_pullbackExtClass
declarations.doc:
Read on isomorphism classes: a class of square-zero extensions of `f^{-1}𝒪_{S'}`-algebras is
a class of solutions of **Stacks 08U7** exactly when its image under `E` restricts, along a
comparison `q : Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'}`, to the image of `ξ` in
`Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}, 𝒢)`.  Here `P` with `hP` is a two-term structure of
`Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}`, `e` and `hcompat` are the per-class bijections and compatibilities of
`exists_compatibleLift_iff_eq_pullbackExtClass`, and `E` is the bijection of **Stacks 0GPZ**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSolutionClass_iff_eq_pullbackExtClass
    (E : Quotient r ≃ extOneNaiveCotangent (f ≫ t) G)
    (q : derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t ⟶ relativeNaiveCotangentObj (f ≫ t))
    (xi : extOneNaiveCotangent t (baseIdealOnReduction t))
    (P : NaiveCotangentTwoTerm
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0))
    (hP : P.obj = derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t)
    (δ : Quotient r → (P.conormal ⟶ G))
    (e : ∀ p : Quotient r, SolutionInClass ht c r p ≃
      {θ : P.base ⟶ G // P.d ≫ θ = δ p})
    (hcompat : ∀ p : Quotient r, eqToHom hP ≫
      (pullbackExtClass f t c xi - restrictDerivedExtClass q (E p)) =
        P.conormalExtClass G (δ p))
    (p : Quotient r) :
    ExtensionOverBase.IsSolutionClass ht c r p ↔
      restrictDerivedExtClass q (E p) = pullbackExtClass f t c xi
declarations.comment: the criterion for the DERIVED pullback, read on isomorphism classes of extensions: this is the hcrit hypothesis of solutionsEquivExtFibre, proved rather than assumed. Carried are the two-term structure P with hP, the per-class bijections e of Steps 1 to 3 of 08U8, the per-class 0GPZ/08U8 compatibilities, and the 0GPZ bijection E

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.pulledNaiveCotangentComparison
declarations.doc:
The canonical comparison `g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{Y/S}`: the identification of `g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}` with the
base change of `𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}`, followed by the canonical base-change map for
`g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S ⟶ g⁻¹𝒪_X ⟶ 𝒪_Y`.
declarations.statement:
def pulledNaiveCotangentComparison (g : Y ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S) :
    pulledNaiveCotangentComplex.{u} g f ⟶ relativeNaiveCotangentComplex g f
declarations.comment: the canonical comparison g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{Y/S} along which ζ is read, for the degreewise pullback; the derived pullback Lg^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S} of the source's statement is not used

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.restrictExtClass
declarations.doc:
The map `Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(𝖭𝖫_{Y/S}, 𝒢) ⟶ Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)`: precomposition with the
canonical comparison of the naive cotangent complexes.
declarations.statement: def restrictExtClass (ζ : relativeExtGroup g f G) : pulledExtGroup g f G
declarations.comment: the map Ext¹(𝖭𝖫_{Y/S}, 𝒢) ⟶ Ext¹(g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢) in which ζ is read, the second of the two maps the source's proof constructs; the first, which goes through the derived pullback of 06YJ and the g-map c, is not constructed here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.exists_compatibleLift_iff_eq_restrictExtClass
declarations.doc:
An `S`-morphism `Y' ⟶ X'` compatible with `g` and the `g`-map `c` exists if and only if
`ξ = restrictExtClass g f G ζ` in `Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)`.

Here `δ : g^*(𝒥/𝒥²) ⟶ 𝒢` is a homomorphism out of the conormal term of the two-term structure
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.pulledNaiveCotangentTwoTerm g f`. The theorem takes as
hypotheses a bijection `e` between the type `Lift` of compatible morphisms and the factorizations
of `δ` through the degree `0` term `g^*Ω`, and the identity `hcompat`: the difference
`ξ - restrictExtClass g f G ζ` is the obstruction class of `δ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_compatibleLift_iff_eq_restrictExtClass
    (δ : (pulledNaiveCotangentTwoTerm g f).conormal ⟶ G) {Lift : Type*}
    (e : Lift ≃ {θ : (pulledNaiveCotangentTwoTerm g f).base ⟶ G //
      (pulledNaiveCotangentTwoTerm g f).d ≫ θ = δ})
    (ξ : pulledExtGroup g f G) (ζ : relativeExtGroup g f G)
    (hcompat : ξ - restrictExtClass g f G ζ =
      (pulledNaiveCotangentTwoTerm g f).conormalExtClass G δ) :
    Nonempty Lift ↔ ξ = restrictExtClass g f G ζ
declarations.comment: the equivalence, deduced from clause (1) of 08U8: the two Ext¹ classes agree exactly when a compatible S-morphism exists. The two-term structure of g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S} is now constructed rather than assumed, by pulledNaiveCotangentTwoTerm. Two conditions remain inputs: (i) the bijection e between the compatible S-morphisms and the factorizations of the difference homomorphism — Steps 1 to 3 of 08U8, an input there too — and (ii) hcompat, the compatibility between the constructions in the proofs of 0GPZ and 08U8 whose statement and proof the source omits. The class read off from ξ is taken as its image in Ext¹(g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢); the first of the source's two maps is not constructed here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.eq_restrictExtClass_iff_exists_factorization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ1**, with every input removed.  The two classes agree in
`Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)` if and only if their difference is the class of a homomorphism `δ`
out of the conormal term of `g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}` which factors through the degree `0` term.

The right hand side is the condition that Steps 1 to 3 of the proof of **Stacks 08U8** identify
with the existence of a compatible `S`-morphism `Y' ⟶ X'`.  Compared with
`exists_compatibleLift_iff_eq_restrictExtClass` the homomorphism `δ`, the type `Lift`, the
bijection `e` and the compatibility `hcompat` are all gone: the only binders are `g`, `f`, `𝒢`
and the two classes.  That statement follows from this one for every choice of them.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_restrictExtClass_iff_exists_factorization
    (ξ : pulledExtGroup g f G) (ζ : relativeExtGroup g f G) :
    ξ = restrictExtClass g f G ζ ↔
      ∃ δ : (pulledNaiveCotangentTwoTerm g f).conormal ⟶ G,
        ξ - restrictExtClass g f G ζ =
            (pulledNaiveCotangentTwoTerm g f).conormalExtClass G δ ∧
          Nonempty { θ : (pulledNaiveCotangentTwoTerm g f).base ⟶ G //
            (pulledNaiveCotangentTwoTerm g f).d ≫ θ = δ }
declarations.comment: the equivalence with every input removed: the two Ext¹ classes agree exactly when their difference is the class of a homomorphism δ out of the conormal term of g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S} which factors through the degree 0 term. The binders are g, f, 𝒢 and the two classes alone — there is no type of compatible morphisms, no bijection e and no compatibility hcompat — and this implies exists_compatibleLift_iff_eq_restrictExtClass of ExtensionClassComparison.lean for every choice of those four. The right hand side is the condition that Steps 1 to 3 of the proof of 08U8 identify with the existence of a compatible S-morphism Y' ⟶ X'; that identification is a separate result of the source, so the left hand side of the source's own equivalence is read here through it. The comparison group is the Ext¹ of the DEGREEWISE pullback g^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S} rather than of the derived pullback Lg^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S} of the source's statement, and ξ is a FREE ELEMENT of that group rather than the image of the class of the extension of 𝒪_X: the first of the source's two maps, which would carry that class in, is absent here

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.InverseImageExtension.Data.pullbackExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GQ2**, the second construction: pulling the extension
`0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪_{Y'} ⟶ 𝒪_Y ⟶ 0` back along `g^♯ : g^{-1}𝒪_X ⟶ 𝒪_Y` gives an extension
`0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪'₂ ⟶ g^{-1}𝒪_X ⟶ 0` of `g^{-1}f^{-1}𝒪_S`-algebras, with
`𝒪'₂ = 𝒪_{Y'} ×_{𝒪_Y} g^{-1}𝒪_X` the fibre product of sheaves of rings and the remark's second
displayed diagram its two projections.
declarations.statement: def pullbackExtension : AlgebraExtension S A (d.u ≫ d.π) d.N.val.presheaf
declarations.comment: the pullback extension 𝒪'₂ = 𝒪_{Y'} ×_{𝒪_Y} g⁻¹𝒪_X, with the second displayed diagram its projections. Carried: that g⁻¹𝒪_{X'} is an extension of g⁻¹𝒪_X by g⁻¹ℱ, and that 𝒢 is the square-zero ideal of 𝒪_{Y'} with its 𝒪_Y-action

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.InverseImageExtension.Data.pushoutExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GQ2**, the first construction: pushing the extension
`0 ⟶ g^{-1}ℱ ⟶ g^{-1}𝒪_{X'} ⟶ g^{-1}𝒪_X ⟶ 0` out along `c : g^{-1}ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` gives an extension
`0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪'₁ ⟶ g^{-1}𝒪_X ⟶ 0` of `g^{-1}f^{-1}𝒪_S`-algebras, with the remark's first
displayed diagram its comparison with `g^{-1}𝒪_{X'}`.
declarations.statement:
def pushoutExtension [K.WEqualsLocallyBijective CommRingCat.{u}] :
    AlgebraExtension S A (d.u ≫ d.π) d.N.val.presheaf
declarations.comment: the pushout extension 𝒪'₁ of g⁻¹𝒪_{X'} along c, with the first displayed diagram its comparison with g⁻¹𝒪_{X'}. Carried: that g⁻¹𝒪_{X'} is an extension of g⁻¹𝒪_X by g⁻¹ℱ, the ideal being Ker π

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.InverseImageExtension.Data.nonempty_compatibleHom_iff_isomorphic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GQ2**, the criterion.  An `S`-morphism `Y' → X'` compatible with `g` and `c`
exists if and only if the pushout `𝒪'₁` and the pullback `𝒪'₂` are isomorphic as
`g^{-1}f^{-1}𝒪_S`-algebra extensions of `g^{-1}𝒪_X` by `𝒢`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_compatibleHom_iff_isomorphic :
    Nonempty d.CompatibleHom ↔
      AlgebraExtension.Isomorphic d.pushoutExtension d.pullbackExtension
declarations.comment: the diagram chase: a compatible S-morphism Y' → X' exists iff 𝒪'₁ ≅ 𝒪'₂ as g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S-algebra extensions of g⁻¹𝒪_X by 𝒢. Carried: that g⁻¹𝒪_{X'} is an extension of g⁻¹𝒪_X by g⁻¹ℱ, and that 𝒢 is the square-zero ideal of 𝒪_{Y'} with its 𝒪_Y-action

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.inverseImageNaiveCotangentIso
declarations.doc:
The identification `g⁻¹𝖭𝖫_{X/S} = 𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}`: the canonical map
`π^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/(g ∘ f)⁻¹𝒪_S}` of naive cotangent complexes, as an isomorphism of
complexes of `g⁻¹𝒪_X`-modules.
declarations.statement:
def inverseImageNaiveCotangentIso :
    ((modulePullback (inverseImageProj g)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (show CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) ℤ from
          PresentedSquareZeroExtension.relativeComplex f) ≅
      (show CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing (inverseImageRingedSpace g))) ℤ from
          PresentedSquareZeroExtension.relativeComplex (inverseImageProj g ≫ f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.isomorphismClassesEquivExt_inverseImagePushout
declarations.doc:
The class, under the bijection of **Stacks 0GPZ** for the ringed space `(Y, g⁻¹𝒪_X)` over `S`,
of the pushout `𝒪'₁` of `0 ⟶ g⁻¹ℱ ⟶ g⁻¹𝒪_{X'} ⟶ g⁻¹𝒪_X ⟶ 0` along `c : g⁻¹ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` is the image
of the class `ξ` of `𝒪_{X'}` (under the bijection of **Stacks 0GPZ** for `X` over `S`): `g⁻¹ξ`
pushed along `c^♭ : g⁻¹ℱ ⟶ 𝒢`, read in `Ext¹_{g⁻¹𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}, 𝒢)` through the
identification `𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S} = g⁻¹𝖭𝖫_{X/S}` of **Stacks 08TM**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isomorphismClassesEquivExt_inverseImagePushout (P : SquareZeroAlgebraExtension f F)
    (c : F ⟶ (modulePushforward g).obj G) :
    SquareZeroAlgebraExtension.isomorphismClassesEquivExt (inverseImageSpaceHom f g)
        (restrictedModule g G) (Quotient.mk _ (inverseImagePushout G P c)) =
      inverseImageXiMap c
        (SquareZeroAlgebraExtension.isomorphismClassesEquivExt f F (Quotient.mk _ P))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.isomorphismClassesEquivExt_inverseImagePullback
declarations.doc:
**The class of `𝒪'₂`.** The class, under the bijection of **Stacks 0GPZ** for the ringed
space `(Y, g⁻¹𝒪_X)` over `S`, of the pullback `𝒪'₂ = 𝒪_{Y'} ×_{𝒪_Y} g⁻¹𝒪_X` is the image of the
class `ζ` of `𝒪_{Y'}` (under the bijection of **Stacks 0GPZ** for `Y` over `S`) by the canonical
map `Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(𝖭𝖫_{Y/S}, 𝒢) ⟶ Ext¹_{g⁻¹𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}, 𝒢)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isomorphismClassesEquivExt_inverseImagePullback
    {G : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology Y.carrier) Y.sheaf)}
    (Q : SquareZeroAlgebraExtension (g ≫ f) G) :
    SquareZeroAlgebraExtension.isomorphismClassesEquivExt (inverseImageSpaceHom f g)
        (restrictedModule g G) (Quotient.mk _ (inverseImagePullback Q)) =
      inverseImageExtMap
        (SquareZeroAlgebraExtension.isomorphismClassesEquivExt (g ≫ f) G (Quotient.mk _ Q))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.inverseImageExtEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The identification `Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(Lg^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢) = Ext¹_{g⁻¹𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}, 𝒢)` of
Stacks 0GQ2.** Through `Lg^* = Lι^* ∘ π^*` along `g = π ∘ ι`, the tensor–hom adjunction
`Lι^* ⊣ Rι_* = ι_*` (restriction of scalars along `g^♯ : g⁻¹𝒪_X ⟶ 𝒪_Y`), and the identification
`g⁻¹𝖭𝖫_{X/S} = 𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}` (`inverseImageNaiveCotangentIso`).

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.inverseImageExtEquiv_apply
declarations.doc:
**The identification `inverseImageExtEquiv` is the explicit composite**: the transposition
`liftProjTransport` along the adjunction `Lι^* ⊣ ι_*`, preceded by
`g⁻¹𝖭𝖫_{X/S} = 𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}` and followed by `ι_*(𝒢[1]) = (ι_*𝒢)[1]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem inverseImageExtEquiv_apply (z : extOnePulledNaiveCotangent g f G) :
    inverseImageExtEquiv f g G z =
      (DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso (inverseImageNaiveCotangentIso f g)).inv ≫
        liftProjTransport g (PresentedSquareZeroExtension.relativeComplex f) z ≫
        liftShiftSingleIso.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.inverseImageExtEquiv_restrictDerivedExtClass
declarations.doc:
**The image of `ζ` through `Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(Lg^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)` is its image in
`Ext¹_{g⁻¹𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}, 𝒢)`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem inverseImageExtEquiv_restrictDerivedExtClass (ζ : extOneNaiveCotangent (g ≫ f) G) :
    inverseImageExtEquiv f g G
        (restrictDerivedExtClass (derivedPullbackNaiveCotangentMap g f) ζ) =
      inverseImageExtMap ζ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.inverseImageExtEquiv_pullbackExtClass
declarations.doc:
**The image of `ξ` through `Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(Lg^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)` is its image in
`Ext¹_{g⁻¹𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}, 𝒢)`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem inverseImageExtEquiv_pullbackExtClass (P : SquareZeroAlgebraExtension f F)
    (c : F ⟶ (modulePushforward g).obj G) :
    inverseImageExtEquiv f g G (pullbackExtClass g f (LiftGluing.cAdj g c) P.extClass) =
      inverseImageXiMap c P.extClass

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff_isomorphismClassesEquivExt_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GQ2, the classification.** By the diagram chase and the bijection of Stacks 0GPZ for
the ringed space `(Y, g⁻¹𝒪_X)` over `S`, an `S`-morphism `Y' ⟶ X'` compatible with `g` and `c`
exists if and only if the extensions `𝒪'₁` and `𝒪'₂` have the same class in
`Ext¹_{g⁻¹𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}, 𝒢)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff_isomorphismClassesEquivExt_eq
    (P : SquareZeroAlgebraExtension f F) (Q : SquareZeroAlgebraExtension (g ≫ f) G)
    (c : F ⟶ (modulePushforward g).obj G) :
    Nonempty (CompatibleMorphism P Q c) ↔
      SquareZeroAlgebraExtension.isomorphismClassesEquivExt (inverseImageSpaceHom f g)
          (restrictedModule g G) (Quotient.mk _ (inverseImagePushout G P c)) =
        SquareZeroAlgebraExtension.isomorphismClassesEquivExt (inverseImageSpaceHom f g)
          (restrictedModule g G) (Quotient.mk _ (inverseImagePullback Q))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff_images_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GQ2, the final deduction.** An `S`-morphism `Y' ⟶ X'` compatible with `g` and `c`
exists if and only if `ξ` and `ζ` have the same image in `Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(Lg^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)`: through the
identification `Ext¹_{g⁻¹𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{g⁻¹𝒪_X/g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S}, 𝒢) = Ext¹_{𝒪_Y}(Lg^*𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)`
(`inverseImageExtEquiv`), the class of `𝒪'₁` is the image of `ξ` and the class of `𝒪'₂` is the
image of `ζ`, so this is `nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff_isomorphismClassesEquivExt_eq`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff_images_eq
    (P : SquareZeroAlgebraExtension f F) (Q : SquareZeroAlgebraExtension (g ≫ f) G)
    (c : F ⟶ (modulePushforward g).obj G) :
    Nonempty (CompatibleMorphism P Q c) ↔
      pullbackExtClass g f (LiftGluing.cAdj g c)
          (SquareZeroAlgebraExtension.isomorphismClassesEquivExt f F (Quotient.mk _ P)) =
        restrictDerivedExtClass (derivedPullbackNaiveCotangentMap g f)
          (SquareZeroAlgebraExtension.isomorphismClassesEquivExt (g ≫ f) G (Quotient.mk _ Q))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.inverseImagePushout
declarations.doc:
**The extension `𝒪'₁` of Stacks 0GQ2**: the pushout of
`0 ⟶ g⁻¹ℱ ⟶ g⁻¹𝒪_{X'} ⟶ g⁻¹𝒪_X ⟶ 0` along `c : g⁻¹ℱ ⟶ 𝒢`, an extension
`0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪'₁ ⟶ g⁻¹𝒪_X ⟶ 0` of `g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebras, that is, a square-zero extension over the
ringed space `(Y, g⁻¹𝒪_X)` and its morphism to `S`. Here `g⁻¹ℱ` is the kernel of the inverse
image `g⁻¹𝒪_{X'} ⟶ g⁻¹𝒪_X` of the reduction, and `c` on it is `idealMap`.
declarations.statement:
def inverseImagePushout :
    SquareZeroAlgebraExtension (inverseImageSpaceHom f g) (restrictedModule g G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.inverseImagePullback
declarations.doc:
**The extension `𝒪'₂` of Stacks 0GQ2**: the pullback of `0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪_{Y'} ⟶ 𝒪_Y ⟶ 0` along
`g^♯ : g⁻¹𝒪_X ⟶ 𝒪_Y`, the extension `0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪_{Y'} ×_{𝒪_Y} g⁻¹𝒪_X ⟶ g⁻¹𝒪_X ⟶ 0` of
`g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebras; its two projections are the second displayed diagram.
declarations.statement:
def inverseImagePullback :
    SquareZeroAlgebraExtension (inverseImageSpaceHom f g) (restrictedModule g G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff_nonempty_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GQ2, the diagram chase.** An `S`-morphism `Y' ⟶ X'` compatible with `g` and `c`
exists if and only if `𝒪'₁` and `𝒪'₂` are isomorphic as `g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebra extensions of
`g⁻¹𝒪_X` by `𝒢`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff_nonempty_iso :
    Nonempty (CompatibleMorphism P Q c) ↔
      Nonempty (inverseImagePushout G P c ≅ inverseImagePullback Q)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.DeformationSolution.isomorphismClassesEquivExtFibre
declarations.doc:
Let `t : (S, 𝒪_S) ⟶ (S', 𝒪_{S'})` be a first order thickening, `𝒥 = Ker(t^♯)`
(`baseIdealModule`), `f : (X, 𝒪_X) ⟶ (S, 𝒪_S)`, `𝒢` an `𝒪_X`-module and `c : 𝒥 ⟶ 𝒢` as in (08U7):
here `c` is given, as in `DeformationSolution`, by `c' : f^*t^*Ker(t^♯) ⟶ 𝒢`, and is
`f^*𝒥 ≅ f^*t^*Ker(t^♯) ⟶ 𝒢` (`baseIdealIsoPullback`). Let `ξ ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_S}(𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}, 𝒥)` be the
element corresponding to the extension `𝒪_{S'}` of `𝒪_S` by `𝒥` via **Stacks 0GPZ** (`baseClass`).
The set of isomorphism classes of solutions of (08U7) (first order thickenings `X ⟶ X'` with a
morphism of thickenings to `S ⟶ S'`, `Ker ≅ 𝒢` and inducing `c`, up to the isomorphism `Isomorphic`
of **Stacks 08UC**) is canonically bijective to the fibre of

`Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{X/S'}, 𝒢) ⟶ Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}, 𝒢)`

over the image of `ξ`: the map is precomposition with the canonical comparison
`Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'}` (through the derived pullback `Lf^*` of **Stacks 06YJ**), and the
image of `ξ` is `Lf^*ξ` pushed along `Lf^*𝒥 ⟶ f^*𝒥 ⟶ 𝒢` (`pullbackExtClass`). The bijection sends
a solution `X'` to the class, under **Stacks 0GPZ** for `X ⟶ S'`, of `𝒪_{X'}` read as an extension
of `f⁻¹𝒪_{S'}`-algebras (`DeformationSolution.isomorphismClassesEquivExtFibre_mk`).

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.solutionsEquivDerivedExtFibre
declarations.doc:
In the situation of **Stacks 08U7**, with `ξ` the class of the extension `𝒪_{S'}` of `𝒪_S`
by `𝒥`, the isomorphism classes of solutions are canonically bijective to the fibre of

`Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{X/S'}, 𝒢) ⟶ Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}, 𝒢)`

over the image of `ξ`, by the map `[X'] ↦ E [𝒪_{X'}]`.  Here `E` is the bijection of
**Stacks 0GPZ**, `q` the comparison of naive cotangent complexes, and `P`, `hP`, `δ`, `e`,
`hcompat` the inputs of `isSolutionClass_iff_eq_pullbackExtClass`.
declarations.statement:
def solutionsEquivDerivedExtFibre
    (E : Quotient r ≃ extOneNaiveCotangent (f ≫ t) G)
    (q : derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t ⟶ relativeNaiveCotangentObj (f ≫ t))
    (xi : extOneNaiveCotangent t (baseIdealOnReduction t))
    (P : NaiveCotangentTwoTerm
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0))
    (hP : P.obj = derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t)
    (δ : Quotient r → (P.conormal ⟶ G))
    (e : ∀ p : Quotient r, SolutionInClass ht c r p ≃
      {θ : P.base ⟶ G // P.d ≫ θ = δ p})
    (hcompat : ∀ p : Quotient r, eqToHom hP ≫
      (pullbackExtClass f t c xi - restrictDerivedExtClass q (E p)) =
        P.conormalExtClass G (δ p)) :
    Quotient (solutionSetoid ht c r) ≃
      {z : extOneNaiveCotangent (f ≫ t) G //
        restrictDerivedExtClass q z = pullbackExtClass f t c xi}
declarations.comment: the canonical bijection from isomorphism classes of solutions of 08U7 to the fibre of Ext¹(𝖭𝖫_{X/S'}, 𝒢) ⟶ Ext¹(Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}, 𝒢) over the image of ξ, by the constructed map [X'] ↦ E [𝒪_{X'}]. Carried: the 0GPZ bijection E, the comparison q, and the inputs P, hP, δ, e, hcompat of the 0GQ1 criterion — which is proved here, not assumed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.solutionsEquivDerivedExtFibre_apply
declarations.doc:
The bijection `solutionsEquivDerivedExtFibre` sends the class of a solution `X'` to
`E [𝒪_{X'}]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem solutionsEquivDerivedExtFibre_apply
    (E : Quotient r ≃ extOneNaiveCotangent (f ≫ t) G)
    (q : derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t ⟶ relativeNaiveCotangentObj (f ≫ t))
    (xi : extOneNaiveCotangent t (baseIdealOnReduction t))
    (P : NaiveCotangentTwoTerm
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0))
    (hP : P.obj = derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t)
    (δ : Quotient r → (P.conormal ⟶ G))
    (e : ∀ p : Quotient r, SolutionInClass ht c r p ≃
      {θ : P.base ⟶ G // P.d ≫ θ = δ p})
    (hcompat : ∀ p : Quotient r, eqToHom hP ≫
      (pullbackExtClass f t c xi - restrictDerivedExtClass q (E p)) =
        P.conormalExtClass G (δ p))
    (s : Quotient (solutionSetoid ht c r)) :
    (solutionsEquivDerivedExtFibre ht c r E q xi P hP δ e hcompat s).1 =
      solutionClassToExtClass ht c r E s
declarations.comment: the canonicity of the bijection: it is the constructed map [X'] ↦ E [𝒪_{X'}], sending the class of a solution to the class of its underlying extension read through the 0GPZ bijection, rather than an unspecified bijection of the two sides

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.naiveCotangentRemarkArrows
declarations.doc:
The two maps `Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}` in `D(𝒪_X)`. The first is the canonical
map of **Stacks 0GQ1** through the derived pullback of **Stacks 06YJ**, the second is induced by
the tower `(f ≫ t)^{-1}𝒪_{S'} ⟶ f^{-1}𝒪_S ⟶ 𝒪_X`.
declarations.statement:
def naiveCotangentRemarkArrows (f : X ⟶ S) (t : S ⟶ S') :
    ComposableArrows (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))) 2

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.DeformationSolution.nonempty_iff_obstructionExtClass_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
In the situation of **Stacks 0GQ3** (a first order thickening `t : S ⟶ S'` with ideal `𝒥`,
`f : X ⟶ S`, an `𝒪_X`-module `𝒢` and `c : f^*𝒥 ⟶ 𝒢`, here `f^*𝒥 ≅ f^*t^*Ker(t^♯) ⟶ 𝒢` with `c'`),
let `ξ` be the class of the extension `𝒪_{S'}` of `𝒪_S` by `𝒥` under **Stacks 0GPZ** (`baseClass`).
*If* the two maps `Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}` form a distinguished triangle with some
connecting map `w`, then a solution of (08U7) exists if and only if the image of `ξ` in
`Ext²_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)` — the image of `ξ` in `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}, 𝒢)`
(`pullbackExtClass`) composed with `w` — vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem DeformationSolution.nonempty_iff_obstructionExtClass_eq_zero
    (w : relativeNaiveCotangentObj f ⟶ (derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (htri : Triangle.mk (derivedPullbackNaiveCotangentMap f t)
        (relativeNaiveCotangentObjMap f t) w ∈
      distTriang (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)))) :
    Nonempty (DeformationSolution t ht f G c') ↔
      obstructionExtClass w (pullbackExtClass f t
        ((modulePullback f).map (baseIdealIsoPullback ht).hom ≫ c') (baseClass ht)) = 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.naiveCotangentRemark_closeToDistinguishedTriangle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ4**, what the remark's two maps
`Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}` satisfy: they are *close to* forming a distinguished
triangle, by **Stacks 0E1Z**.  Precisely:

* the composite `Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}` vanishes in `D(𝒪_X)`;
* the first map factors as the comparison `Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ f^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'}` of **Stacks 06YJ**
  (an isomorphism on `H⁰`) followed by the canonical map `f^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'}`;
* the second map sits in a distinguished triangle `C[-1] ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S} ⟶ C`, with
  `C` the cone of `𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}`;
* the canonical map `f^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ C[-1]` of **Stacks 0E1Z** lifts `f^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'}`
  along `C[-1] ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'}`, is an isomorphism on `H⁰` and is surjective on `H⁻¹`.

So the maps form a distinguished triangle exactly when the comparison with the cone is an
isomorphism; the remark only says they are close to one, and nothing more is claimed.
declarations.statement:
theorem naiveCotangentRemark_closeToDistinguishedTriangle :
    derivedPullbackNaiveCotangentMap f t ≫ relativeNaiveCotangentObjMap f t = 0 ∧
    remarkPullbackComparison f t ≫ remarkPulledMap f t = derivedPullbackNaiveCotangentMap f t ∧
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0).map
      (remarkPullbackComparison f t)) ∧
    remarkConeTriangle f t ∈ distTriang _ ∧
    (remarkConeTriangle f t).mor₂ = relativeNaiveCotangentObjMap f t ∧
    remarkConeMap f t ≫ (remarkConeTriangle f t).mor₁ = remarkPulledMap f t ∧
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0).map
      (remarkConeMap f t)) ∧
    Epi ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) (-1)).map
      (remarkConeMap f t))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.naiveCotangentCompComplexMap
declarations.doc:
The map of complexes `𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}`: the canonical map of a tower of sheaves of
rings on `X`, taken at `(f ≫ t)^{-1}𝒪_{S'} ⟶ f^{-1}𝒪_S ⟶ 𝒪_X`.
declarations.statement:
public def naiveCotangentCompComplexMap (f : X ⟶ S) (t : S ⟶ S') :
    RingedSpace.naiveCotangentComplex (f ≫ t) ⟶ RingedSpace.naiveCotangentComplex f
declarations.comment: the second map of complexes of the remark, 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.derivedPullbackNaiveCotangentChain
declarations.doc:
The chain `Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}`, composed in `D(𝒪_X)`: the first map
is the given comparison `q`, the second is `relativeNaiveCotangentObjMap`.
declarations.comment: the remark's chain Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, with q carried

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.nonempty_deformationSolution_iff_obstruction_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
In the situation of **Stacks 0GQ3**, *given* that the two maps
`Lf^*𝖭𝖫_{S/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S'} ⟶ 𝖭𝖫_{X/S}` form a distinguished triangle with connecting morphism
`w`, the deformation problem of **Stacks 08U7** has a solution exactly when the image of `ξ` in
`Ext²_{𝒪_X}(𝖭𝖫_{X/S}, 𝒢)` vanishes; that image is therefore the obstruction.

The triangle is a hypothesis, not a claim: the source only says that the two maps are close to
forming a distinguished triangle, and its conclusion is drawn under that assumption.  The
remaining arguments are those of `solutionsEquivDerivedExtFibre`, which supplies the bijection
of **Stacks 0GQ3** between isomorphism classes of solutions and the fibre over the image of
`ξ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_deformationSolution_iff_obstruction_eq_zero
    (E : Quotient r ≃ extOneNaiveCotangent (f ≫ t) G)
    (q : derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t ⟶ relativeNaiveCotangentObj (f ≫ t))
    (xi : extOneNaiveCotangent t (baseIdealOnReduction t))
    (P : NaiveCotangentTwoTerm
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0))
    (hP : P.obj = derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t)
    (δ : Quotient r → (P.conormal ⟶ G))
    (e : ∀ p : Quotient r, SolutionInClass ht c r p ≃
      {θ : P.base ⟶ G // P.d ≫ θ = δ p})
    (hcompat : ∀ p : Quotient r, eqToHom hP ≫
      (pullbackExtClass f t c xi - restrictDerivedExtClass q (E p)) =
        P.conormalExtClass G (δ p))
    (w : relativeNaiveCotangentObj f ⟶ (derivedPullbackNaiveCotangent f t)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (htri : Triangle.mk q (relativeNaiveCotangentObjMap f t) w ∈
      distTriang (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)))) :
    Nonempty (DeformationSolution t ht f G c) ↔
      obstructionExtClass w (pullbackExtClass f t c xi) = 0
declarations.comment: the conditional: given the triangle, ξ's image in Ext² obstructs 08U7

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.classesEquivExt
declarations.doc:
The isomorphism classes of square-zero extensions `0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪 ⟶ 0` of `f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ`-algebras —
equivalently, of first order thickenings over the base with an `𝒪`-module isomorphism
`𝒢 ≅ Ker(i^♯)`, i.e. of solutions of the problem of [Stacks 08UF] whose base reduction is
invertible — are in bijection with `Ext¹(NL(α), 𝒢)`.

The bijection is the torsor of [Stacks 08UK] evaluated at the base point supplied by the trivial
extension `𝒪 ⋉ 𝒢`: a class `q` goes to the obstruction class separating it from the class of
`𝒪 ⋉ 𝒢`, and a class `ξ` of `Ext¹` goes to the class of the solution obtained from `𝒪 ⋉ 𝒢` by
twisting with `ξ`. The five inputs — the four of
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.SolutionObstruction` and the lift bijection `e` of
[Stacks 08UG] — remain hypotheses; see the implementation notes of this file.
declarations.statement:
def classesEquivExt (h : IsIso S.baseReduction) (P : NaiveCotangentTwoTerm single)
    (xi : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening → S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening →
      (P.conormal ⟶ S.G))
    (hxi : ∀ Q₁ Q₂ Q₃ : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening,
      xi Q₁ Q₂ + xi Q₂ Q₃ = xi Q₁ Q₃)
    (rep : ∀ ξ : P.obj ⟶ (single.obj S.G)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      { δ : P.conormal ⟶ S.G // liftingObstruction P S.G δ = ξ })
    (pushout : ∀ (Q : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening) (δ : P.conormal ⟶ S.G),
      { Q' : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening // xi Q Q' = δ })
    (e : ∀ Q₁ Q₂ : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening,
      CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.Hom Q₁ Q₂ ≃
        { θ : P.base ⟶ S.G // P.d ≫ θ = xi Q₁ Q₂ }) :
    CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.IsomorphismClasses S ≃
      (P.obj ⟶ (single.obj S.G)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
declarations.comment: the bijection between isomorphism classes of square-zero extensions of 𝒪 by 𝒢 as f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ-algebras and Ext¹ of a FIXED presentation α, carrying the four inputs of SolutionObstruction (xi, hxi, rep, pushout) and the lift bijection e of 08UG; identifying Ext¹(NL(α), 𝒢) with Ext¹(NL_{𝒪/𝒪_ℬ}, 𝒢) is 08TY and 08TL, absent on a general site

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.classesEquivExt_trivialSolution
declarations.doc:
**The bijection `classesEquivExt` is the canonical one.** It carries the isomorphism class of
the trivial square-zero extension `𝒪 ⋉ 𝒢` to `0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem classesEquivExt_trivialSolution (h : IsIso S.baseReduction)
    (P : NaiveCotangentTwoTerm single)
    (xi : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening → S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening →
      (P.conormal ⟶ S.G))
    (hxi : ∀ Q₁ Q₂ Q₃ : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening,
      xi Q₁ Q₂ + xi Q₂ Q₃ = xi Q₁ Q₃)
    (rep : ∀ ξ : P.obj ⟶ (single.obj S.G)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      { δ : P.conormal ⟶ S.G // liftingObstruction P S.G δ = ξ })
    (pushout : ∀ (Q : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening) (δ : P.conormal ⟶ S.G),
      { Q' : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening // xi Q Q' = δ })
    (e : ∀ Q₁ Q₂ : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening,
      CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.Hom Q₁ Q₂ ≃
        { θ : P.base ⟶ S.G // P.d ≫ θ = xi Q₁ Q₂ }) :
    S.classesEquivExt h P xi hxi rep pushout e
        (Quotient.mk (CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.isomorphicSetoid S)
          (S.trivialSolution h)) = 0
declarations.comment: that the bijection is canonical: the class of the trivial extension 𝒪 ⋉ 𝒢 goes to 0; the hypotheses carried are those of the bijection itself

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ5.** Let `f : (Sh(𝒞), 𝒪) ⟶ (Sh(ℬ), 𝒪_ℬ)` be a morphism of ringed
topoi and `𝒢` an `𝒪`-module. The set of isomorphism classes of extensions of
`f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ`-algebras `0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪 ⟶ 0` with `𝒢` an ideal of square zero — the solutions of the
problem `ofTrivialBase f 𝒢` — is canonically bijective to `Ext¹_𝒪(NL_{𝒪/𝒪_ℬ}, 𝒢)`.

The bijection is the one of the source's proof: the torsor of [Stacks 08UK] under
`Ext¹_𝒪(NL_{𝒪/𝒪_ℬ}, 𝒢)` with base point the trivial extension `𝒪 ⊕ 𝒢`. The class of `𝒪'` goes
to the obstruction class `o(𝒪 ⊕ 𝒢, 𝒪')` (`squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv_mk`), and `ξ` goes to
the class of the pushout extension `(𝒪 ⊕ 𝒢)_ξ` (`squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv_symm_apply`).
declarations.statement:
def squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv :
    CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.IsomorphismClasses (ofTrivialBase f G) ≃
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.naiveCotangentExt.{u, u, u, u, t} X.J
        ((inverseImageCommRingFunctor f.toToposHom).obj B.O) X.O f.fSharpInverseImage G 1

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv_mk
declarations.doc:
**The bijection of [Stacks 0GQ5] is the canonical one**: it sends the isomorphism class of
an extension `𝒪'` to the obstruction class `o(𝒪 ⊕ 𝒢, 𝒪')` of [Stacks 08UG] separating it from
the trivial extension, that is the element of `Ext¹_𝒪(NL_{𝒪/𝒪_ℬ}, 𝒢)` carrying the class of
`𝒪 ⊕ 𝒢` to that of `𝒪'` in the torsor of [Stacks 08UK].
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv_mk
    (Q : (ofTrivialBase f G).CompatibleFirstOrderThickening) :
    squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv f G
        (Quotient.mk (CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.isomorphicSetoid _) Q) =
      CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.pairObstruction
        ((ofTrivialBase f G).trivialSolution (IsIso.id B.O)) Q

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.trivialSolution
declarations.doc:
**The trivial square-zero extension is a solution** of the square-zero extension problem of
[Stacks 08UF] whose base reduction is invertible: `𝒪' = 𝒪 ⋉ 𝒢`, with the projection as reduction,
the inclusion `m ↦ (0, m)` as the identification of `𝒢` with the kernel, and the zero section
composed with the structure map of `f` as the map from the inverse image of the thickened base.

This is the existence of a solution in the proof of [Stacks 0GQ5] — the source's "a solution
exists, take `𝒢 ⊕ 𝒪`". It is not the bijection with `Ext¹`, which needs the torsor statement of
[Stacks 08UK]; see
`StacksFrontier/Deformation/ToposThickening/SquareZeroExtensionClasses.lean`.
declarations.statement: def trivialSolution (h : IsIso S.baseReduction) : S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening
declarations.comment: the existence of a solution: the trivial extension 𝒪 ⋉ 𝒢; not the bijection with Ext¹, which needs the torsor statement of 08UK

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.nonempty_compatibleFirstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**A square-zero extension problem of ringed topoi whose bottom row is
`0 ⟶ 0 ⟶ f⁻¹𝒪_B ⟶ f⁻¹𝒪_B ⟶ 0` has a solution**, namely the trivial extension `𝒪 ⋉ 𝒢`. This is
the base point the torsor statement of [Stacks 08UK] needs in order to turn into the bijection of
[Stacks 0GQ5].
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_compatibleFirstOrderThickening (h : IsIso S.baseReduction) :
    Nonempty S.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening
declarations.comment: the existence of a solution, as the base point the torsor of 08UK needs; not the bijection with Ext¹

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.lift_comp_reduction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ6**, the commutative diagram: `α'` followed by the reduction
`𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` is the presentation attached to `α`.
declarations.statement:
theorem lift_comp_reduction (base : inverseImageBaseRing S ⟶ P.extension)
    (hbase : base ≫ P.reduction = S.f.fSharpInverseImage) :
    P.lift base ≫ P.reduction = P.presentation
declarations.comment: the commutative diagram over 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪 for ℰ underlying 𝒪' with α' the identity

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.presentation_isLocallySurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ6**, surjectivity of `f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪`: the variables of the free
algebra are all the local sections of `𝒪'`, and they already cover `𝒪` because the reduction
does.
declarations.statement:
instance presentation_isLocallySurjective :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective X.J P.presentation.hom
declarations.comment: surjectivity of f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪, which is what makes NL(α) defined

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.exists_generators
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ6**, the choice the source makes is possible: there are a sheaf of
sets `ℰ` and maps `α' : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪'`, `α : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪` forming a commutative triangle over the reduction
`𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` for which `f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪` is surjective. The witness is the source's own: `ℰ` is the
sheaf of sets underlying `𝒪'` and `α'` is the identity.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_generators :
    ∃ (E : Functor X.Cᵒᵖ (Type u)) (α' : E ⟶ underlyingPresheaf X.J P.extension)
      (α : E ⟶ underlyingPresheaf X.J X.O),
      α' ≫ Functor.whiskerRight P.reduction.hom (forget CommRingCat.{u}) = α ∧
        Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective X.J
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.presentation X.J (inverseImageBaseRing S) X.O
            S.f.fSharpInverseImage E α).hom
declarations.comment: the choice of ℰ with α' : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪' and α : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪 making f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪 surjective

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.conormalToIdeal
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ6**, the map `𝒥/𝒥² ⟶ 𝒢` determined by `α'`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev conormalToIdeal (base : inverseImageBaseRing S ⟶ P.extension)
    (hbase : base ≫ P.reduction = S.f.fSharpInverseImage) :
    conormalSheaf.{u, u, u, u} X.J
        (freeAlgebraSheaf X.J (inverseImageBaseRing S) P.generators) X.O P.presentation ⟶
      S.G
declarations.comment: the map 𝒥/𝒥² ⟶ 𝒢 determined by α'

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.extClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ6**, the class in `Ext¹_𝒪(NL(α), 𝒢)` that `α'` determines: the
first Ext class of the map `𝒥/𝒥² ⟶ 𝒢`.
declarations.statement:
def extClass (base : inverseImageBaseRing S ⟶ P.extension)
    (hbase : base ≫ P.reduction = S.f.fSharpInverseImage) :
    DerivedCategory.Ext (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.naiveCotangentComplex)
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj S.G) 1
declarations.comment: the class in Ext¹_𝒪(NL(α), 𝒢) that α' determines through the map 𝒥/𝒥² ⟶ 𝒢

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.isLocallySurjective_presentation_of_isLocallySurjective
declarations.doc:
For any sheaf of sets `ℰ` with a surjection `α' : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪'`, the presentation
`f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪` of `α = α'` followed by the reduction is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_presentation_of_isLocallySurjective
    (Q : (ofTrivialBase f G).CompatibleFirstOrderThickening) (E : Functor X.Cᵒᵖ (Type u))
    (α' : E ⟶ underlyingPresheaf X.J Q.extension) [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective X.J α'] :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective X.J (Stacks.SheafOfModules.presentation X.J
      ((inverseImageCommRingFunctor f.toToposHom).obj B.O) X.O f.fSharpInverseImage E
        (α' ≫ Functor.whiskerRight Q.reduction.hom (forget CommRingCat.{u}))).hom

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.exists_generators_ofTrivialBase
declarations.doc:
For every extension `0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪 ⟶ 0` of `f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ`-algebras there are a sheaf of sets
`ℰ` and maps `α' : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪'`, `α : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪` forming a commutative triangle over `𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` for which
`f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪` is surjective; for instance `ℰ` the sheaf of sets underlying `𝒪'` and `α'` the
identity.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_generators_ofTrivialBase
    (Q : (ofTrivialBase f G).CompatibleFirstOrderThickening) :
    ∃ (E : Functor X.Cᵒᵖ (Type u)) (α' : E ⟶ underlyingPresheaf X.J Q.extension)
      (α : E ⟶ underlyingPresheaf X.J X.O),
      α' ≫ Functor.whiskerRight Q.reduction.hom (forget CommRingCat.{u}) = α ∧
        Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective X.J (Stacks.SheafOfModules.presentation X.J
          ((inverseImageCommRingFunctor f.toToposHom).obj B.O) X.O f.fSharpInverseImage E α).hom

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.RingedToposExtensionProblem.squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv_mk_eq_generators
declarations.doc:
Let `f : (Sh(𝒞), 𝒪) ⟶ (Sh(ℬ), 𝒪_ℬ)` be a morphism of ringed topoi, `𝒢` an `𝒪`-module and
`0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪 ⟶ 0` an extension of `f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ`-algebras with `𝒢` an ideal of square zero. Let
`ℰ` be a sheaf of sets with a commutative diagram `α' : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪'`, `α : ℰ ⟶ 𝒪` over `𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` such
that `f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ[ℰ] ⟶ 𝒪` is surjective with kernel `𝒥`. The map `𝒥/𝒥² ⟶ 𝒢` determined by `α'` has a
class in `Ext¹_𝒪(NL(α), 𝒢)`; transported along the isomorphism `NL(α) ≅ NL_{𝒪/𝒪_ℬ}` of
[Stacks 08TY], it is the element of `Ext¹_𝒪(NL_{𝒪/𝒪_ℬ}, 𝒢)` corresponding to `𝒪'` under the
bijection of [Stacks 0GQ5].
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv_mk_eq_generators
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (Sheaf.targetModules.{u, u, u} X.J X.O)] :
    inv (DerivedCategory.Q.map
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.naiveCotangentComplexComparison.{u, u, u, u} X.J
          ((inverseImageCommRingFunctor f.toToposHom).obj B.O) X.O f.fSharpInverseImage E α)) ≫
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.presentationConormalExtClass.{u, u, u, t} X.J
        ((inverseImageCommRingFunctor f.toToposHom).obj B.O) X.O f.fSharpInverseImage E α G
        (Q.generatorsConormalToIdeal (A := (inverseImageCommRingFunctor f.toToposHom).obj B.O)
          (a := f.fSharpInverseImage) (base := Q.baseMap) hα
        (baseMap_comp_reduction_ofTrivialBase Q)) =
      squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv f G
        (Quotient.mk (CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.isomorphicSetoid _) Q)

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.LiftingMorphismDerived.nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff
declarations.doc:
Let `f : (Sh(𝒞), 𝒪_𝒞) ⟶ (Sh(ℬ), 𝒪_ℬ)` and `g : (Sh(𝒟), 𝒪_𝒟) ⟶ (Sh(𝒞), 𝒪_𝒞)` be morphisms of
ringed topoi, `ℱ` an `𝒪_𝒞`-module, `𝒢` an `𝒪_𝒟`-module and `c : g^*ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` an `𝒪_𝒟`-linear map. Let
`0 ⟶ ℱ ⟶ 𝒪_{𝒞'} ⟶ 𝒪_𝒞 ⟶ 0` be an extension of `f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ`-algebras (a solution `QC` of the problem of
Stacks 0GQ5 for `f` and `ℱ`) corresponding to `ξ ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_𝒞}(NL_{𝒪_𝒞/𝒪_ℬ}, ℱ)`, and
`0 ⟶ 𝒢 ⟶ 𝒪_{𝒟'} ⟶ 𝒪_𝒟 ⟶ 0` an extension of `g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ`-algebras (a solution `QD` of the problem for
`f ∘ g` and `𝒢`) corresponding to `ζ ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_𝒟}(NL_{𝒪_𝒟/𝒪_ℬ}, 𝒢)`, the classes being those of
Stacks 0GQ5. Then there is a morphism `g' : (Sh(𝒟), 𝒪_{𝒟'}) ⟶ (Sh(𝒞), 𝒪_{𝒞'})` of ringed topoi over
`(Sh(ℬ), 𝒪_ℬ)` compatible with `g` and `c` if and only if `ξ` and `ζ` map to the same element of
`Ext¹_{𝒪_𝒟}(Lg^*NL_{𝒪_𝒞/𝒪_ℬ}, 𝒢)`: `ξ` through `Lg^*` and `Lg^*ℱ ⟶ g^*ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` (`pullbackExtClass`),
`ζ` through the canonical map `Lg^*NL_{𝒪_𝒞/𝒪_ℬ} ⟶ NL_{𝒪_𝒟/𝒪_ℬ}` (`restrictExtClass`).
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_compatibleMorphism_iff :
    Nonempty (CompatibleMorphism g QC QD c) ↔
      pullbackExtClass g c
          (RingedToposExtensionProblem.squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv f F
            (Quotient.mk
              (RingedToposExtensionProblem.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.isomorphicSetoid _)
              QC)) =
        restrictExtClass f g
          (RingedToposExtensionProblem.squareZeroExtensionClassesEquiv (f.comp g) G
            (Quotient.mk
              (RingedToposExtensionProblem.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening.isomorphicSetoid _)
              QD))

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.LiftDiagram.pulledNaiveCotangentComparison
declarations.doc:
The canonical comparison `g^*NL_{𝒪_𝒞/𝒪_ℬ} ⟶ NL_{𝒪_𝒟/𝒪_ℬ}`: the base-change map for
`f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ ⟶ 𝒪_𝒞 ⟶ 𝒪_𝒟` followed by the relative map for `f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ ⟶ g⁻¹f⁻¹𝒪_ℬ ⟶ 𝒪_𝒟`.
declarations.statement:
def pulledNaiveCotangentComparison :
    D.pulledNaiveCotangentComplex ⟶ D.relativeNaiveCotangentComplex
declarations.comment:
the canonical comparison `g^*NL_{O_C/O_B} ⟶ NL_{O_D/O_B}` along which `ζ` is
read, for the DEGREEWISE pullback, built from the base-change and relative maps of Tag 0E1Y with
the topoi identified as in 08UG's own reduction. The derived pullback `Lg^*NL_{O_C/O_B}` of the
source's statement is NOT used: the LEFT-DERIVED extension of scalars along `O_C ⟶ O_D` is
absent from the library, degreewise extension of scalars being only right exact. Tag 08TZ is
NOT the missing input and is NOT absent from the library: it is carried as
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.inverseImageNaiveCotangentComplexIso`, and it is about the inverse image
along a morphism of TOPOI, whereas both layers here live on the one site `J`

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.LiftDiagram.restrictExtClass
declarations.doc:
The map `Ext¹_{𝒪_𝒟}(NL_{𝒪_𝒟/𝒪_ℬ}, 𝒢) ⟶ Ext¹_{𝒪_𝒟}(g^*NL_{𝒪_𝒞/𝒪_ℬ}, 𝒢)`: precomposition
with the canonical comparison of the two naive cotangent complexes.
declarations.statement: def restrictExtClass (ζ : D.relativeExtGroup) : D.pulledExtGroup
declarations.comment:
the map `Ext¹(NL_{O_D/O_B}, G) ⟶ Ext¹(g^*NL_{O_C/O_B}, G)` in which `ζ` is read,
the second of the two maps the source's proof constructs. The first, through the derived pullback
of Tag 06YY and `Lg^*F ⟶ g^*F ⟶ G`, is NOT constructed here

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.LiftDiagram.restrictExtClassHom
declarations.doc: The map in which `ζ` is read, as a homomorphism of the two `Ext` groups.
declarations.statement: def restrictExtClassHom : D.relativeExtGroup →+ D.pulledExtGroup
declarations.comment:
the same map as an additive homomorphism; the first of the source's two maps is
not constructed here

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.LiftDiagram.nonempty_lift_iff_eq_restrictExtClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0GQ7.** A morphism `g' : (Sh(𝒟), 𝒪_{𝒟'}) ⟶ (Sh(𝒞), 𝒪_{𝒞'})` of ringed
topoi over `(Sh(ℬ), 𝒪_ℬ)` compatible with `g` and the prescribed map `c` on the square-zero
ideals exists if and only if the classes of the two extensions have the same image in
`Ext¹_{𝒪_𝒟}(g^*NL_{𝒪_𝒞/𝒪_ℬ}, 𝒢)`.

Those morphisms are the concrete type `LiftDiagram.Lift` of the diagram, identified by `e` with
the factorizations of the difference homomorphism `δ` of Step 1 of the proof of **Stacks 08UG**
through the degree `0` term of `g^*NL_{𝒪_𝒞/𝒪_ℬ}`; the hypothesis `hcompat` is the compatibility
between the constructions in the proofs of **Stacks 0GQ5** and **Stacks 08UG**, which the source
omits and defers to **Stacks 0GQ8**: the difference of the two classes is the obstruction class
of **Stacks 08UG**.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_lift_iff_eq_restrictExtClass
    (P : NaiveCotangentTwoTerm (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf D.back.O)) 0))
    (hP : P.obj = DerivedCategory.Q.obj D.pulledNaiveCotangentComplex)
    (δ : P.conormal ⟶ D.back.G)
    (e : D.Lift ≃ {θ : P.base ⟶ D.back.G // P.d ≫ θ = δ})
    (ξ : D.pulledExtGroup) (ζ : D.relativeExtGroup)
    (hcompat : eqToHom hP ≫ (ξ - D.restrictExtClass ζ) = P.conormalExtClass D.back.G δ) :
    Nonempty D.Lift ↔ ξ = D.restrictExtClass ζ
declarations.comment:
the equivalence, from clause (1) of Tag 08UG: a morphism of ringed topoi over the
base compatible with `g` and `c` exists exactly when the two Ext¹ classes agree. THIS IS THE
DEGREEWISE ANALOGUE, NOT THE SOURCE'S STATEMENT: the comparison group is `Ext¹(g^*NL, G)` rather
than `Ext¹(Lg^*NL, G)`, the LEFT-DERIVED extension of scalars being absent from the library (NOT
Tag 08TZ, which is carried as
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.inverseImageNaiveCotangentComplexIso` and is about inverse images along a
morphism of topoi, not about `Lg^*` on one site), and `ξ` is taken as its image there rather than
mapped in. Carried: the two-term structure `P` with its identification `hP`, the bijection `e`
(Steps 1 to 3 of the proof of 08UG), the Step 1 homomorphism `δ`, and `hcompat` -- the
compatibility between the constructions in the proofs of Tags 0GQ5 and 08UG whose statement and
